data.jd_text:
**Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE (Hybrid)
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Global PMO Lead
   

  

**About The Role**
 This role exists to help build and embed a fit\-for\-purpose PMO capability for the Emerging Markets (EM) business, enabling disciplined execution of innovation and portfolio priorities at pace and with quality.
   

  

 As Flora Food Group continues to scale consumer\-led innovation across regions, the Emerging Markets business requires stronger orchestration across Marketing, R\&D, Supply Chain, Finance and Operations. The PMO Manager will act as a foundational builder of this capability: setting up robust ways of working, driving executional discipline, and ensuring projects land on time, in full, and with clear accountability.
   

  

 This role is critical to reducing execution risk, improving speed\-to\-market, and freeing up functional leaders to focus on content and decision\-making rather than coordination.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Operating at the intersection of strategy and execution, you will help establish an Emerging Markets PMO operating/ framework model aligned to global P\&P / PMO standards, while tailored to local business realities.
   

  

 You will bring consistency, transparency and rigor to how innovation and portfolio initiatives are planned, governed and delivered, and act as the single point of truth for execution status, risks and delivery confidence across the EM innovation and portfolio agenda.
   

  

 You will act as the executional backbone for end\-to\-end project \& activity management, by owning the planning and orchestration of priority innovation and portfolio initiatives, ensuring cross\-functional teams’ ownership and accountability to deliver against clear timelines, milestones and decision gates.
   

  

 You will improve delivery confidence, resource visibility and decision quality across the EM portfolio by ensuring high\-quality data, discipline and follow\-through in portfolio \& project management systems. You will act as a role model for execution discipline, pragmatic problem\-solving and collaborative leadership; and you will help to build the EM PMO capability over time, including a small team, templates/tools, playbooks and best practices, as the EM hub scales.
   

  

**What This Role Is (and Is Not)**
 You will be
 **accountable for execution and orchestration** 
 , not for project content ownership. Project leadership and strategic direction will remain with the Marketing / Business leads; this role ensures the work lands.
   

  

 You are biased toward action, clarity and simplification — not to add bureaucracy.
   

  

**What Does It Take To Be Successful**
 You combine strong project management fundamentals with the confidence to operate in complex, cross\-functional FMCG environments. You are comfortable building structure where it does not yet exist, and you bring calm, clarity and momentum to ambiguous situations.
   

  

* 5–10\+ years’ experience in project, program or PMO roles within FMCG / CPG or similarly complex environments
* Experience acting as owner of PMO data quality, reporting cadence and execution dashboards in enterprise environments
* Strong systems thinker with the ability to design simple, scalable ways of working, with proven experience setting up or scaling PMO / project management structures
* Hands\-on experience managing end\-to\-end innovation, transformation or portfolio initiatives.
* Strong understanding of stage\-gate models, innovation lifecycles and launch readiness
* Confident facilitator and communicator with experience in influencing senior and cross\-functional stakeholders without direct authority
* Excellent planning, prioritization, execution discipline, high accountability mindset comfortable holding others to commitments and follow\-through for continuous improvement
* Values transparency, pragmatic, solution\-oriented, resilient under pressure and energised by building capability and enabling others to succeed
* Preferred, but not required: PMP, PRINCE2, Agile / SAFe certification.


**What’s next?**
**Flora Food Group** 
 is committed to culinary essentials for better food. We believe fewer, better ideas — executed with excellence — are what drive sustainable growth.
   

  

 This is a career\-defining opportunity to work with our high\-impact brands in a high\-energy, high\-accountability environment. If you recognise yourself in this profile, apply and be part of this exciting journey. Apply now at www.florafoodgroup.com.We prefer to receive your application before
 **25th June 2026** 
 .
   

  

 We understand your resume might not be up to date and recommend that you apply with what you have or your LinkedIn Profile. Flora Food Group is dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workplace, we understand that you might not meet all the requirements stated in the description, but we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the right candidate for this role or other roles.
   

  

*Flora Food Group is an employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and equal opportunities for all. We recruit based only on values, qualifications, performance, skills, behaviours, experience, and knowledge. We ensure job advertisements are free from unintentional bias.*
*No personal characteristics should be a barrier to joining Flora Food Group. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or other personal characteristics.*

data.jd_text:
**Application Deadline:** 
 30 June 2026
 



**Department:** 
 Central Services, People
 



**Location:** 
 Dubai
   

  




**Description**
**A Career with Trivandi**
 Working for Trivandi means the opportunity to work on the world’s most iconic projects in a supportive, people\-first environment with colleagues who are passionate, collaborative and love what they do.
   

  

 Our culture is grounded in trust and fulfilment, with a shared passion for achieving excellence, whilst having fun. We’re dedicated to ensuring that every team member’s voice is heard and valued, enabling Trivandi to be shaped and grown by the people within it.
   

  

 Ultimately, Trivandi is a place where you’ll be excited to come to work at the start of each week.
   

  

 Together, we keep our shared values at the heart of everything we do:
   

  

**Passion** 
 : We love what we do and care passionately about achieving great outcomes with our partners.
   

  

**Trust \& Quality:** 
 We are trusted to consistently deliver to the highest international standards and professional ethics.
   

  

**OneTeam** 
 : We are a close\-knit team and know that our best work is done together. We care for each other, always putting people first, enabling us to deliver our best work.
   

  

**Always Evolving** 
 : We don't stand still. We strive to make each project better than the last, daring to challenge what's gone before, in our quest for innovation and improvement.
   

  

**About Trivandi**
 Trivandi provides advisory, design and delivery services across sport, events, live entertainment and venues.
   

  

 Founded in 2013 from the success of the London 2012 Games, we have grown to over 100 specialists across four global offices in London, Dubai, Riyadh and Brisbane, delivering over 300 projects in 29 countries.
   

  

 Our unique “One Team” approach brings together the right expertise at the right time, synchronising strategy, design, project management, and operations to simplify complexity and deliver actionable solutions that drive meaningful impact.
   

  

 We passionately share our knowledge to empower local teams, unlocking the full potential of each unique experience to inspire positive change and create lasting legacies.
   

  

 That’s what we mean by creating experiences, better.
   

  

  

**About the Role**
 We are looking for a motivated People Administrator \& PRO to join our People team to support the day\-to\-day People operations and government relations activities for the business in Dubai and KSA, with a strong focus on DMCC processes and compliance.
   

  

 The role is responsible for coordinating employee lifecycle administration, including visa and immigration activities, maintaining employee records, supporting payroll inputs, and acting as the key liaison with DMCC and relevant UAE government authorities.
   

  

 This role requires strong organisational skills, attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and a proactive approach to employee support and compliance management.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be highly energetic, professional and able to demonstrate integrity and discretion in all tasks. As this role involves handling sensitive personal and company data, you must be able to manage confidential information with the highest level of care and responsibility.
   

  

 To come on this journey with us, you’ll bring a great sense of humour, a positive and collaborative mindset, and the confidence to navigate a fast\-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment. You should be naturally resourceful, solutions\-driven, and comfortable taking initiative. Most importantly, you’ll enjoy a challenge and be excited by the opportunity to support and elevate the People function across all regions as we continue to grow.
   

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 At Trivandi all our roles are broad and flexible, but here’s a flavour of where you’ll focus your time:
   

  

**HR Administration** 
* Support day\-to\-day People administration activities across the employee lifecycle including onboarding, employment changes and offboarding.
* Prepare letters, certificates and other HR documentation.
* Maintain accurate employee records and HR databases ensuring all information is up to date and compliant.
* Coordinate onboarding processes for new employees including document collection, inductions and system access requests.
* Track probation periods, visa expiry dates, passport renewals and other key employee milestones.
* Support payroll administration by preparing monthly payroll inputs including leave, allowances, deductions and employee changes.
* Maintain annual leave and attendance records.
* Respond to employee queries relating to HR policies, benefits, visas and company procedures.
* Support the implementation and continuous improvement of HR processes and systems.
* Assist with recruitment coordination including interview scheduling, candidate communication and onboarding administration.
* Ensure all HR practices are compliant with UAE labour law and company policies.


**PRO \& Government Relations Responsibilities** 
* Act as the main point of contact for DMCC and relevant UAE government authorities.
* Manage and process employment visas, labour cards, Emirates IDs, medicals and residency permits.
* Coordinate visa applications, renewals, cancellations and status changes for employees
* Maintain accurate tracking of all visa and immigration activities and ensure renewals are completed in advance of expiry dates.
* Ensure compliance with all DMCC regulations and UAE immigration requirements.
* Coordinate document attestation and notarisation processes where required.
* Support WPS and labour\-related administrative requirements.
* Keep up to date with changes to UAE labour law, immigration regulations and DMCC requirements and communicate impacts to the business.
* Support the KSA People team with KSA Business Visa applications and renewals, monitoring expiry dates and turnaround times. Ensure all documentation is complete and correct before employees visit the visa processing centre.


**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
**Personal Skills and Experience**
 The key knowledge, experience, and qualifications we are looking for include:
 * 1–2 years of experience in Human Resources or People operations in Dubai, ideally within a professional services or fast\-paced environment.
* Strong administration skills developed within a professional setting.
* Experience with HRMS platforms or other relevant HR information system.
* Proficient in the use of IT and Microsoft programmes and iOS applications.
* Highly organised, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
* Desirable \- DMCC systems knowledge
* Desirable – KSA business visa and Iqama knowledge
* Strongly desirable \- Arabic speaker


**About You**
 The key competencies and behaviours we are looking for include:
 * Excellent team working skills with an open, friendly, and supportive style.
* Ability to effectively, accurately, and concisely present and communicate in both written and verbal forms and be empathetic across different audiences and cultural sensitivities.
* Proven attention to detail
* Able to handle shifting demands.
* Responsive and helpful
* Self\-motivated and resourceful
* Loyal, displaying the highest levels of integrity and commitment.
* Flexible and adaptable in a dynamic company


**Benefits**
 If you are successful in this application we will invest in you, support, and train you to be successful, opening up a world of opportunities.
   

  

 Trivandi is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity amongst our team. We aim to be truly representative of all sections of society, creating an environment where everyone feels respected and able to give of their best. We therefore warmly welcome applications from anyone who meets the criteria we’ve described.

**Your new company** 




  





 We are working with a cutting\-edge, research\-driven FinTech company backed by a prominent family office. Specializing in advanced, AI\-powered investment and allocation strategies, they combine mathematical modeling, portfolio optimization, and risk analytics to build a sophisticated SaaS platform.
 



 As they scale their elite, Dubai\-based AI engineering hub, they are seeking a structured, hands\-on Head of Delivery to serve as the operational anchor of the team.
 



  





  





**Your new role** 




 As the Head of Delivery, you will act as the critical bridge between people, tech, and product. Sitting between senior management (the Group CFO and Director) and a highly talented technical team, you will be the operational backbone of the Dubai office.
 



 Your core responsibilities will include:
 


* **Owning Delivery:** 
 Chairing and leading recurring progress ("J\-curve") meetings, tracking technical commitments relentlessly, and following up through to execution.
* **Team Coordination:** 
 Coordinating a small, senior team of engineers and support staff, ensuring clear alignment between leadership and technical execution.
* **End\-to\-End Recruitment:** 
 Leading the hiring lifecycle for top\-tier technical and AI talent—screening, interviewing, and making clear hire/no\-hire recommendations.
* **Strategy \& Product Documentation:** 
 Turning rough internal directions into clear, exceptionally well\-written documentation and positioning pieces for internal and external stakeholders.



  





  





**What you'll need to succeed** 




 You do not need to be an engineer yourself, but you must be a masterful, structured coordinator who is highly comfortable working alongside technical minds.
 



 To be successful, you will need:
 


* Proven experience in a delivery, operations, or program management role within a technology, software, or AI environment.
* Deep hands\-on experience and working knowledge of
 **Kanban and Scrum** 
 frameworks.
* Excellent technical literacy—the ability to understand engineering workflows, ask the right questions, and hold people to their commitments.
* A solid understanding of the
 **finance industry, financial markets, or private equity** 
 (highly advantageous).
* Strong recruitment instincts with a confident ability to assess and judge technical candidates.
* Impeccable written and spoken English, paired with a calm, diplomatic, and self\-directed personal style.
* A commitment to being based full\-time, on\-site in Dubai.



  





  





**What you'll get in return** 




  





 This is a unique opportunity to join a highly specialized, well\-backed entity at an exciting stage of product innovation. You will receive a highly competitive compensation package tailored to your experience. For the right international candidate looking to make a long\-term commitment to Dubai, comprehensive relocation support is available.
 



  





  





**What you'll need to do now** 




 If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up\-to\-date copy of your CV, and a consultant will reach out to you should your profile look suitable, for a further discussion.

**About the Company** 




 We are building a next\-generation orchestration infrastructure platform, operating across device ecosystems, partner networks and licensed financial institutions. As an early\-stage company, we are simultaneously building our platform, organisation, operating model and delivery capability. We are looking for a Program Manager to help establish the governance, visibility and execution discipline required to support our growth.
 



  





**ROLE SUMMARY** 




 The Program Manager – Strategic Execution is responsible for ensuring the company executes effectively across Product, Engineering, Operations and strategic partners. The role creates visibility, accountability and structure across the organisation whilst helping leadership establish the operating mechanisms required to scale. This is a highly cross\-functional position that works directly with leadership and influences initiatives across the company.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Governance \& Planning** 



* Establish company planning processes.
* Coordinate roadmap planning and prioritisation activities.
* Develop KPI and OKR reporting frameworks.
* Create executive dashboards and reporting.
* Manage company\-level risks, issues and dependencies.
* Support governance reviews and leadership operating cadences.



**Product \& Engineering Delivery** 



* Coordinate delivery across Product, Engineering and Architecture.
* Track milestones, deliverables and dependencies.
* Support release planning and readiness activities.
* Escalate delivery risks and blockers.
* Ensure strategic initiatives remain aligned and on track.



**Programme Management** 



* Build and maintain programme plans.
* Coordinate cross\-functional workstreams.
* Drive accountability for agreed actions and commitments.
* Facilitate decision tracking and execution follow\-through.
* Support portfolio visibility and prioritisation.



**Vendor \& Partner Coordination** 



* Coordinate activities involving strategic vendors and partners.
* Track commitments, timelines and deliverables.
* Ensure dependencies are identified and managed.
* Support governance and reporting activities.



  





**EXPERIENCE \& SKILLS** 



* Startup or high\-growth company experience preferred.
* 10\+ years programme management experience.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience working across Product and Engineering organisations.
* Strong planning, governance and execution capabilities.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguous and fast\-changing environments.
* Experience building processes and operating frameworks from the ground up.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.



  





**SUCCESS MEASURES** 




 Success in this role will be measured by:
 


* Improved visibility of company execution.
* Increased predictability of delivery outcomes.
* Effective management of risks and dependencies.
* Reduced leadership overhead associated with programme coordination.
* Establishment of scalable governance and operating processes.
* Successful delivery of strategic cross\-functional initiatives.

**Why qlub**
 The end of a great meal shouldn't be the slow part. Waiting for the check, finding someone to take payment, splitting a bill by hand. qlub removes that friction. Guests scan a QR code and pay in seconds. No app, no download, no waiting.
   

  

 From Pay\-at\-Table and Digital Menus to Order\-and\-Pay, Payment Links, and SoftPOS terminals, we handle the full payment experience so restaurants can focus on what they do best: great hospitality. Less friction means faster table turnover, smoother operations, and higher profit.
   

  

 We're a fast\-scaling fintech backed by Mastercard, Mubadala, e\& and Shorooq. $72M raised, live across multiple markets worldwide, and headcount doubled in the past year. We're building the teams that take us to the next stage.
   

  

**The role**
 qlub is scaling fast across markets worldwide, and we look for people who take real ownership of their work. As our next Operations Executive, you'll help drive our growth in Partner Success building, shipping, and delivering results from day one.
   

  

 You'll work closely with operators and partners to turn frictionless payments into real growth for restaurants. You'll also play a key role in ensuring new restaurant partners have a smooth onboarding journey and that existing partners maximize their adoption of Qlub solutions. From training restaurant staff to troubleshooting issues and driving re\-engagement, you'll be at the frontlines of ensuring our partners and their customers have the best possible experience.
   

  

 If you thrive in a fast\-moving, build\-from\-scratch environment, this role is for you.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
**Onboarding \& Setup**
* Support the full onboarding journey of new restaurant partners, including account setup and system configurations when required
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams, including Sales, Tech, Content, Procurement, and Account Management, to ensure a seamless go\-live experience
* Ensure all onboarding activities are completed accurately and on time to facilitate successful launches


**Training \& Enablement**
* Conduct in\-person and remote training sessions for restaurant staff to ensure smooth adoption of Qlub's solutions
* Organize and deliver retraining sessions when needed to address knowledge gaps and reinforce best practices
* Act as a trusted advisor for restaurant teams, helping them maximize the value of Qlub's products and features


**Performance Monitoring \& Adoption**
* Monitor partner performance metrics, including QR adoption rates and transaction trends, to proactively identify opportunities and potential issues
* Troubleshoot operational and technical challenges in collaboration with Account Management, Customer Support, and Tech teams
* Implement corrective actions and provide ongoing enablement to drive long\-term adoption and engagement
* Conduct regular restaurant visits and operational checks to ensure teams remain confident and effective in using Qlub solutions


**Cross\-Team Collaboration \& Feedback**
* Partner closely with Account Managers to share insights on partner performance and ensure timely communication with key stakeholders
* Gather feedback from restaurant partners and frontline staff to continuously improve processes, training materials, and the overall partner experience
* Collaborate with Product, Operations, and Tech teams to identify recurring challenges and contribute to scalable solutions and product enhancements


**What You’ll Own**
* Own the end\-to\-end onboarding process for new restaurant partners, ensuring a seamless setup experience and building strong partner relationships from day one
* Drive adoption and engagement for newly onboarded partners, achieving and maintaining a target Qlub adoption rate of 45% across assigned accounts
* Monitor and manage the performance of existing partner outlets, proactively identifying opportunities to improve adoption, engagement, and overall partner success


**Who You Are**
* You've done this before in a fast\-moving, high\-growth environment
* You move fast and make strong decisions with incomplete information
* You take real ownership and think like an operator, not a coordinator
* You're energized by solving problems and creating exceptional experiences for restaurant partners and their customers
* You're highly organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities without losing attention to detail
* You enjoy working directly with customers, building relationships, and helping partners succeed


**What You'll Need**
* A valid driving license and access to a car are required
* 0–2 years of experience in customer onboarding, account management, training, customer success, or a similar client\-facing role
* Proven ability to deliver training sessions and engage diverse audiences effectively
* Strong communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills
* A problem\-solving mindset with the ability to troubleshoot issues and coordinate solutions quickly across multiple stakeholders
* Proficiency with digital tools such as CRM systems, Google Workspace, Excel, and Google Sheets
* Fluency in English is a must
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, evolving environment where priorities can shift quickly


**Nice to have**
* Experience in hospitality, F\&B, SaaS, or technology environments is a strong plus
* Fluency in Arabic is a plus


**What We Offer**
* Real ownership over products that impact millions of diners and thousands of restaurants globally
* The opportunity to solve challenging problems in payments, hospitality, and customer experience
* A fast\-moving environment where great ideas quickly become reality
* Close collaboration with experienced operators, builders, and industry experts
* A chance to leave a visible mark on one of the fastest\-growing restaurant technology companies globally


**Ready to build?** 
 Join us and help shape how the world pays at the table. If that excites you, apply now.

data.jd_text:
**Role Description** 




 The Regional Director – Middle East \& French West Africa will lead the establishment, expansion, and long‑term development of the company’s pharmaceutical business across the Middle East Region and Francophone West Africa. The role carries full regional P\&L responsibility and is accountable for building a scalable commercial platform capable of delivering sustainable growth across multiple markets.
 



  





 The regional expansion strategy will initially focus on establishing a strong presence in Iraq, Senegal, and Ivory Coast, followed by expansion into selected non\-GCC Middle Eastern markets and key Frontier and West African (FWA) markets. Subsequently, the strategy will extend to GCC countries to further strengthen the company's regional footprint.
 



  





 This position represents a senior regional leadership role responsible for developing the company’s commercial footprint, building high‑performing country teams, establishing strong distributor and stakeholder relationships and delivering consistent financial and operational performance across the region.
 



  





 The successful candidate will combine strong strategic leadership with hands‑on execution capability and an entrepreneurial mindset suited to building a regional business in the region.
 



  





**Governance and Reporting Structure** 




 The Regional Director will report to the Group Director International Business and will be responsible for overall governance, operational leadership, and financial performance of the defined region.
 



 Key governance responsibilities include:
 


* Full regional profit and loss accountability
* Development and execution of regional business plans
* Establishment of effective governance and reporting processes
* Alignment of regional strategy with global corporate objectives
* Ensuring regulatory, financial, and operational compliance across all markets



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Regional Strategy Development** 



* Develop and implement the commercial strategy for the region.
* Identify and prioritize new market entry opportunities including new countries, therapeutic segments, market segments, and product opportunities.
* Develop multi‑year regional growth plans including revenue targets, portfolio expansion, and market penetration strategies.
* Assess regulatory environments and competitive landscapes across the region.



  





**Market Entry and Expansion** 



* Lead the planning and execution of country launches across priority markets.
* Establish commercial operations in new markets including distributor and promotional agency partnerships, commercial infrastructure, and local teams.
* Expand operations beyond the initial markets of Iraq, Senegal and Ivory Coast, into other regional markets.
* Drive early market entry and rapid product launch strategies.



  





**Regulatory and Market Access Acceleration** 



* Assess regulatory environments across target markets.
* Devise and implement strategies and action plans to accelerate regulatory processes.
* Ensure early market entry and rapid new product launches through proactive regulatory planning and coordination.



  





**Commercial Leadership** 



* Provide strategic and operational leadership to commercial teams across the region.
* Establish clear regional sales targets and financial performance expectations.
* Drive revenue growth and market share expansion across multiple markets.
* Ensure disciplined commercial execution at the country and front\-line levels.



  





**Organization and Team Development** 



* Recruit, develop, and lead strong country leadership and front\-line teams.
* Foster a culture of engagement, accountability, and performance across all country teams.
* Drive continuous team development and capability building.
* Promote strong collaboration across commercial, regulatory, and operational functions.



  





**Operational Leadership and Execution** 



* Maintain a hands‑on leadership approach with active involvement in on‑ground execution.
* Ensure disciplined implementation of commercial plans and market expansion initiatives.
* Work closely with distributors and local partners to ensure strong market penetration.
* Closely engage with key opinion leaders and key officers of major medical associations in the region and at the county level.



  





**Business Monitoring and Performance Management** 



* Develop and implement robust business monitoring systems across the region.
* Establish performance management frameworks to track sales, profitability, and operational metrics.
* Monitor business performance against plans and forecasts.
* Implement corrective actions where deviations from plan occur.
* Maintain clear and structured reporting systems at country, region and corporate levels.



  





**Strategic Partnerships and Stakeholder Engagement** 



* Build strong relationships with pharmaceutical distributors and channel partners across the region.
* Engage regulatory authorities and healthcare stakeholders across the region.
* Represent the company within relevant pharmaceutical and healthcare industry forums.
* Identify partnerships that accelerate market penetration and commercial growth.



  





**Cross‑Functional Leadership** 



* Coordinate regional activities across regulatory, supply chain, marketing, finance, and medical functions.
* Ensure alignment between regional commercial strategy and corporate priorities.
* Maintain strong operational discipline and compliance across all markets.



  





**Performance Expectations** 




 Success in the role will be measured by the candidate’s ability to:
 


* Deliver strong regional revenue growth and profitability
* Successfully launch and expand operations across priority markets
* Build high‑performing country leadership teams
* Establish a scalable commercial infrastructure across the Middle East and Francophone West Africa
* Achieve rapid market penetration and successful product launches
* Implement strong governance, reporting, and business monitoring systems



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 The ideal candidate must have:
 


* More than 15 years of pharmaceutical commercial leadership experience, including at least 5 years in sales leadership positions
* Significant experience managing multi‑country operations in Africa
* Strong knowledge of Middle East and African healthcare markets
* Demonstrated success launching or expanding pharmaceutical businesses in emerging markets
* Strong financial and P\&L management capability

* About Arada


 Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Sharjah, UAE, Arada was created to build spaces that inspire, connect, and enrich communities. As one of the region’s fastest\-growing master developers, Arada has delivered landmark residential, retail, hospitality, and lifestyle destinations that redefine modern living.
   

  

 At Arada, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and high\-performance culture where talented professionals are empowered to make a meaningful impact on the communities we create.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Act as the central operational link and technical attaché to the Project Controls Director, driving portfolio\-wide data consolidation, cross\-functional stakeholder coordination, and executive reporting from the Head Office. This role is responsible for standardizing reporting frameworks across all high\-rise and master development sites, monitoring design and procurement trackers, and developing C\-suite presentations, serving as the strategic right\-hand support for all departmental operations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Portfolio Data Consolidation \& Reporting Governance
* Central Database Management: Establish and maintain the department's central project controls database, ensuring seamless data harvesting and consolidation from all project sites.
* Reporting Standardization: Design, implement, and enforce standardized weekly and monthly reporting templates across contractors, consultants, and internal project teams to ensure consistency, accuracy, and transparency.
* Periodic Audit \& Review: Conduct rigorous reviews of incoming site reports, cross\-verifying contractor progress claims against actual site conditions and flagging critical path anomalies, schedule risks, and reporting inconsistencies directly to the Project Controls Director.
* Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Coordination (Pre\-Contract Tracks)
* Design \& Procurement Tracking: Establish, manage, and continuously update comprehensive trackers and dashboards for pre\-construction activities, with a strong focus on design development, authority approvals, procurement milestones, and package award schedules.
* Internal Stakeholder Interface: Coordinate directly with Development Managers, Design Directors, and Procurement leads to resolve scheduling conflicts and ensure pre\-contract deliverables align with planned construction commencement dates.
* Master Program Development: Support the Project Controls Director in developing, maintaining, and logic\-linking portfolio\-level master programs that integrate design, permitting, tendering, procurement, and construction activities.
* Executive Analytics \& C\-Suite Presentations
* Dashboard Management: Maintain and oversee the department’s live Power BI and ERP\-based dashboards, transforming complex project, commercial, and schedule data into meaningful performance indicators and executive\-level insights.
* Executive Presentation Development: Consolidate portfolio\-wide progress updates, schedule risks, delay exposures, and cost\-related insights into professional, structured presentations and briefing materials for the CDO, CFO, CEO, and Executive Leadership Team.
* Special Briefings \& Ad\-Hoc Analytics: Act as an operational extension of the Project Controls Director by conducting deep\-dive analyses, forensic schedule reviews, and focused data audits on critical or distressed project packages as required.
* Site\-HO Bridging \& Compliance Enforcement
* Site Coordination: Maintain close engagement with embedded site planning teams, consultants, and contractors to ensure real\-time visibility of progress, risks, and emerging critical path delays.
* Process Enforcement: Audit planning and reporting compliance across all projects, ensuring schedule networks, baseline updates, milestone reporting, and delay notifications adhere strictly to Arada’s Project Controls Manual and governance requirements.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* PMP or PMI\-SP (Scheduling Professional) certifications are highly advantageous.


**Experience**
* 7–10 years of progressive project planning and scheduling experience within the UAE real estate, developer, or construction sector.
* A balanced background is essential, including:
+ Minimum 3–4 years of hands\-on site\-based construction planning and execution experience.
+ Minimum 3–4 years within a Head Office PMO, Project Controls, or Developer corporate environment.

* Proven experience supporting multiple projects simultaneously and coordinating across diverse stakeholder groups.


**Technical Skills**
* Advanced to expert\-level proficiency in Primavera P6\.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel reporting and analytical capabilities.
* Strong Power BI dashboard development and data visualization skills.
* Advanced PowerPoint presentation design with the ability to prepare executive\-level reporting materials.
* Strong understanding of project controls methodologies, schedule governance, and portfolio reporting frameworks.


**Core Competency**
* Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and organizational agility.
* Ability to confidently engage with senior leadership while maintaining strong technical credibility with consultants, contractors, and project teams.
* Strong analytical mindset with the capability to challenge assumptions, identify reporting inconsistencies, and provide data\-driven recommendations.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and capable of operating effectively in a fast\-paced, multi\-project environment.

**Job Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE
   

  

 Whiteshield is a global policy advisory and AI economics firm known for our ability to respond to global challenges rapidly and incisively. We use the most advanced tools and technology and combine them with our team of leading international experts to engage decision\-makers in tackling society's most significant challenges. We are recognized for our rapid decision support, innovation, data science algorithms and deep policy expertise. We are specialists in "connecting the dots" between policy, business and technology.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced and driven
 **Digital Delivery Manager** 
 to join Whiteshield to become an integral part of our delivery organization. This role will be instrumental in establishing governance frameworks and driving excellence across our complex digital and policy initiatives. This Digital Delivery Manager should have very strong experience in project and program management, ideally with deep expertise in Agile methodologies and digital product delivery to complement our technical and policy teams.
   

  

 This is a role with a lot of responsibility and the potential to make a true impact \- on our delivery capability, within the business, and on government across the globe. We look for entrepreneurial people that want to make their mark on the world, and we empower and reward our staff accordingly. There is a lot of room for creativity and big ideas that shift the status quo. We are constantly delivering large new features and complex initiatives.
   

  

 You will report to our Principals and Partners working across all of our cross\-functional delivery teams, closely collaborating with product managers, developers, UI/UX designers, data scientists, business analysts, and QA teams.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 Entrepreneurial and ambitious, with your own perspective and ideas, and with an eagerness to contribute to the success of the organization's delivery excellence.
   

  

 Highly independent and self\-motivated, with strong leadership skills and a get\-things\-done attitude to deliver results.
   

  

 Passion for the public good and eagerness to make a societal impact with their work, ideally with a particular interest in economic development, workforce development, and education.
   

  

 Highly organized and eager to push the boundary on delivery excellence and really rethink traditional project management approaches.
   

  

 Eager to work in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment that challenges you to excel.
   

  

 Detail\-oriented with high standards for quality and governance.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**End\-to\-End Project Leadership:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end planning, execution, and closure of complex digital and policy projects from inception through delivery.
   

  

**PMO Governance:** 
 Establish and enforce PMO governance, delivery standards, and reporting frameworks across all projects to ensure consistency and quality.
   

  

**Cross\-Functional Coordination:** 
 Coordinate and drive cross\-functional delivery teams including product, data science, data engineering, AI and BI development to achieve project objectives.
   

  

**Stakeholder Interface:** 
 Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, executive leadership, and technical teams to ensure alignment and transparency.
   

  

**Product Delivery Oversight:** 
 Govern the design, development, validation, and deployment of digital products to ensure they meet quality standards and business requirements.
   

  

**Analytics \& Reporting:** 
 Ensure effective visualization and consumption of insights through Live Jira dashboards and related analytics platforms for real\-time project visibility.
   

  

**Toolset Management:** 
 Manage project delivery using Jira, Confluence and Azure\-based toolsets, ensuring transparency, traceability, and control across all initiatives.
   

  

**Risk \& Issue Management:** 
 Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, issues, and dependencies to keep projects on track.
   

  

**Scope \& Schedule Control:** 
 Monitor and control scope, schedule, and benefits realization across concurrent initiatives to ensure successful outcomes.
   

  

**Quality Assurance:** 
 Ensure quality and consistency of deliverables through formal reviews and adherence to Whiteshield standards.
   

  

**Executive Reporting:** 
 Provide clear, concise, and regular status reporting to senior stakeholders and steering committees.
   

  

**Resource Optimization:** 
 Optimize resource planning, capacity management, and prioritization across multiple workstreams to maximize efficiency.
   

  

**Requirements**
* Exceptional analytical, critical thinking, and problem\-solving skills
* Multiple years of experience in project/program management and PMO leadership, preferably in a dynamic, high\-growth and highly innovative environment
* Proven successful experience in delivering complex digital products and technology initiatives from scratch
* Proficiency with relevant tooling (such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, and analytics platforms)
* Professional certifications such as PMP, PMI\-ACP, PRINCE2, or Agile certifications (Scrum Master, SAFe, etc.)
* Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, and hybrid delivery methodologies with experience adapting frameworks to organizational needs
* Experience with data\-driven decision making and building dashboards/reporting frameworks for executive visibility
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to multitask and resilience to meet deadlines and manage stressful situations
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills and experience with stakeholder management at all levels


**Benefits**
**Inclusive by Design**
 At Whiteshield, we champion equal opportunities \- not just in principle, but in practice. We believe the best ideas grow in spaces where every voice is respected, and every background adds value. Our inclusive culture empowers all team members to bring their whole selves to work, knowing their perspectives are welcomed and their contributions matter.
   

  

**Celebrate the Climb**
 We don't just notice high performance \- we reward it. Whether it's through career advancement or peer recognition, we celebrate those who push boundaries and raise the bar. Your growth is our priority.
   

  

**Flexible, Human\-Centered Work**
 We understand that ambition and wellbeing go hand in hand. That's why we offer flexible working models and a culture that values balance, autonomy, and trust. Whether you're recharging or reaching new heights, we want you to thrive \- both inside and outside the office.
   

  

**Impact with Purpose**
 At Whiteshield, your work drives real change. From shaping national labour strategies to advising global climate policy, we work on challenges that matter. For professionals who want their career to stand for something, this is your platform to make it count.
   

  

**Global Mindset**
 Join an international network of economists, data scientists, policy advisors, and strategists \- all collaborating across borders with a shared mission. Expect sharp minds, open conversations, and a genuine team spirit.

data.jd_text:
Eaton’s ES EMEA CPS division is currently seeking a Program Manager Direct Current for Data Center (DC for DC) EMEA.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The DC for DC EMEA Program Manager is responsible for orchestrating and governing Eaton’s end to end data center electrical solution portfolio for hyperscale and colocation customers across EMEA. This role ensures that product development, system architectures, and customer engagement activities across multiple Eaton divisions are aligned into a coherent, competitive, and execution ready offering.
   

  

 Operating as a senior, technical program leader with strong systems engineering credibility, the Program Manager leads through influence across R\&D, product management, engineering, and commercial teams. The role owns program execution from concept through launch, ensuring on schedule and on budget delivery, structured customer engagement at each development milestone, and rapid identification and resolution of technical or organizational gaps.
   

  

 This is a newly created, strategic role reporting directly to the VP/GM, with a mandate to strengthen Eaton’s position with hyperscalers and colocation customers by driving integrated solutions rather than disconnected products.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**DC for DC EMEA Program Leadership:**
* Establish and lead the DC for DC EMEA program covering Eaton’s full data center power value chain, including MVSST, 800VDC Switchboard, DC Remote Power Panel, Solid State Breakers, BESS, Busway, digital power management, and related software and services.
* Define clear program governance, milestones, success criteria, and escalation mechanisms across participating divisions.
* Ensure the program is executed on schedule and within approved budgets, with disciplined tracking of progress, risks, and dependencies.


**Cross Division Product \& Technology Alignment**
* Coordinate new product development roadmaps across multiple Eaton divisions to ensure architectural coherence and compatibility for hyperscale and colocation data center applications.
* Work closely with divisional R\&D, power systems engineering, and product management teams to align technical assumptions, interfaces, and performance targets.
* Identify portfolio gaps, overlaps, or misalignments impacting customer requirements and drive resolution through structured action plans and executive escalation where required.


**Customer Engagement \& External Alignment**
* Ensure structured and continuous customer engagement throughout the product and solution development lifecycle, including concept validation, architecture reviews, pilot phases, and launch readiness.
* Act as a senior technical interface for hyperscale and colocation customers in EMEA, ensuring customer feedback is systematically captured and translated into product and program actions.
* Coordinate with regional teams in APAC and the Americas to align customer learnings, program progress, and best practices globally.


**Program Execution, Visibility \& Issue Resolution**
* Consolidate inputs from divisions into clear program dashboards, executive summaries, and decision materials for senior leadership.
* Proactively identify technical, organizational, or execution risks and lead cross functional teams to resolve issues before customer or market impact.
* Drive disciplined follow up on actions, ensuring accountability and closure across divisional stakeholders.


**Strategic Contribution \& Continuous Improvement**
* Contribute to Eaton’s long term data center strategy by providing insights from customer engagements, competitive dynamics, and technology trends.
* Support continuous improvement of Eaton’s data center go to market model by strengthening integration between product, engineering, and customer facing teams.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Power Systems Engineering; Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum 10–15 years of experience in power systems, electrical infrastructure, or data center technology environments.
* Proven experience working with hyperscale and/or colocation data center customers.
* Prior experience in R\&D, advanced engineering, systems engineering, or complex technical program leadership roles.


**Skills**
* Strong understanding of data center electrical architectures, including MV and LV distribution, ACBs, UPS systems, energy storage, busway, and redundancy concepts.
* Ability to ensure system level technical coherence through collaboration with divisional experts rather than hands on detailed design ownership.
* Credibility based leadership and the ability to lead through influence in a matrix organization.
* Strong program management discipline and executive communication skills.
* Ability to operate confidently with senior internal leaders and demanding external customers.
* Structured, action oriented mindset with a strong bias toward execution and issue resolution.
* Excellent written and spoken English.


 All positions may require participation in video and in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job\-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.
   

  

 We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for job applicants and employees. Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, colour, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law.

data.jd_text:
**About The Role**
 Müller's Solutions is looking for a senior, hands\-on Project Manager to lead the delivery of a SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition implementation for a major trading group based in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. You will take full ownership of a multi\-legal\-entity Finance and Supply Chain transformation — from Fit\-to\-Standard workshops through go\-live and hypercare — working at the intersection of our client's leadership and a hybrid onsite/offshore delivery team.
   

  

 This is a high\-visibility role within our Middle East practice. You will report directly to the Managing Director and act as the single point of accountability for scope, schedule, budget, and client satisfaction throughout the engagement.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
 — End\-to\-end delivery of the S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition program using SAP ACTIVATE methodology, from Prepare through Run.
   

  

 — A delivery team spanning Finance, Supply Chain, Integration, Data Migration, and Training — coordinating onsite and offshore workstreams as one team.
   

  

 — The project plan, RAID log, budget tracking, and resourcing decisions across all phases.
   

  

 — Executive\-level reporting and steering committee facilitation with client leadership across 4 legal entities.
   

  

 — Scope governance and change request management, protecting both project quality and commercial margin.
   

  

 — Cutover planning, go\-live readiness, and hypercare oversight — ensuring the client lands the system successfully.
   

  

 — Coordination of ZATCA Phase 2 compliance milestones with the Finance workstream lead.
   

  

**Requirements**
 — 8\+ years of SAP project management experience, with full lifecycle accountability.
   

  

 — A minimum of 3 completed SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition go\-lives as lead Project Manager.
   

  

 — SAP ACTIVATE methodology certification.
   

  

 — Demonstrated experience managing multi\-legal\-entity SAP deployments within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 — Confident, polished stakeholder management with C\-level and finance leadership in Arabic\-speaking business environments.
   

  

 — A track record of holding scope, budget, and timeline discipline on fixed\-price or milestone\-based engagements.
   

  

**Preferred**
 — PMP or PRINCE2 certification.
   

  

 — Prior experience in trading, distribution, or manufacturing client environments.
   

  

 — Familiarity with SAP Integration Suite and BTP\-based integration landscapes.
   

  

**Benefits**
 — Work on flagship Cloud ERP transformations for some of the region's most respected enterprises, backed by a multi\-vendor partner ecosystem spanning SAP, ServiceNow, OpenText, BMC, Boomi, and Red Hat.
   

  

 — A Berlin\-headquartered firm with genuine regional depth — offices in Riyadh, Dubai, Cairo, and Casablanca, and an offshore delivery model that lets you focus on what matters most: the client.
   

  

 — Direct visibility and access to senior leadership — your impact on client outcomes is seen and valued, not buried in a large delivery hierarchy.
   

  

 — A culture that rewards ownership: you scope it, you lead it, you're credited for it.

data.jd_text:
As the Project Manager, you will lead the planning, coordination, and execution of Earth Hotels' development projects from concept through delivery.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role for someone who can balance strategic oversight with day\-to\-day coordination. You will drive progress across multiple workstreams, align internal and external stakeholders, proactively solve problems, and ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in line with Earth's design vision and quality standards.
   

  

 As part of a lean and growing team, you will also support coordination activities typically associated with a Project Coordinator, stepping into the detail when required to keep projects moving.
   

  

**What on Earth Will You Do?**
* Lead the day\-to\-day management of assigned projects across all phases of delivery.
* Develop, maintain, and monitor project programmes, milestones, and critical paths.
* Coordinate internal stakeholders, consultants, contractors, and suppliers to ensure timely execution.
* Identify project risks, constraints, and dependencies, implementing mitigation plans where required.
* Monitor progress against approved timelines and proactively drive recovery actions when necessary.
* Ensure projects transition smoothly between design, procurement, construction, and operational handover phases.
* Support the coordination and review of design deliverables throughout all project stages.
* Facilitate design workshops, meetings, and stakeholder reviews to support decision\-making.
* Monitor design development to ensure alignment with approved briefs, budgets, and operational requirements.
* Track design approvals and ensure timely resolution of outstanding issues.
* Support quality assurance throughout construction and fit\-out activities.
* Monitor project budgets and expenditure against approved cost plans.
* Track procurement activities, supplier deliverables, and key commercial commitments.
* Review variations, change requests, and potential cost implications with relevant stakeholders.
* Escalate financial risks and support cost\-control initiatives throughout the project lifecycle.
* Prepare project reports, dashboards, meeting minutes, and status updates for leadership.
* Ensure clear communication and transparency across all project stakeholders.
* Coordinate project meetings and follow up on actions to completion.
* Provide accurate reporting on progress, risks, budget status, and delivery performance.
* Ensure leadership teams are informed early of any issues that may impact project outcomes.
* Maintain project documentation, trackers, registers, and filing systems.
* Coordinate consultant appointments, submissions, approvals, and document control activities.
* Support logistics, scheduling, and follow\-up activities required to keep projects progressing efficiently.
* Take ownership of both project management and coordination responsibilities as required by the business.
* Ensure projects comply with applicable health, safety, regulatory, and company requirements.
* Promote safe working practices across all project activities.
* Ensure delivery standards align with Earth Hotels' quality expectations and brand aspirations.


**What We're Looking For**
* Previous experience in project management within hospitality, construction, design, real estate, or related sectors.
* Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and competing priorities simultaneously.
* Strong organizational, planning, and coordination skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Experience monitoring programmes, budgets, and project deliverables.
* Confident communicator with the ability to influence and build strong working relationships.
* Comfortable operating in a lean environment and taking a hands\-on approach.
* Proactive, solutions\-oriented, and calm under pressure.
* Experience within hotel developments or hospitality projects is highly desirable.

**Success Profile**

 Project Leadership \& Planning

* Ensure compliance with local authority regulations, health and safety requirements, and sustainability objectives.



  





 Design \& Consultant Management

* Support the review of design documentation to ensure alignment with project brief, budget, and operational requirements.
* Facilitate design workshops and value engineering exercises.



  





 Procurement \& Contract Administration
 


* Support tendering and appointment of consultants, contractors, and suppliers.
* Review and recommend procurement strategies suitable for luxury hospitality and residential developments.
* Administer contracts in coordination with commercial and legal teams, ensuring compliance and fair execution.



  





 Construction \& Site Management
 


* Monitor construction progress, quality standards, and adherence to design intent.
* Conduct regular site inspections and progress meetings.
* Manage contractor performance and ensure timely resolution of technical and contractual issues.



  





 Stakeholder \& Client Interface
 


* Act as the principal client representative for all project\-related matters.
* Prepare and deliver regular project reports, presentations, and dashboards to senior management.
* Manage stakeholder expectations, ensuring alignment with project vision, cost, and delivery targets.

The Opportunity
   

  

 Responsible for directing Professional and Continuing Education (PaCE) activities, including strategic planning, development, and execution of PaCE programmes, business development, training catalog oversight, and stakeholder engagement, to ensure alignment with market demand, client expectations, and the University’s policies and procedures.
   

  

 The Responsibilities
   

  

 Strategic \& Financial
   

  

* Lead the development and monitor the execution of the Department's strategy and align with ZU's strategic objectives, ensuring effective and efficient achievement of departmental operations.
* Oversee the Department’s performance through defined KPIs and targets, and continuously identify and recommend improvements to support the realisation of ZU's strategy.
* Direct the allocation of budget across the Department and ensure full adherence to approved plans and rectify any deviations in a timely manner.
* Provide the relevant organisational unit with consolidated budget input as required, ensuring that the Department’s requirements are appropriately addressed in the overall budget planning process.


 Operational
   

  

* Lead the development and execution of business development strategies to expand B2B and B2C professional training services in line with University’s objectives.
* Lead the establishment of strategic partnerships with industry, government, and community stakeholders to generate revenue, expand reach, and ensure programme sustainability.
* Lead the development of tailored proposals and promotional strategies to position PaCE as a leading provider.
* Direct the development, planning, and internal coordination of full\-scale and customised training programmes to ensure strategic alignment, resource optimisation, and successful delivery of the same.

* Lead the engagement with external subject\-matter experts to maintain high\-quality content development and delivery across all training programmes.
* Lead the development and maintenance of a centralised training catalog and digital infrastructure, including LMS platforms, to ensure seamless access to current and upcoming training offerings.
* Direct institutional compliance by ensuring documentation, reporting, and quality assurance mechanisms across all PaCE training activities.
* Direct institutional initiatives that promote faculty and student participation in entrepreneurial training, venture creation, and business incubation programmes offered by the PaCE department.
* Perform ad\-hoc activities related to the job duties, as requested by the direct supervisor.


 People Management
   

  

* Review consolidated workforce planning reports, talent acquisition strategies, and budgets at the Department level to ensure adequate staffing for optimal operational smoothness, and submit to the appropriate authority for final approval.
* Set performance management objectives for all reportees and perform mid\-year and year\-end performance reviews.
* Identify talent for pivotal roles from a succession management standpoint to ensure business continuity.
* Provide guidance to reporting managers on people management matters.
* Manage organisational units within the Department and ensure effective leadership to adequately manage human capital.


 The Requirements
   

  

* Master's Degree with a minimum of 15 years of experience and at least 10 years in a managerial position.
* Certification in a relevant field is preferred.

 The University’s benefits package is highly attractive, with competitive tax\-free salaries in the U.A.E., cash housing, annual vacation airline tickets for the employee and immediate family, educational subsidies for children, and healthcare for the employee and sponsored family members.

 While we appreciate all applications, you will be contacted only if selected for an interview.
   

  

 For any further inquiries, please contact Recruitment@zu.ac.ae

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 Amazon is looking for a motivated individual for the profile of ACES (Amazon Customer Excellence Systems) Program Manager for its AMET operations team. The candidate should enjoy getting their hands dirty, and looking around the corners for solutions with the aim of optimization of OTR operations in Amazon’s last mile delivery stations.
   

  

 As an ACES (Amazon Customer Excellence Systems) program manager, you will be the subject matter expert for UTR and OTR operations driving capacity enhancements and utilization improvements in both.
   

  

 You will be a subject matter expert on routing and sortation operations and accountable for RUBL60 and sort grid utilization metrics. You should be able to think big to solve complex problems with simple and practical solutions by developing a deep knowledge of the operation processes.
   

  

 This role calls for an individual who can own all aspects of how transportation impacts customer experience, shipper experience and operator experience; monitor metrics, determine, then drive any initiatives necessary to improve it. It requires an individual to showcase judgement and decision\-making skills to balance customer experience with financial impact. This position offers a broad exposure to various business, financial, and technical teams within Amazon.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be a person who enjoys and excels at dealing with ambiguity and design and define products/programs with little information. He / She will have excellent written and verbal communication skills, the ability to create and sustain urgency, and a proven ability to lead cross\-functional projects including communication across all levels and teams in the organization: senior leaders, technical teams, finance, business, and operations leaders.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As UTR and OTR capacity SME, you will responsible for:
   

  

* Driving (accountable) RUBL60 and Sort Grid utilization metrics across MEATR region.
* Invent solutions to solve complex business problems.
* Provide corresponding tools to support Central Ops.
* Build mechanisms and monitor RUBL60 and Bag utilization metrics on a daily basis. Identify root causes and corrective/preventive actions for misses.
* Discuss trends and unusual behaviors of the RUBL60 and bag utilization metric.
* Provide sustainable solutions and effective guidance across the organization.
* Leverage route planning metrics to define, characterize areas of improvement.
* Collaborate with Tech/Science teams to enhance route planning systems.
* Aim to produce routes that are efficient and maximize the time utilization without impacting drivers' workload.
* Influence Route Planning teams to build models that generate fair, sustainable, and efficient delivery routes.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**Job Description**
 The Head of School – Computing is a key academic and administrative leadership position at TAG\-ME, Curtin University Dubai. The role involves overseeing the development, implementation, and management of the School of Computing, ensuring alignment with Curtin’s global academic standards and institutional goals. The Head of School will work closely with the Director Learning and Teaching at Curtin University Dubai, faculty members, professional staff, Curtin University Perth and students to foster a collaborative and high‑quality learning environment while supporting the growth of computing programs at Curtin Dubai.
   

  

**Leadership and School Ownership**
* Provide overall leadership of the School of Computing. Take ownership of the school’s academic performance, strategic direction, growth, and market positioning, in line with Curtin Dubai’s objectives and strategy.
* Develop and implement a 3\-5 year roadmap for the school covering enrolment growth, program development, research, student outcomes, and industry engagement.
* Work closely with the Pro Vice\-Chancellor \& President, Director – Learning and Teaching, other Heads of School, professional services teams, and Curtin Perth faculty leadership to support institutional and school priorities.
* Build effective working relationships with Curtin Perth Faculty leadership, Heads of School, Deans, Unit Coordinators, and other academic staff.
* Identify emerging and high\-demand areas such as Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Data Science, Digital Transformation, and related fields to strengthen the School’s program portfolio.
* Support the expansion of postgraduate programs, micro\-credentials, executive education, and other industry\-aligned offerings.
* Be accountable for the School’s overall performance, including enrolment growth, academic quality, student satisfaction, progression, retention, graduate outcomes, and industry relevance.


**School and Program Management**
* Oversee the day\-to\-day academic and administrative operations of the School of Computing.
* Liaise closely with Curtin Perth on operational matters, program delivery, unit coordination, curriculum, academic governance, and quality assurance.
* Manage faculty, including teaching allocations, workload planning, and effective program delivery across the School.
* Coordinate curriculum structures, course offerings, units, and academic schedules in consultation with Curtin Perth and relevant internal stakeholders.
* Ensure all programs meet accreditation, regulatory, and quality assurance requirements, and participate in related activities as required.
* Conduct program reviews, evaluations, and performance analysis to identify improvements and support continuous enhancement.
* Monitor the overall health, performance, and sustainability of programs, including enrolments, progression, resourcing, and student outcomes.
* Identify academic, operational, regulatory, and reputational risks affecting the School, and implement appropriate mitigation measures.


**Academic Leadership**
* Lead the delivery and continuous improvement of programs within the School of Computing.
* Develop, implement, and monitor School\-level academic procedures and operating practices in line with Curtin and local regulatory requirements.
* Provide leadership in academic delivery, academic quality, and term\-by\-term readiness.
* Ensure the school maintains a high standard of academic quality in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies, and external or professional accreditations.
* Participate in curriculum review and academic planning before each study period in collaboration with Curtin Perth and internal stakeholders.
* Lead the School resource planning, including staffing, laboratories, equipment, and other academic infrastructure needed in collaboration with other stakeholders to support growth and quality delivery.
* Mentor and support faculty in their teaching, research and scholarly activities, while actively supporting their continuous professional development and career progression.
* Strategically manage School resources and departmental staff to meet and/or align with school, campus, and university\-wide strategic objectives.
* Facilitate School meetings, academic discussions, and collaborative initiatives that support alignment, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Foster a culture of academic excellence, collegiality, innovation, accountability, and student\-centred practice.


**Teaching and Learning**
* Deliver lectures, tutorials, practical sessions, workshops, seminars, demonstrations, and laboratory classes in the relevant subject area.
* Administer and assess examinations, quizzes, assignments, projects, laboratory work, and other assessment tasks in line with approved academic requirements.
* Provide constructive and timely feedback to support student learning and progression.
* Maintain regular consultation hours and provide academic guidance, mentoring, and support to students.
* Contribute to improvements in teaching quality, the learning experience, assessment practice, and academic support within the School.
* Oversee and support faculty in the implementation of high\-quality teaching practices and the effective management of unit\-level administrative requirements.


**Student Support, Success, and Employability**
* Provide academic advising, mentoring, and guidance to students across the student lifecycle.
* Address student concerns appropriately, support academic success and engagement, and refer wellbeing matters where needed.
* Develop and support initiatives to improve student engagement, retention, progression, and the overall student experience.
* Coordinate and promote internships, industry placements, capstone projects, applied learning opportunities, guest lectures, seminars, workshops, competitions, and other experiential learning activities.
* Support strategies that strengthen student employability, career readiness, and graduate outcomes.
* Encourage a strong School identity and student community through academic, professional, and co\-curricular engagement.


**Research and Scholarly Activities**
* Maintain an active research and scholarly agenda relevant to the role and discipline.
* Promote research collaboration across Curtin Dubai, Curtin Perth, and external academic and industry partners.
* Encourage interdisciplinary and applied research, funded projects, industry\-supported initiatives, and scholarly outputs that strengthen the School’s profile and impact.
* Support the development of a strong research culture within the School, including mentoring faculty in research and scholarly development.


**Industry Engagement, Marketing, Growth, and Outreach**
* Cultivate a culture of innovation and industry engagement, driving the integration of work\-integrated learning and professional connectivity across the School’s programs and activities.
* Develop and maintain partnerships with technology companies, start\-ups, innovation hubs, professional bodies, community organisations, government stakeholders, and academic institutions.
* Strengthen industry engagement through internships, advisory boards, applied projects, certifications, guest speakers, research partnerships, and employer collaboration.
* Work with Marketing, Recruitment, Admissions, and Student Services to support recruitment, conversion, retention, and growth across the School’s programs.
* Contribute to School growth strategies, including outreach initiatives, lead generation activities, enrolment campaigns, and new market opportunities.
* Represent the School and Curtin Dubai at open days, school visits, webinars, exhibitions, industry events, and corporate meetings.
* Act as an academic ambassador for the School with prospective students, parents, schools, agents, alumni, employers, regulators, and other stakeholders.
* Support the development of promotional content, thought leadership, market\-facing academic messaging, and other initiatives that strengthen the School’s reputation and visibility.
