data.jd_text:
**Project Overview** 




 The Taweelah C Project is a landmark greenfield development in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi, representing one of the region's most advanced and efficient combined cycle gas turbine (CCGT) power plants. With an installed capacity of approximately 2\.6 GW, the project will play a critical role in supporting the UAE's growing electricity demand while delivering high efficiency and lower emissions through state\-of\-the\-art technology.
 



 The project brings together leading international partners with Al Jomaih Energy and Water Co. Ltd. (AEW) and Sembcorp Utilities Pte. Ltd. (Sembcorp) together with TAQA acting as the Project Company
 



 Taweelah C offers a unique opportunity to be part of a high\-profile infrastructure project that will set new benchmarks in performance, reliability, and sustainability in the region's power sector.
   





**Location:** 
 Taweelah, Abu Dhabi, UAE (Site is 30 to 40 Kms from Abu Dhabi city)
 



**Duration:** 
 2\.5 years
   





**Job Overview** 




 To lead and oversee all construction activities for the Taweelah C Power Project. Ensuring the timely, on\-budget, and quality delivery of the asset, meeting contractual requirements, and design specifications for reliable and sustainable operation over the Power Purchase Agreement period.
 



 Implementing the HSSE program and supervision in the Project Company and Owner's team, fostering a culture of health, safety, security, and environment in alignment with Project Company and Stakeholder targets.
 



 Monitoring, coordinating, and reporting on multiple Contractors' activities at the site, challenging and negotiating with the EPC contractor when necessary to protect the Project Company's interests.
 



 Leading a highly skilled team and directing the Owner's Engineer to ensure seamless construction with highest levels of HSSE within the necessary quality, time and budget.
 



 Facilitating seamless communication and information exchanges among stakeholders, including project partners, local communities, and external parties.
   

  




**Requirements**

**Your Job Functions (Duties \& Responsibilities)** 



* Oversee plant construction to ensure compliance with quality, schedule, and budget agreements.
* Manage HSSE implementation onsite and offsite, maintaining a strong HSSE culture.
* Coordinate activities of the Owner's Engineer, local contractors, local authorities and interface partners and Contractors.
* Monitor and enforce EPC Contractor's compliance with EPC Contract, Owner's requirements and International Standards
* Act as the primary link between the off\-taker, Owner's Engineer, EPC Contractor, third party, the Operator, \-\-etc to align battery limits and tie\-ins.
* Align technical and schedule interfaces between different contractors, ensuring contract conformity and project needs.
* Monitor Engineering \& Procurement, QA/QC and OE ensuring the EPC Contractor issuing the engineering packages and deliver procurement items ahead of construction needs.
* Organize and lead construction and progress management meetings with all stakeholders.
* Identify, assess, and escalate technical deviations, construction risks, and non\-conformities to the Project Company EMD, proposing effective mitigation and recovery measures.
* Manage contractual, commercial, and technical matters arising under the EPC Contract and WTA, in coordination with legal and commercial teams.
* Review, evaluate, and provide recommendations on change orders, variations, and claims submitted by contractors and service providers.
* Lead resolution meetings for technical and construction issues encountered on\-site and off\-site during execution.
* Lead QA/QC oversight and manage the SPV engineering teams including the Owner's Engineer  to witness, verify, and document key inspections and tests in accordance with the approved Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) and project requirements.
* Lead risk assessment and risk identification workshops with the EPC Contractor and Owner's Engineer, ensuring all project risks are identified, formally recorded in the risk register periodically, and supported by clear mitigation and action plans.
* Interact with Sponsors, Lender's Engineer, Insurance Advisers, and O\&M teams.
* Issue progress reports and technical memoranda as required.
* Supervise milestone completion certificates, invoices, and mechanical completion certificates.
* Lead/participate as required in technical review committees as they may be defined during the construction period with sponsors.
* Facilitate the handover of the Project to the O\&M Team.
* Host visitors at the site and manage communications with stakeholders.



**Contractual/Commercial** 



* Timely reporting of contractual/commercial variances and proposing mitigation or alternative solutions.
* Assist in writing contractual letters to stakeholders.
* Identify and anticipate deliverables to relevant parties.
* Coordinate progress of commissioning and testing with Off\-taker and Dispatch Control Centre.
* Assist in claims management with Contractors and Service Providers.



**Qualifications \& Skill Sets** 



* University Degree in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or Chemical Engineering.
* Additional qualifications (project management/Construction Management) are preferred
* 15 \+years of project and site experience in large scale power projects, some in CCGT projects.
* Extensive knowledge of utilities and construction of Combined Cycle Power Plants.
* Experience in large infrastructure project execution.
* Experience with Turnkey EPC contractors. (with Chinese EPC contractor preferred)
* Strong technical knowledge and understanding of construction processes, contracts, and international standards.
* Contract/claim management and negotiation skills.
* Familiarity with BOO project structures, project finance documents, EPC contracts, PPAs.
* Excellent communication and reporting skills.
* Ability to work independently and lead teams.
* Strong ethical standards.

data.jd_text:
**Role:** 




 An Associate Director in Financial Crime Risk in Supervision is responsible for executing the Financial Crime Risk Team’s work plan. The Associate Director must ensure that a risk based, proportionate and efficient approach is maintained towards all the team’s supervisory activities.
 



  





 An Associate Director is expected to oversee assigned regulatory projects related to financial crime risk and relevant business model within the team, across the Supervision Department and the DFSA, as well as supporting on related policy work.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 The Associate Director is expected to devote the majority of his/her time towards managerial and operational level tasks, as well as support policy development. The Associate Director will assist the Director and contribute to the work of the team with the following key responsibilities:
 



  






 Technical Guidance
 



* Act as a technical expert in respective risk area and provide internal trainings as needed.
* Provide guidance to the team in all aspects of financial crime risk for regulated entities in order to ensure delivery of effective and efficient risk\-based supervision.
* Support DFSA Divisions by providing guidance in all aspects of financial crime risk in line with the DFSA’s objectives.
* Monitor developments in relevant international and regional regulatory standards and in the financial services industry and provide inputs and updates.



  






 Strategy Formulation, Implementation, Planning and Projects
 




  




* Contribute to DFSA\-wide and Supervision Division\-wide strategic direction, business planning and policy formation. Ensure effective cascading of approved strategy, business plans and policies into the day\-to\-day management of the team.
* Participate in the development and implementation of supervision strategy for the team, consistent with the DFSA\-wide goals and objectives.
* Ensure DFSA\-wide projects as captured in the Business Plan relevant to the AD are completed effectively, on\-time and within budget.
* Be expected to devote a considerable level of time toward managerial, policy, outreach and other assigned projects.



  






 People Management
 



* Manage and support the effective achievement of the objectives of respective areas of focus through setting individual objectives, managing performance, developing and motivating staff, provision of formal and informal feedback and appraisal in order to maximize subordinate and the overall performance.
* Ensure the key performance indicators, performance reviews, leave approvals and timesheets are completed in an accurate and timely manner for self and team members.
* Support the professional development programs of the DFSA through program development, delivery and participation. Support and contribute to the DFSA graduates training program.
* When requested, effectively lead the team in the absence of the Director.



  





**Educational Background** 



* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Business, Finance, Accounting, Risk Management or Economics. A post graduate degree in similar fields would be considered as an advantage.
* Evidence of continuing professional education relevant to target position.
* Professional qualifications in finance, risk management, quantitative analysis, etc. such as ACAMS, CFA, FRM, PRM, etc. would be considered as a plus.



  





**Professional Experience** 



* 10\+ years of regulatory, compliance or risk management experience required in a broadly equivalent financial services regulator and/or a regulated entity, with a minimum of 2 years in managerial/ supervisory roles in one or more of these functions being desirable. Managerial roles might include project leadership / management roles or equivalent with a demonstrated ability to mentor and motivate staff.
* Experience in dealing with financial services regulators, standard setters and members of Board of Directors and senior executives.
* Preferably experience in the development and implementation of regulatory standards and policy analysis.
* Experience of country self\-assessments against the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) 40 recommendations; national risk assessments pursuant to FATF Recommendation 1; and involvement with a FATF country mutual evaluation would be considered an advantage.



  





**Knowledge, Skills \& Attributes** 



* Strong and up to date knowledge and technical expertise in dealing with financial services regulations and relevant international standard setters.
* Robust understanding of the responsibilities/role of the regulator and of what it means to be a risk\-based regulator.
* An in\-depth knowledge of the financial services industry and its unique characteristics with proven technical knowledge and understanding of the key risks in the sector.
* Deep understanding of current and emerging risk management trends/issues.
* Appreciation of the unique features of the regulatory regime in the DIFC and understanding of the nature of the financial service activities offered by Authorised Firms operating in the DIFC.
* Strategic vision, strong analytical thinking and creativity; capacity to clearly articulate options and trade\-offs and ability to apply judgment.
* Influential skills and ability to lead meetings and deliver difficult messages, when necessary.
* Excellent people leadership, planning, organisation and time management skills embodied in a professional, diplomatic and ethical attitude.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with proven ability to address senior executives.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including ability to engage effectively and confidently with international counterparts.
* Capacity to deliver high quality work to demanding timescales.
* Be able to work flexibility, autonomously, and co\-operatively in a collaborative team environment.

**Job Description**
**About Moove**
 Moove is a global mobility fintech and operations company focused on transforming mobility through innovative fleet solutions, mobility, and next\-generation transportation technologies. As we expand our operations across the UAE and GCC region, we are looking for an experienced and highly driven Project Manager to support the launch and scaling of new mobility and automotive projects.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This role leads the planning, coordination, and execution of new mobility and automotive projects across the UAE. Working closely with internal teams, OEM partners, technology providers, and strategic stakeholders, the Program Manager drives initiatives from concept through commercial launch ensuring Moove’s expansion is delivered on time, at scale, and to the highest operational standard.
   

  

 The role requires strong project management expertise, stakeholder coordination, and a working understanding of the mobility ecosystem. The ideal candidate has 5–7 years of experience in project or program management, with a track record of delivering complex, cross\-functional initiatives in mobility, fleet, logistics, or adjacent sectors.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 The role exists to own end\-to\-end delivery of mobility projects across the UAE from initial scoping through pilot and into commercial launch. Success is measured by projects delivered on time, within budget, and at the quality standard required for Moove to scale its regional operations.
   

  

 Within the first 6 months, the role is expected to own at least one active project end\-to\-end, establish clear project governance and reporting cadence for the leadership team, and build the operational frameworks that enable future market launches to be faster and more repeatable.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities

* Develop detailed project plans, timelines, budgets, and execution frameworks for new market launches.
* Manage cross\-functional teams across Operations, Engineering, Compliance, Fleet, Safety, and Technology.
* Drive project execution from pilot phase through commercial launch, owning delivery outcomes end\-to\-end.
* Monitor project risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans; escalate issues proactively to senior leadership.
* Lead vendor management, OEM partner onboarding, and operational integration activities across GCC markets.

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 Amazon Now is building the future of ultra\-fast grocery delivery across the Middle East. We are looking for a Program Manager to drive measurable improvements across store capacity management, cost\-per\-order reduction, and delivery speed (Click\-to\-Door).
   

  

 This role sits within the Operations Excellence function and is responsible for identifying, scoping, and delivering high\-impact programmes that improve customer experience and unit economics across Amazon Now’s network in Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 You will work across Last Mile, Middle Mile, and Under\-The\-Roof (UTR) operations to find inefficiencies, build the business case, and drive cross\-functional execution. This is not a reactive role, you will proactively identify opportunities before they become problems, connect the dots across operational channels, and ensure every initiative ladders up to CX outcomes and P\&L impact.
   

  

 The right candidate is analytically sharp, comfortable with ambiguity, and operates with a bias for action. You think in systems, not silos. You’re as comfortable in the data as you are in a room with senior stakeholders making the case for change.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Store Capacity \& Cost Management
   

  

* Own programmes to optimise store capacity utilization, including bin density, ASIN rationalisation, gas tank management, and space allocation across darkstores.
* Drive cost\-per\-order reduction across the end\-to\-end operation: UTR pick efficiency, DA (Delivery Associate) productivity, hub\-to\-store transhipment costs, and middle mile truck utilisation.
* Analyse operational cost structures to identify the highest\-leverage opportunities for unit economics improvement. Build business cases with clear ROI and execution plans.
* Partner with UTR, Last Mile, and Middle Mile teams to implement changes that reduce waste, improve throughput, and lower cost\-to\-serve without degrading customer experience.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track capacity utilisation and cost metrics across KSA stores.


 Delivery Speed \& Click\-to\-Door (C2D)
   

  

* Own the programme roadmap for C2D reduction, identifying bottlenecks across order acceptance, pick \& pack, dispatch, and last mile delivery.
* Analyse delivery defects, early delivery marking, Did\-Not\-Receive (DNR) patterns, and other CX pain points to drive root cause resolution.
* Identify and eliminate handoff delays between UTR, Middle Mile, and Last Mile that contribute to C2D inflation.


 Project \& Programme Delivery
   

  

* Scope, plan, and execute operational improvement projects end\-to\-end, from opportunity identification through to measurable business impact.
* Build and manage a portfolio of initiatives across capacity, cost, and speed, with clear prioritisation based on CX and P\&L impact.
* Create mechanisms for project tracking, stakeholder communication, and escalation. Maintain a clear view of project status, risks, and dependencies.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment with ACES, Tech, Finance, Category, and operations teams to remove blockers and deliver on commitments.
* Contribute to the development of scalable solutions that can be replicated across KSA stores, solve once, scale everywhere.


 Cross\-Functional Influence \& Visibility
   

  

* Operate as the connective tissue between operational channels, ensuring improvements in one area don’t create problems in another.
* Build visibility into operational performance through data, dashboards, and regular reporting cadences (WBR/MBR contributions).
* Influence without authority, drive outcomes through data\-backed recommendations, clear communication, and stakeholder management.
* Support Automation \& AI initiatives that drive efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve decision\-making across operations.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Master's degree
* Experience in program requirements definition, together with data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

 Outcome: Prop Firm Match Global FZCO is fully compliant, in good standing, and audit\-ready at all times.
   

  

 Typical tasks:
   

  

* Maintain free\-zone licence, share capital, and corporate documentation up to date
* Ensure timely renewals, statutory filings, and entity\-level reporting
* Coordinate with the free\-zone authority on all governance matters
* Run quarterly governance reviews with the CFO


**Objective 2 \- Lead regulatory affairs and authority relationships**
 Outcome: PFM operates with regulatory clarity in the UAE and can navigate questions from authorities quickly and credibly.
   

  

 Typical tasks:
   

  

* Own the regulatory map for PFM's activities in the UAE (free\-zone, federal, financial\-services adjacencies)
* Build and maintain relationships with regulators, free\-zone authorities, banks, and key service providers
* Track regulatory changes affecting PFM and translate them into business impact and action items
* Lead any direct regulator engagement or audit on PFM's behalf, in coordination with legal counsel
* Partner with internal and external legal counsel on the UAE legal landscape — contracts, employment law, FZCO governance, commercial agreements, and dispute resolution


**Objective 3 \- Manage UAE operations: banking, tax, audit, and admin**
 Outcome: All UAE\-side operational rails (banking, corporate tax, VAT, audit, visas, office, vendors) run smoothly with no surprises.
   

  

 Typical tasks:
   

  

* Manage banking relationships and resolve account\-, transaction\-, or compliance\-related issues
* Oversee UAE corporate tax (9%) and VAT registration, filings, and compliance with the Federal Tax Authority
* Lead the annual statutory audit cycle in coordination with the Finance function
* Sponsor visas for UAE\-based hires and manage related immigration, residency, and renewal workflows
* Own the UAE office presence (if applicable), vendor contracts, insurance, and local administration


**Objective 4 \- Partner with leadership on UAE strategic initiatives**
 Outcome: Leadership has a trusted UAE partner who can scope, scale, and de\-risk any new initiative anchored in the region.
   

  

 Typical tasks:
   

  

* Advise leadership on the regulatory and operational implications of new products, partnerships, or markets
* Lead UAE\-specific initiatives such as banking expansion, new entity structures, or regulatory licensing
* Represent PFM in select UAE industry forums and at high\-trust meetings with partners or authorities
* Surface risks and opportunities to the CFO and CEO with clear written analysis


**What We Look For**
**Must have**
* 7\+ years of operations, regulatory, or compliance leadership experience in the UAE
* Hands\-on familiarity with one or more UAE free zones (e.g., DMCC, IFZA, DIFC, ADGM, JAFZA)
* Strong working knowledge of UAE corporate tax, VAT, and Federal Tax Authority requirements
* Experience managing banking relationships and resolving compliance / KYC matters with UAE banks
* Track record of running statutory audits and filings end\-to\-end
* Demonstrated experience working with internal or external legal counsel on UAE\-specific matters — contracts, employment law, free\-zone governance, or commercial agreements
* Excellent English; comfortable operating in a remote\-first, async\-first environment


**Nice to have**
* Background in fintech, financial services, brokerage, or trading\-adjacent industries
* DIFC or ADGM\-specific licensing experience
* Working Arabic — useful for direct regulator and bank conversations
* Existing relationships with UAE regulators, free\-zone authorities, or top legal / audit firms
* Experience scaling a UAE entity through tax or regulatory transitions (e.g., corporate tax rollout)


**Compensation**
 $6,000\-$10,000 / month gross
   

  

**Reporting cadence**
 Reports to: CFO.
   

  

 Direct reports: None at hire. May grow to include UAE\-based operational staff over time.
   

  

 Key cross\-functional partners: Finance, Leadership, HR, Legal counsel, external auditors and bankers.
   

  

 Upward reporting cadence: Weekly 1:1 with CFO; monthly written summary covering compliance, regulator interactions, and operational risks; quarterly strategic review with leadership.
   

  

**Location \& work setup**
* Location: UAE\-based (Dubai preferred), with the ability to be physically present at relevant authorities, banks, and the free\-zone office when needed
* Working hours: Flexible, with reasonable overlap with CET hours (4\+ hours of overlap)
* Employment type: Full\-time


**Benefits**
**Hiring stages**
 We keep our process simple, transparent, and respectful of your time. Here's what to expect:
   

  

* Application screening We carefully review all applications to identify candidates whose background aligns with the role's requirements. You'll receive a timely and transparent update on your application status
* Video intro \+ role fit questionnaire A short async step \- no scheduling required. You'll record a brief video introduction and complete a written questionnaire. This helps us understand who you are, your relevant background, and how your experience aligns with the role without either side committing to a live call upfront
* Discovery HR Interview A conversation with our HR team focused on company and culture match. We'll walk you through how PFM works, what remote ownership looks like in practice, and what success in this role looks like. You'll have plenty of space to ask questions and share your goals
* Real\-world task (paid) A short, scoped exercise based on a real PFM UAE operations or regulatory challenge. We compensate for your time because we believe that's the right way to do it. This stage is designed to give both sides a realistic view of the work before committing further
* Peer \& values conversation A conversation with a peer from across the team focused on values, culture, and how you work best. You'll have plenty of space to ask questions and get a real feel for life at PFM
* Professional interview You will meet our CFO, to focus on your UAE operations and regulatory expertise — entity governance, banking, tax, free\-zone matters, and how you approach complex regulatory situations. This is the decisive conversation on domain skills and role\-specific experience
* Leadership interview (optional) A conversation with a peer from across the team focused on values, culture, and how you work best. You'll have plenty of space to ask questions and get a real feel for life at PFM


 If there's a strong mutual match, we start with an informal conversation to align on expectations, then follow up with a formal written offer. Full transparency throughout, and time for you to make an informed decision.
   

  

 To keep things fully transparent and mutually fair, we complete a reference check before the formal offer is extended. No surprises \- just part of how we make careful, informed decisions on both sides.
   

  

**Before applying take into account that:**
 ▸ If you don't meet every single qualification but believe you can excel in the role based on what it requires \- we encourage you to apply.
   

  

 ▸ We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
   

  

 ▸ Even if it's not listed as a formal requirement, we truly value candidates who have clear familiarity with the prop trading industry and us, our mission and what we do.
   

  

**Not the right fit for this role?**
 If this role isn't the right match but you have experience in trading operations, customer success, compliance, support, partnerships, or a related area \- we still want to hear from you. Join our Talent Pool and we'll reach out when a relevant role opens. Every submission is reviewed, and the pool is always the first place we look before opening a new search.

**Description**
 Amazon works hard to delight customers – from the second an order is placed online to the seamless coordination of that order behind the scenes, we strive to stay agile, \& fluid. Have you ever ordered a product on Amazon and when that box with the smile arrived you wondered how it got to you so fast?
   

  

 If so, the Amazon Now team is for you. We partner directly with product and software teams to develop the future of quick commerce.
   

  

 The Tech SME team acts as a catalyst for change by driving innovation at the operator level, prioritizing technology initiatives and supporting engineering design innovations. Tech SMEs strive to be experts in Amazon’s operation systems. They are accountable to delivering world class solutions through optimizing and reinventing the existing technology.
   

  

 The Tech SME is a functional expert on the software tools in given process areas and their application in the network. A successful manager in this organization has strong program management experience to define the process the team uses to deliver best in class tech to the field. This person looks for ways to automate human decision making by influencing Technology to build and update tools that reduce process complexity to deliver robust processes.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Subject Matter Expert (SME) supports, coordinates and facilitates implementation of new \& improved processes within the quick commerce operations. The SME works closely with the store operations, last mile delivery teams, and local \& global product teams. They will be the single point of contact for all tech related activities related with Supply Chain (SC), Under the roof (UTR) and On the road (OTR) and will be providing regular updates to senior leadership team.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead technology programs and initiatives for darkstore operations, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems
* Drive Under the Roof (UTR) and On the Road (OTR) operations programs at the darkstore level, optimizing inbound, warehouse, and last\-mile delivery processes
* Build low\-cost automations using AI tools such as KIRO, Quick, and related operations to drive efficiency and reduce manual processes
* Prepare \& lead the tech roadmap for improvement of hybrid warehouse management system (HWMS) for inbound and outbound processes
* Prepare \& lead the tech roadmap for enhancement of delivery service, working closely with the 3P partners \& DSP teams
* Collaborate with worldwide (WW) product and tech teams of HWMS/PRIMS and Last Mile to launch products in Quick commerce (QC) business
* Work closely with the tech organization to document and drive upcoming changes, leveraging tools such as business requirement documents (BRDs) to ensure seamless integration with the existing system.
* Provide regular, concise updates to Tech SME leadership on the progress of the system's development and its potential impact.
* Develop the culture of continuous improvement and Kaizen across tech \& operations to optimize processes and reduce SLAs
* Support new store launches, including but not limited to configurations, Quality Assurance (QA), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), etc., coordinating with multiple global product \& tech teams and work with external stakeholders to continuously reduce the time to launch a store
* Provide trainings to operations on new systems and processes
* Maintain strong relationship with the IN, NA, MENA, ROW tech teams working for QC business


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

**About Us** 




 We are a fast\-growing FinTech company licensed by the Dubai Financial Services Authority (DFSA). We operate in a highly regulated environment and uphold the highest standards of compliance, governance, and operational excellence.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic Senior Executive Officer (SEO)/ Managing Director to lead our Dubai operations. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing the branch’s overall performance, ensuring compliance with DFSA regulations, managing key stakeholder relationships, and driving the company’s growth in the region.

* Ensuring compliance with DFSA requirements.
* Develop and implement strategic plans to achieve business growth and profitability.

* Oversee risk management, governance, and compliance frameworks.

* Provide leadership, mentorship, and motivation to the team.
* Attract new banking partners and identify market opportunities.

**Requirements** 



* Proven track record in a senior leadership role (Financial services or FinTech will be an advantage).
* In\-depth knowledge of DFSA regulations.

* Understanding of compliance, regulatory frameworks, and partner\-bank relations
* Exceptional leadership, a mix of structured thinking, communication skills, and diplomacy \- amicable yet professional.
* Ability to take ownership, act independently, and grow companies to a new level.

* Opportunity to lead and shape the growth of a DFSA\-licensed FinTech company.
* Competitive compensation package.
* Dynamic and innovative work environment.
* Exposure to a fast\-evolving financial technology sector.

data.jd_text:
Join the UAE’s largest bank and one of the world’s largest and safest financial institutions. Our focus is to create value for our employees, customers, shareholders and communities to grow through differentiation, agility and innovation. We are looking for top talent, and your success is our success. Accelerate your growth as you help us reach our goals and advance your career. Be ready to make your mark a top company, in an exciting \& dynamic industry.
 



  





**Job Purpose** 




 To manage and grow relationships with large and strategic clients within the assigned portfolio in the Retail \& Consumer Goods segment of Wholesale Banking. Drive new business origination while ensuring full compliance with Credit and Risk frameworks. Improve service quality levels and supervise the day‑to‑day activities and client interactions of subordinates to ensure the team consistently meets its objectives and achieves revenue targets, while maintaining strong client satisfaction and portfolio credit quality. Promote effective cross‑functional collaboration to deliver integrated financial solutions. Achieving financial targets and strategic objectives will be essential in driving sustainable growth and maintaining profitability.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities** 




**Business Origination** 



* Originate new business opportunities with target clients across banking products and in line with relevant policies.
* Obtain support from relevant stakeholders and governance forums to execute deals (e.g., credit, products, GT).
* Draft Term Sheets, Information Memorandums, Mandate letters etc.
* Examine \& resolve credit, market and operational risk aspects of transactions in collaboration with products and enablement units.
* Leverage FAB’s network expansion through cross border deals.
* Expand Products Penetration Through Sector\-Focused Solutions.
* Ensure high returns with satisfactory yields and sufficient ancillary business.
* Maintain the credit quality of the client's relationships within the Portfolio to an acceptable level set by the Bank's management.
* Pitch, review, negotiate and conclude deals.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers in other banks to originate business.
* Up to date with the latest market, competitors, regulatory and industry and amend accordingly the account plans as when applicable.
* Ability to handle sophisticated transactions and engage assigned team members.
* Recommend policy amendments as when required to match with the latest business trends.



  





**Client Relationship Management** 



* To achieve assigned financial and non\-financial objectives by meeting all borrowing \& non borrowing needs of customers with target segments (E.g., borrowers, transactors, depositors).
* Prepare and Maintain Group Account Plans for all clients with support from relevant partners (e.g., products, international banking, Employee banking, Asset Management, etc.).
* Act as the main point of contact for clients, ensuring quality service and effective resolution of issues.
* Prepare briefing note memos ahead of senior management meetings with clients.
* Engage with internal stakeholders to obtain approvals for client RFPs in a timely manner.
* Increase wallet share with existing clients through strategic engagement and product penetration.
* Support on the conduct of annual/periodic credit facility reviews in the existing portfolio in a timely manner and support on the recommendation of appropriate credit facilities in line with the banks credit. policy to maximize earnings while containing risks to an acceptable level and identifying candidates for downgrades/ upgrades.
* Develop, Implement and maintain complete control aspects i.e., documentation, periodical client visits / call reports, stock inspections and formal credit checks / informal market feedback to monitor the assigned portfolio effectively.
* Organize client meetings with relevant partners/ seniority to deepen FAB relationship within the portfolio.
* Identify \& develop cross selling opportunities and increase cross\-sell ratio and returns with clients.
* Support client on their day\-to\-day banking requirements with support from the team (as applicable).
* Ensure customer satisfaction remains high and meets the targeted NPS score.
* Be knowledgeable on market trends and manage a disciplined marketing process by identifying steps/strategies necessary to effectively initiate relationships with prospects.
* Onboard new clients as and when required.



  





**Collaboration** 



* Align with Retail \& Consumer Goods team as well as other partners to identify and convert opportunities.
* Collaborate with other business divisions to drive cross\-BU collaboration. Develop proposition strategy, competition analysis, focused group approach, service delivery model, customer experience, internal \& external campaigns and alignment with other Products \& proposition including Risk policies, Payment \& Cash management, Trade products, collaboration with Retail banking including Private Banking, etc.
* Align with International banking to support client in FAB network locations.
* Support Unit/Divisional/Bank\-wide initiatives (as required or assigned).



  





**Operational** 



* Follow all relevant policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.
* Present transactions/proposals to the Credit Allocation Committee (CAC) for approvals.
* Run deal RAROCs and draft CAC submissions, ensuring delivery on CAC promises to achieve target RAROC thresholds.
* Prepare Green Light Memos for deal screening and Client Credit Applications (CAs).
* Review CAs and draft relationship comments before submission to Credit Committees.
* Ensure all credit reviews are submitted on time and agreed conditions are met.
* Address Credit inquiries, liaise with CAD and Legal for documentation matters.
* Conduct periodic reviews of risks (credit, operational, compliance etc.) within the portfolio on a regular basis.
* Drive day\-to\-day administrative and transactional activities for the team such as client calls, documentation follow up, pipeline updates, and any other activities in the unit/team to ensure continuity of work and delivery of effective/high quality output.
* Ensure that internal processes for existing portfolio/ NTBs are in\-line with the Bank's policies \& procedures.
* Manage and follow up on KYC and compliance requirements to ensure consistency with the Bank's KYC and AML policies and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure all clients' files \[documents] are maintained.
* Maintain a satisfactory audit on the portfolio.
* Adhere to process KPl's and, ORM, BCP \& Internal Audit requirements.
* Prepare timely and accurate statements and reports to meet the unit's requirements, policies, and standards.



  





**Client and Market Analysis** 



* Conduct financial analysis on clients and their respective geographies/ industries/ markets to identify potential opportunities and risks.



  





**Leadership** 



* Act as Role Model for the entire Retail \& Consumer Goods group and Retails \& Wholesale team
* Lead, Mentor, Motivate, Develop and Coach team members to ensure career growth and short\- \& long\-term successors
* Establish high\-performance culture and ensure high engagement levels.
* Encourage ownership through rightful assignments to team members.
* Achieve individual and team's financial performance targets.
* Learning \& Development Attend appropriate on and off\-the\-job training programs and ensure development and skill upgradation of team members.
* Involvement in team members new hirings.


- 


**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in finance or related discipline.
* CFA, or master’s degree in business administration is preferred.
* 12\+ years of experience in Banking with at least 8\+ years in senior role of team management.



  





**Knowledge, Skills, And Attributes** 



* Deep Knowledge of Wholesale Banking or Investment Banking with exposure to Retail \& Consumer Goods.
* Strong understanding of credit analysis, trade finance, and treasury products.
* Excellent relationship management, negotiation, and leadership skills.
* Ability to manage complex client structures and deliver on strategic objectives.
* Understanding of FAB's product offering and business strategy.
* Ability to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders to drive business.
* Strong relationship management skills both internally and externally.
* Sound communication skills (written and verbal).
* Ability to analyze and research information.
* Deep Financial and credit analysis ability with an aptitude to identify opportunities and close business deals.
* Data analysis and financial modelling skills
* Ability to work under pressure and adjust quickly to changing priorities
* Proficient in MS Office (excel, word and Power\-point).

**Company Description**

**Job Description**
 The role of the Expert Services MEA Practice Director will oversee a team of consultants responsible for delivering high\-quality outcomes to our customers and partners across all the Workflows. This role reports to the Director, Expert Services MEA and plays a pivotal role in shaping and executing the delivery strategy for MEA Expert services and delivery high\-impact programme across the region.
   

  

 What you get to do in this role
   

  

* Define and execute the MEA Expert Services delivery strategy, aligned with customer needs, market trends, and ServiceNow’s business goals. Drive decisions around capability development, service offerings, delivery models, and market positioning.
* Champion transformation delivery and customer success: Ensure delivery efforts are aligned to customer business outcomes, platform adoption, and long\-term success. Position the practice as a strategic partner for MEA transformation journeys.

* Manage partner execution through clear expectations, weekly cadence reviews, and escalation protocols. Partner with global delivery partners and ServiceNow Partner Alliance Teams to co\-deliver on customer outcomes, align on delivery standards, and drive continuous improvement.
* Translate market demand, sales pipeline insights, and strategic initiatives into action—driving decisions around hiring, team structure, capability development, and enablement.
* Own the technical solution quality of delivery in MEA engagements, ensuring consistent, scalable, and value\-driven outcomes for our customers.
* Position the team for scale by developing delivery models, frameworks, and leadership capabilities that support predictable and high\-quality customer success.

* Familiarity with project management tools and performance tracking systems

Egis is an international player active in architecture, consulting, construction engineering and mobility services. We create and operate intelligent infrastructures and buildings that respond to the climate emergency and contribute to more balanced, sustainable and resilient territorial development. Operating in 100 countries, Egis puts the expertise of its 19,500 employees at the service of its clients and develops cutting\-edge innovations accessible to all projects. Through its wide range of activities, Egis is a key player in the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.
   

  





 With 3,500 employees across 8 countries in the Middle East, Egis has delivered over 700 complex development projects, stimulating economic growth and enhancing quality of life. Ranked among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development. The Group’s operations in the Middle East are built on strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions. Egis’ long history of providing comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services makes it a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 Egis is building its data centre capability across the UAE and wider MESA region. We are seeking a Technical Director to lead the technical direction of that emerging practice \- setting standards, leading major bids, and acting as our senior technical authority on mission\-critical work. Reporting to the Regional Director \- MEP, this is a leadership role with real scope to shape a practice from the ground up, backed by the reach and resources of a global consultancy.

* Provide technical leadership and sign\-off authority across all data centre projects in the region
* Define and maintain MEP/ELV design standards and delivery frameworks for mission\-critical work

* Drive innovation across BIM, parametric design, and AI\-assisted workflows

* Deep expertise across data centre MEP/ELV systems: HV/LV, generators, UPS, precision cooling, EPMS, DCIM, and ICT infrastructure

* Degree\-qualified with Chartered Engineer status (CEng or regional equivalent) required

**Additional Information**
* 400\+ strong, award\-winning MEP/ELV team across UAE, KSA, India, Jordan, and Egypt

* Platform to build a specialist data centre practice from the ground up

 **Infrastructure and Capital Projects (Infra)** 
 team focuses on improving return on investment capital and reducing the risks specific to capital projects. * Collaborate with teams and clients, engaging in negotiations and fostering effective partnerships between leadership.
* Develop and nurture client relationships, seeking to understand their needs and contributing to their satisfaction.
* Participate in industry events and associations to broaden professional connections and identify potential growth avenues.
* Contribute to the identification and pursuit of new business prospects, aligned with the strategic goals of Infra and other Business Units.

* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex situations and develop solutions, emphasizing creativity and critical thinking.
* Self\-starter with strong business acumen and a results\-driven approach.
* Ability to adapt and thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
* Collaborative and team\-oriented mindset.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills for interactions with senior management, clients, and colleagues.

* Consulting background (programme director / practice lead) considered strongly

**Job Description**
 Are you ready to lead a busy Operations Control Centre that coordinates operational safety, efficiency and resilience across our network? At
 **SolitAir** 
 , we’re seeking an experienced and adaptable leader to establish and head the Integrated Operations Control Centre (IOCC). This role will set the strategy, build the team, and oversee integrated operational control functions that ensure safe, compliant and on\-time service delivery.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
**As Head Of IOCC, You Will**
* Establish and operationally manage the IOCC, including staffing, processes, tools and performance metrics to deliver 24/7 operational control.
* Lead cross\-functional coordination between flight operations, maintenance control, ground operations, cargo planning, safety, and regulatory liaison to resolve disruptions and maintain continuity.
* Drive problem solving for complex operational events by applying structured analysis, root cause identification, and timely corrective actions to minimise impact on safety and schedule.
* Develop flexible operating procedures and escalation frameworks to respond to dynamic operational conditions, including irregular operations, AOG events and severe weather.
* Implement and maintain integrated systems and dashboards that provide real\-time situational awareness and decision support for IOCC staff and senior leadership.
* Champion a culture of continuous improvement, capturing lessons learned, training requirements and process enhancements to reduce recurrence of operational disruptions.
* Ensure all IOCC activities comply with relevant regulatory requirements and company policies, and coordinate timely reporting to regulators and stakeholders as required.
* Provide clear, effective communication in English across internal teams and external partners during normal and contingency operations.


****What We’re Looking For****
* Experience: Proven background in airline or aviation operational control roles, with significant experience leading operational teams and managing irregular operations.
* Problem Solving: Strong analytical capability and structured problem solving skills, able to lead investigations, define root causes and implement robust corrective actions.
* Flexibility: Demonstrated adaptability to changing priorities and operational pressures; comfortable leading a 24/7 function with variable hours and rapid decision\-making demands. This means you are likely to work over weekends and/or evenings as operational demands require.
* English: Excellent written and spoken English with the ability to prepare clear reports, brief senior leadership and communicate effectively across diverse teams.
* Leadership \& Communication: Strong people leadership skills, able to recruit, develop and motivate a high\-performing, inclusive team; confident at stakeholder engagement and crisis communication.
* Systems \& Data: Comfortable with operational control systems, real\-time dashboards and data\-driven decision making; experience with industry tools is desirable.
* Qualifications: Relevant degree or professional qualifications in aviation, operations management or related field preferred.


 At SolitAir, every role contributes to shaping the future of cargo aviation. This is a gender neutral role and we are committed to providing equal opportunities for all candidates.

* An inclusive workplace with opportunities for professional growth and development.
* The chance to build and lead a new, and growing, high\-impact operational function at the heart of our business.

data.jd_text:
**Company Description** 




  





 talabat is the leading on\-demand food and non\-food delivery platform in MENA, operating across 8 countries and processing hundreds of millions of orders annually.
 



 We're part of Delivery Hero, the global leader in online food delivery and q\-commerce, and we're engineering\-first. Our teams operate under
 **eXtreme Programming (XP) principles** 
 — TDD, pair programming, continuous refactoring, and trunk\-based development. We believe
 **quality enables speed** 
 , and our hiring reflects that. Our engineering culture is a key competitive advantage, and we're looking for leaders who embody it.
 



  





**Job Description** 




  





**What you'll own** 




  





 As
 **Senior Engineering Manager** 
 , you'll lead multiple engineering teams (typically 4 squads, \~20 engineers) across a single technical domain. You're accountable for:
 


* **Domain\-level technical strategy** 
 — Work with product leadership and your teams to define a 12–18 month technical vision for your domain
* **Team health and growth** 
 — Build an environment where engineers thrive: hiring, developing ICs, mentoring junior managers, and creating psychological safety
* **Delivery excellence** 
 — Guide your teams through discovery, planning, and execution using small\-batch delivery and continuous feedback loops
* **Business impact** 
 — Translate product objectives into technical solutions; quantify and communicate the impact of your domain's work
* **Cross\-functional leadership** 
 — Work closely with product, design, and business partners to resolve ambiguity and drive alignment
* **Technical decision\-making** 
 — Guide your teams on system design, architecture, and engineering practices while maintaining talabat's standards for scalability, security, and performance



  





**90\-day, 6\-month, and 12\-month outcomes** 




  





**90 days:** 
 You've onboarded your teams, understood their technical roadmap and pain points, and delivered your first feedback to your manager on domain health and near\-term priorities.
 



**6 months:** 
 Your teams are shipping value consistently; you've identified one emerging technical leader and started mentoring them; you've coached your teams through at least one cross\-domain initiative; code quality and shipping velocity are on track or improving.
 



**12 months:** 
 Your domain has a clear technical vision communicated across the org; you've grown at least one engineer significantly (either toward IC4/Staff or toward management); your teams ship with confidence; you're contributing to 1–2 strategic initiatives beyond your domain; you're mentoring or developing a potential future manager.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




  





**What you'll bring** 




  





**Leadership \& people management** 



* 4\+ years of hands\-on technical leadership experience managing engineering teams
* Demonstrated ability to hire, mentor, and grow engineers — we care about your track record of developing people, not just technical skills
* Comfort with cross\-functional leadership: working with product, design, business partners, and other engineering teams
* Emotional intelligence: you navigate ambiguity, handle conflict constructively, and create psychological safety for your teams



  





**Technical depth** 



* 8\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience in production systems
* Deep understanding of
 **at least one** 
 of: distributed systems, backend systems, data platforms, mobile platforms, or web\-scale infrastructure
* Proven ability to work
 **across diverse technology stacks** 
 — we care that you've made architecture decisions that matter, not that you've used every specific tool
* Hands\-on understanding of XP practices: TDD, pair programming, continuous refactoring, and trunk\-based development (or strong willingness to learn and lead talabat's approach)



  





**Engineering sense** 



* You think about non\-functional requirements: scalability, reliability, latency, cost efficiency, and security — not just feature delivery
* You've navigated the tradeoffs between speed and technical debt; you know when to optimize and when to simplify
* You've led or been part of domain\-level decisions (tech stack migrations, architectural changes, platform initiatives)



  





**Nice\-to\-haves** 



* Experience leading multiple teams or a domain in a high\-growth environment
* Exposure to eXtreme Programming practices (XP culture is learnable but experience is valuable)
* Background in marketplace, delivery, or logistics optimization
* Experience mentoring or developing other engineering managers
* Familiarity with modern cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)



  





**Additional information** 




  





**Why this role, why talabat** 




  




* **Scale with purpose:** 
 You'll impact millions of daily orders across MENA while building a technical foundation that's proven to scale
* **Engineering culture that works:** 
 We practice XP genuinely — TDD, pair programming, continuous delivery — not as Agile theater. Our engineers ship faster
 *because* 
 we focus on quality
* **Autonomous teams:** 
 Your teams own their roadmap and their quality. You're not a bottleneck; you're an enabler
* **Mentoring and growth:** 
 If you want to grow into a Director role, we have a clear path: multi\-domain scope → tribe leadership → org strategy
* **Real problems:** 
 Food delivery in MENA is complex. You'll solve problems that matter: serving millions, operating across 8 countries, balancing fast delivery with sustainability

data.raw_snippet:
**About The Role**
 The Art Director is a senior creative delivery role within M\+C Saatchi Sport \& Entertainment Middle East, responsible for leading the visual and conceptual development of sport and events campaigns across the agency's client portfolio.
   

  

 Reporting to the Senior Client D
data.jd_text:
**About The Role**
 The Art Director is a senior creative delivery role within M\+C Saatchi Sport \& Entertainment Middle East, responsible for leading the visual and conceptual development of sport and events campaigns across the agency's client portfolio.
   

  

 Reporting to the Senior Client Director, the Art Director will take briefs from strategy and account teams and translate them into compelling creative territories, campaign identities, event experiences, and activation assets that perform across all channels and touchpoints.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, high\-output role suited to a creative who understands the energy, pace, and visual language of sport and live events. You will be expected to concept and create at speed, uphold quality standards across a busy client roster, and contribute to the creative direction of the agency's most visible and complex campaigns.
   

  

 The Art Director will play an important role in shaping the agency's creative output \- working across event branding, sponsorship activations, fan engagement, social content and pitch development \- while supporting and developing the wider creative team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Campaign Creative \& Concept Development**
* Lead creative development from brief to delivery across sports and events campaigns, ensuring all work is on\-brief, on\-brand, and commercially sound.
* Translate strategic briefs into visual creative territories, mood boards, campaign frameworks and creative rationales.
* Develop and present multiple creative routes with clarity and confidence, both internally and in client\-facing settings.
* Oversee creative quality and visual consistency across all client touchpoints and across the full campaign lifecycle.


**Sports \& Events Creative**
* Design and develop event identity systems, environmental branding, wayfinding, fan zone concepts and large\-format experiential assets.
* Create campaign visual assets for major sporting events, sponsor activations, athlete partnerships and fan engagement activations.
* Produce creative across OOH, digital, social, print, broadcast and environmental formats as required by client campaigns.
* Stay ahead of design and visual communication trends in global sports marketing, live events and fan culture.


**Client \& Agency Presentations**
* Support the development of new business pitch decks, credentials presentations and agency marketing materials.
* Present creative work to clients with confidence, manage feedback clearly and see revisions through to final artwork.
* Help the agency bring creative ambition to pitches and proposals, positioning M\+C Saatchi S\&E ME as a best\-in\-class creative partner.


**Creative Team \& Production**
* Brief, direct and review work from freelance designers, illustrators, photographers and video producers.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously, maintaining quality and meeting deadlines without compromising standards.
* Oversee artwork trafficking and file management, ensuring all assets are delivered to specification for print and digital use.
* Manage relationships with print suppliers, production studios and external creative partners where required.
* Support and mentor junior members of the creative team, helping to build capability and a culture of high standards.


**Cross\-Department Collaboration**
* Work closely across all departments to deliver integrated creative solutions.
* Collaborate with the Social Media team to ensure campaign creative works effectively across all social platforms.
* Contribute to internal creative reviews and help raise the quality of creative output across all agency accounts.


 ABOUT YOU
   

  

**Essential**
* 5\+ years of experience as an Art Director, Senior Designer or equivalent creative role, with a strong portfolio demonstrating sport and/or events work.
* Exceptional design craft with a sharp eye for typography, layout, colour and visual storytelling.
* Proven experience across multiple formats: campaign identities, event branding, social content, large\-format production and presentation design.
* Expert\-level proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite: Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign.
* Strong conceptual thinking \- able to generate original ideas and develop them from sketch to final delivery.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced agency environment managing multiple client briefs simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills \- confident in client\-facing situations.
* Understanding of the GCC and Middle East market, cultural sensitivities and visual communication norms.


**Desirable**
* Proven experience on major sporting events \- rugby, football, motorsport, tennis, athletics or equivalent.
* Motion graphics and video editing skills: After Effects, Premiere Pro.
* Experience working with government entities, tourism boards, rights holders or sports federations in the region.
* Bilingual creative capability in English and Arabic.


**What Great Looks Like**
 Success in this role means producing creative that is confident, original and purposeful \- work that wins pitches, elevates client campaigns and makes the agency proud.
   

  

 You are the person who brings energy and clarity to a brief. You concept quickly, execute with precision, and know how to read a room when presenting. You understand the difference between a great idea and a great execution \- and you deliver both.
   

  

 You work well with strategy and account teams without needing to be spoon\-fed. You push back constructively when a brief is not right, and you take responsibility for quality at every stage of the process.
   

  

 You are as comfortable art directing an event identity system for a major sports property as you are turning around a social asset for a sponsor activation at pace. You understand sport, you understand the region, and you bring both to your work.
   

  

 Ready to lead. Built for sport and entertainment industry. Focused on quality, originality and delivery.
   

  

 This role is suited to a strong, confident Art Director who wants to be at the centre of one of the region's most exciting creative agency environments.
   

  

**Applications close on Friday, June 26, 2026\.**
**About Our Local Office**
 We were born out of the need for strategic and brutally effective creativity in the region. With every successful campaign, we have grown, and cherry\-picked the best professionals to work with us from all over the region and the world. In 2012, we opened our Abu Dhabi office and expanded our team with our Dubai office in 2016 and then our Riyadh office in 2023\. From these offices we manage a number of local and global brands across the Middle East and Europe. Brutal Simplicity of Thought is the creative philosophy of M\+C Saatchi. It defines the way we work and the work we produce. We believe: It’s easier to complicate than simplify. Simple ideas enter the brain quicker and stay there longer. Brutal Simplicity of Thought is therefore a painful necessity.
   

  

 ABOUT M\+C SAATCHI GROUP
   

  

 M\+C Saatchi Group is a creative federation of companies who navigate, create, and lead meaningful change for clients across five specialist divisions connected through people, culture, data, technology and creativity, M\+C Saatchi Group aims to unlock new value for clients and leave a positive impact on the world. M\+C Saatchi Group’s work is informed by two core principles \- Brutal Simplicity of Thought and Diversity of Thought. Together they guide how problems are solved and integrated specialist teams are built. Headquartered in London, M\+C Saatchi Group have circa 2,500 employees globally. Our global operations span 23 countries with major hubs in the UK, Europe, Middle East \& Africa, Asia and Australia.
   

  

 OUR AMBITION
   

  

 At M\+C Saatchi Group, our ambition is to create and curate Cultural Power for our clients. We do this by connecting specialist expertise, powered by creativity, data and technology, to help build famous brands and solve the most complex business and societal challenges.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose:** 




 We are seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to lead the design, delivery, and operations of scalable, cloud\-native platforms powering last\-mile delivery across multiple MENA markets.
 



 This role blends deep technical leadership with strong business acumen to build reliable, high\-performance systems that support real\-time order processing, logistics orchestration, and operational decision\-making at scale.
 



 You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams including Product, Operations, Data, and Infrastructure, driving the development of resilient platforms capable of handling high transaction volumes, while enabling future\-ready capabilities in advanced analytics, automation, and AI\-driven optimization.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




**Platform Architecture \& Engineering Leadership** 



* Architect, build, and operate large\-scale event\-driven microservices in Java, Node.js, and Python platforms powered by Confluent Kafka for real\-time order processing, delivery orchestration, and logistics intelligence.
* Lead the engineering strategy for last\-mile delivery systems, handling millions of order transactions per month across multiple MENA markets.
* Drive platform scalability, resiliency, observability, and high availability, ensuring enterprise\-grade SLAs and operational stability.
* Define and implement best practices for distributed systems, asynchronous messaging, API management, and event\-driven integration patterns.
* Provide technical leadership for cloud\-native application development using containerized and Kubernetes\-based architectures.



**Cloud \& Data Infrastructure** 



* Design and manage Azure\-native enterprise platforms leveraging:
* Microsoft Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
* API Management (APIM)
* PostgreSQL
* Azure Data Lake
* Azure AI/ML Services
* Event\-driven integration services
* Ensure platform reliability with a target uptime of 99\.99% through proactive monitoring, disaster recovery planning, and performance optimization.
* Build scalable data pipelines and integrated data ecosystems enabling advanced analytics, AI/ML, and operational reporting.



**Data Integration \& Enterprise Analytics Enablement** 



* Lead integration initiatives across:
* Restaurant POS systems
* Delivery logistics platforms
* Customer mobile/web applications
* Financial and reporting systems
* Enterprise operational platforms
* Create unified operational data layers supporting:
* Delivery time prediction
* Logistics efficiency optimization
* Store performance analytics
* Customer behaviour analysis
* Workforce and capacity planning
* Partner with analytics and data science teams to ensure platform readiness for enterprise\-scale data mining and predictive intelligence initiatives.



**AI/ML \& Intelligent Automation** 



* Lead deployment and operationalization of AI/ML models using Python\-based ecosystems, including:
* Neural Prophet
* XGboost
* Scikit\-learn
* TensorFlow
* Predictive analytics frameworks
* Enable intelligent operational capabilities such as:
* Dynamic order routing
* ETA prediction
* Delivery capacity optimization
* Demand forecasting
* Drive MLOps best practices, including model deployment, monitoring, retraining, and lifecycle governance.



**Engineering Management \& Stakeholder Collaboration** 



* Manage and mentor high\-performing engineering teams, including backend engineers, DevOps engineers, architects, and data engineers.
* Collaborate with product management, operations, finance, and executive leadership to align technology initiatives with business objectives.
* Drive agile delivery execution, sprint planning, engineering governance, and release management.
* Own technical roadmap planning, architecture reviews, risk management, and vendor coordination.
* Establish engineering KPIs, operational metrics, and platform performance governance.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.
* 15\+ years of experience in enterprise software engineering with at least 3\+ years in engineering leadership or architecture management roles.
* Strong experience designing and operating event\-driven architectures using Confluent Kafka or Apache Kafka ecosystems.
* Extensive experience with cloud\-native technologies on Microsoft Azure.



  





**Proven Expertise In** 



* AKS/Kubernetes
* Microservices architecture
* API\-first integration
* Distributed systems
* Real\-time data streaming
* Hands\-on experience with PostgreSQL, Data Lakes, and enterprise integration architectures.
* Experience deploying and managing AI/ML solutions using Python frameworks such as TensorFlow and Scikit\-learn.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD, DevSecOps, observability, and platform reliability engineering.
* Experience in logistics, QSR, e\-commerce, supply chain, mobility, or last\-mile delivery domains is highly preferred.

data.jd_text:
**About Zamanat** 




 Zamanat is a Sharia\-aligned real\-world asset tokenisation platform. We structure and tokenise assets across funds, private credit, real estate and receivables, then distribute them through institutional, private wealth and on\-chain channels.
 



  





 We have applied for a DIFC tokenised credit fund and run a live structuring pipeline across receivables, fund and real\-estate mandates in MENA, GCC and selected emerging markets. The structuring lead is a foundational role.
 



  





 AI\-driven playbooks are a core part of Zamanat's growth strategy. We are building a structuring function where AI tools compress time\-to\-launch, accelerate documentation, and turn one\-off deals into repeatable products. The right hire is hungry to learn, prototype and embed AI tooling into the structuring workflow.
 



  





  





**The Role** 




 We are hiring a
 **Director, Structuring \& Originatio** 
 n to lead deal structuring across Zamanat's live and forward pipeline, originate new mandates, and build the structuring playbook that compresses our time\-to\-launch on every subsequent deal. The role is hands\-on today. It is also on a clear path to Senior Director or MD as deal pipeline, AUM and team scale. The right person executes deals personally now and grows into running a structuring desk over the next 18 to 36 months. This is not a pure origination seat and not a back\-office structuring seat. We need someone who can hold a term sheet, a Sharia structure, a regulator conversation, a sponsor relationship and a documentation pack in the same week.
 



  





  





**What You Will Do** 



* Lead end\-to\-end structuring on live mandates across receivables financing, private credit, fund tokenisation and asset\-backed structures
* Originate new mandates alongside the CEO and BD lead, primarily across MENA, GCC, South Asia and Sub\-Saharan Africa
* Codify Zamanat's structuring playbooks. The 12\-month KPI is three named playbooks in production use
* Build AI\-assisted structuring tooling and templates: use AI to fast\-track documentation, term\-sheet drafting, scenario modelling, Sharia structure checks, and deal pattern recognition across the playbook library
* Own commercial term\-sheet design, fee structures and economic alignment with sponsors and partners
* Run Sharia structuring decisions in close coordination with appointed Sharia advisors. Murabaha, Wakala, Sukuk, Ijara, Musharaka and hybrid structures as relevant
* Oversee post\-issuance servicing on SME and receivables programmes including servicing, reporting, performance monitoring and remediation triggers
* Work with regulatory counsel and partner licence\-holders on jurisdictional execution (ADGM, DIFC, DFSA, FSRA, and selected emerging\-market regulators)
* Manage the deal\-team relationship with fund administrators, custodians, tokenisation tech partners and Sharia advisors
* Build and lead the structuring team as pipeline conversion supports it.



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 You ha
 **ve 10 to 14 ye** 
 ars of experience in structured finance, capital markets, Islamic finance, private credit, securitisation, receivables financing or specialist arranging. You have personally led deals through structuring, documentation and closing, not just sat on the desk while others closed them. You can run the playbook today and build the team that runs it tomorrow.
 



 You understand both the commercial logic of a deal and the structural mechanics that make it executable. You are comfortable with ambiguity, lean teams and shaping a function from scratch. You are hungry to learn and apply AI tooling to your work. You see AI as core leverage on structuring throughput, not a side experiment.
 



  





**Required Experience** 



* 10 to 14 years in structured finance, capital markets, sukuk, Islamic finance, private credit, securitisation, receivables financing or specialist arranging
* Demonstrable Sharia\-structured execution on live deals. Murabaha, Wakala, Sukuk or Ijara applied in production, not theoretical.
* Capital markets experience including debt capital markets, sukuk issuance, structured notes or asset\-backed transactions
* Receivables financing, factoring, supply\-chain finance or working\-capital programme experience.
* Strong commercial judgement on term sheets, fee structures and sponsor economics.
* Experience working across ADGM, DIFC, DFSA, FSRA or comparable GCC and MENA regulatory environments.
* Ability to manage external counsel, fund administrators, custodians and partner licence\-holders.
* Willingness to learn and embed AI tools in day\-to\-day structuring work. Comfortable using AI for documentation, scenario testing, term\-sheet drafting, structure comparison and pattern recognition across deal libraries.



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* Private markets experience including private credit funds, real\-estate funds, infrastructure or alternatives
* Tokenisation, digital assets or blockchain\-based issuance exposure
* Direct relationships with mid\-market issuers, sponsors, asset managers and private credit originators across MENA, GCC, South Asia or Sub\-Saharan Africa.
* Prior experience codifying structuring playbooks, templates or repeat\-issuance frameworks.
* Existing exposure to AI tools applied to financial work (deal review, documentation drafting, model build, research synthesis).
* Team build and leadership experience.
* Comfort operating without a large platform underneath, in an early\-stage operating company



  





  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 In the first 90 days, you will have taken ownership of the live structuring book, mapped the forward pipeline, locked priority deal sequencing, started the first playbook codification, and identified the first two or three AI tooling levers for the structuring workflow. In the first 12 months, success means closed mandates with locked fee economics, the first three named structuring playbooks in production, AI tooling embedded in at least two playbooks (with measurable time\-to\-launch compression), a working post\-issuance servicing model on receivables programmes, and a hiring case for the next structuring team member.
 



  





  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive fixed compensation.
* Performance\-linked bonus tied to closed mandates, structuring fee revenue and playbook delivery.
* Equity or carry participation aligned to long\-term value creation
* Clear trajectory to Senior Director or MD as pipeline, AUM and team scale.
* Direct exposure to the CEO, partners, sponsors and Sharia governance.
* A foundational role in building a Sharia\-aligned tokenisation platform from the structuring layer up, with AI tooling embedded into the workflow from inception.
