data.jd_text:
**About Arada**
 Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Sharjah, UAE, Arada was created to build spaces that inspire, connect, and enrich communities. As one of the region’s fastest\-growing master developers, Arada has delivered landmark residential, retail, hospitality, and lifestyle destinations that redefine modern living.
   

  

 At Arada, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and high\-performance culture where talented professionals are empowered to make a meaningful impact on the communities we create.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Lead the independent Cost Control Audit \& Governance function across pre\- and post\-contract stages for Arada’s portfolio. Operating as a mandatory control point, this role ensures absolute baseline integrity, strictly audits commercial recommendations prior to package awards, and enforces rigorous governance over the Forecast Final Cost (FFC) versus project budget, disciplined cost governance, and financial visibility for all projects. The role drives cost strategy, reporting integrity, and team capability development.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Pre\-Award Independent Audit \& Gateway Control
* Mandatory Tender Sign\-Off: Review, audit, and provide formal feedback on all Pre\-Tender Estimates (PTE) and Tender Recommendation Reports before any package finalization.
* Independent Budget Verification: Act as an independent control point to cross\-verify procurement and commercial tender returns against the approved business case.
* Executive Gateway Reporting: Prepare and present concise "Gate Review" commercial analysis briefs to the Project Controls Director, CDO, and CEO, explicitly highlighting budget variances and risks prior to contract award.
* Design\-Stage Cost Checks: Monitor schematic and detailed design progressions to flag budget deviations early, forcing mandatory Value Engineering (VE) triggers if baselines are breached.
* Post\-Award Budget Governance \& FFC Control
* Budget vs. FFC Reconciliation: Own the monthly audit of Budget versus Forecast Final Cost (FFC) across all active assets. Identify and challenge hidden cost overruns or optimistic forecasting by project site teams.
* Contingency Drawdown Audit: Establish and enforce strict governance over project risks and contingencies. Validate that any drawdown request is backed by robust data and contractually justified.
* Trend Log \& Early Warning Governance: Implement and oversee an active Trend Log system to capture potential variations, design changes, and claims weeks before they manifest as formal commercial risks.
* Cost Monitoring, Reporting \& BI Automation
* Data Integrity Auditing: Validate and sign off on all monthly cost reports, cash flow projections, and cost\-to\-complete metrics, ensuring they represent a single source of truth.
* Executive Dashboards: Drive the development of automated, live Power BI dashboards for the C\-suite, focusing strictly on Management by Exception by flagging projects tracking outside a 5% variance threshold.
* Proprietary Benchmarking: Oversee the construction and maintenance of a live internal cost\-per\-square\-foot benchmarking database using historical data from completed Arada phases.
* Team Leadership \& Interface
* Internal Audit Team Management: Manage and mentor Senior Cost Controllers and Analysts, instilling a culture of objective, data\-driven financial auditing.
* Cross\-Departmental Interface: Partner effectively with the established Pre\- and Post\-Contract Commercial, Procurement, and Project Management teams while maintaining strict departmental independence.

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced
 **Project Manager** 
 to join a large\-scale operations transformation and technology modernization program within a leading international organization. This role sits within a broader enterprise transformation initiative and is responsible for managing a dedicated workstream supporting the migration of operational capabilities from legacy platforms to a modern enterprise solution. The Project Manager will work closely with operational and technical teams to coordinate activities, manage dependencies, and support the successful delivery of the wider program objectives.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be comfortable operating within a multi\-stream environment, collaborating with parallel project teams and external vendors while ensuring that operational requirements are effectively represented throughout the delivery lifecycle. This is an excellent opportunity for a Project Manager with experience in enterprise system migrations and operational transformation who enjoys working at the intersection of business operations and technology delivery.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Workstream Project Management
   

  

* Manage a dedicated workstream within a larger transformation program.
* Coordinate the migration of operational functions from legacy systems into a unified enterprise platform.
* Support project planning, governance, status reporting, risk tracking, and dependency management across the assigned workstream.
* Collaborate with adjacent workstreams to ensure delivery activities remain aligned with the overall program roadmap.
* Facilitate the successful transition of users, processes, and operational capabilities onto the target platform.


 Operations Transformation
   

  

* Support the migration of key operational functions, including:
+ Helpline Services
+ Pre\-certification Processes
+ Claims Processing
+ Direct Billing
+ Reimbursement
+ Policy Administration
+ International Health Insurance operational processes

* Ensure operational requirements are clearly understood and reflected throughout project delivery.
* Support the adoption of new processes and ways of working while maintaining business continuity.


 Business \& Technology Coordination
   

  

* Act as a key link between operational teams and technology delivery teams.
* Work closely with technical specialists responsible for data integration, reporting, platform enhancements, and vendor\-delivered solutions.
* Coordinate cross\-functional inputs and help manage dependencies across multiple workstreams.
* Support the alignment of business needs with technical delivery activities.


 Defect \& Issue Management
   

  

* Coordinate defect and issue management activities across the workstream.
* Ensure operational requirements are represented during testing and validation activities.
* Support the tracking, prioritization, and resolution of system and process issues.
* Help ensure that system performance and usability align with operational expectations.


 Stakeholder Collaboration
   

  

* Build effective working relationships with operational teams, business users, technical delivery teams, and external partners.
* Facilitate workshops, project meetings, and regular progress updates.
* Ensure communication remains clear across all functions involved in the transformation program.

 Key Requirements
   

  

* Proven experience as a Project Manager supporting business and technology transformation initiatives.

* Strong understanding of operational process transformation.

 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience within the insurance or financial services sector.
* Exposure to health insurance operations, claims processing, policy administration, billing, or reimbursement functions.

* Familiarity with Agile or hybrid project delivery methodologies.
* Project Management certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile are advantageous.


 Other Details
   

  

 This consulting assignment is based in Dubai and is part of a business transformation initiative within the insurance sector, focusing on technology migration and operations transformation.

data.jd_text:
**Responsibilities:** 



* Provide inputs to the development of the overall division strategy and participate in developing the business unit strategy in line with the vision, mission, and business objectives of the company.
* Deliver the Facilities Management strategy while ensuring contractual commitments are successfully met.
* Manage the effective achievement of the business unit’s objectives through leading the Facilities and Operations team in the assigned project, by setting individual objectives, managing performance, developing and motivating staff, and providing formal and informal feedback and appraisals in order to maximize the subordinates’ and the business unit’s performance.
* Contribute and assist the director of operations in defining an optimum structure for the business unit/ division so that resources are optimally utilized, and communication takes place in an efficient manner.
* Recommend and oversee the budget for the business unit and monitor financial performance versus the budget so that the business is aware of anticipated costs/ revenues, areas of unsatisfactory performance and potential areas of cost reduction are identified, and performance improvement opportunities are realized.
* Lead and manage the Facilities Management function while ensuring the planning and allocation of all resources, and the implementation of the appropriate standards and controls to ensure that all the unit activities are carried out in an efficient and effective manner to meet and exceed unit objectives.
* Discuss “Side\-Specific\-Budgets” with customers including CAPEX for example, advise the customers on expenditures, opportunities for cost reductions, and the viability/ feasibility of changing/ buying assets (such as changing a chiller for example) to ensure customers’ budgeting is as appropriate and as accurate as possible.
* Develop and monitor SLAs for the assets, and ensure that they are aligned to service delivery, client expectations, and expectations from suppliers / service partners in order to achieve quality service delivery, effective supplier relationship management, and profitability.
* Monitor service delivery performance and lead the evaluation of suppliers’ performance to ensure the selection of appropriately qualified service providers at the optimum price in order to deliver the expected quality of service.
* Monitor resource utilization to ensure that the right number and talent is available for running operations (projects, civil works, mechanical works, electrical works, landscaping, building inspections, etc.), accomplishing targets, improving customer satisfaction, and achieving business objectives.
* Monitor and control the execution of maintenance contracts, review the preventive and corrective maintenance programs, and supervise the implementation by employees or assigned contractor(s) through reviewing reports and spot\-checking as appropriate to ensure the provision of quality maintenance works to the facilities (including maintenance to audio visual equipment, BMS, chillers, generators, HVAC, IT, etc.).
* Attend all coordination meetings with the tenants and contractors to discuss the progress of the fit out works and collect the required documentation, carry out an overall inspection after the completion of the fit out works, prepare the snag list to for the tenant, and follow up on all rectification works needed.
* Monitor the request for quotations and the preparation of Purchase Orders and Vendor Contracts, approve same, and ensure that the purchasing process is optimized to guarantee the provision of products/ services to the company/ customer on time and avoid any operational delays.
* Ensure that the Annual Leave Planer is completed to have a holistic view on forecasted leaves and employees’ availabilities throughout the year so as to guarantee that the appropriate resourcing is done and that business operations do not get interrupted.
* Manage customers’ expectations through clear communication and transparent work attitude in order to be consistent and to develop strong customer relationships.
* Receive escalated problems and complaints from the Call Centre and ensure that the necessary support and maintenance work is provided to customers in a timely fashion in order to resolve customers’ issues (pertaining to cooling, power, ventilation, plumbing, etc.) and maintain their high levels of satisfaction.
* Escort customers on daily tours within the premises/ facilities, listen to any feedback or complaints they might have, and delegate any work needed to the subordinates in order to provide customers with the necessary civil, mechanical, electrical, etc. support and maintenance support.
* Provide technical advice to customers and represent customers in technical interfaces with third parties (such as dealing with contractors conducting any construction work on premises while ensuring that they are delivering according to the agreement) as well as furnish customers with technical advice on improvement opportunities (such as reducing utility consumption and bills) in order to increase CSR awareness and contribute in achieving a greener environment.
* Manage the implementation and improvement of policies, guidelines, and processes for contract management and administration to ensure standards are set so that all business requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality service to customers in line with the corporate strategy.
* Manage the process of revising contracts’ scope of work, renewing the contract while recommending changes, conducting pricing, and negotiating the contract with the customer while coordinating the Terms \& Conditions of the contract with the Legal department to ensure alignment with internal policies and any external laws and regulations.
* Lead and monitor the subcontracting of works (such as fire systems, gas, emergency lighting, vertical transportation, water treatment, tank cleaning, etc.), ensure that subcontractors fulfil their duties in an accurate manner and as per the agreed upon contractual clauses, and manage subcontractors’ evaluations and negotiations while ensuring that chosen subcontractors are approved by the relevant authorities to guarantee compliance with the regulatory framework (such as any approvals needed from the Civil Defense Department for fire\-fighting systems).
* Ensure effective planning and implementation of HSEEQ inspections and audits in order to meet regulatory requirements and company standards.
* Monitor physical and documentation audits being conducted on subcontractors to ensure that work is being conducted properly and that customers are being served with the highest quality standards, and take the necessary actions upon the detection of unreported/ undisclosed variations and/ or poor performance to safeguard the company against any liabilities.
* Lead the audits of staff, customers, and suppliers to gather feedback and monitor satisfaction in order to improve the operations and facilities management services the company provides.
* Develop and ensure the implementation of division policies, procedures, and controls covering all areas of activity so that all relevant procedural/ legislative requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality and cost\-effective service.
* Ensure compliance to all relevant quality, health, safety, and environmental management policies, procedures, and controls across the department to guarantee employee safety, legislative compliance, delivery of high quality products/ service and a responsible environmental attitude.
* Ensure corrective actions and preventive actions issued by the HSEEQ department are implemented, update the HSEEQ department about the progress of the implementation.
* Ensure the legionella reporting is timely sent to HSEEQ department.
* Ensure the HIRAs are finalized and yearly updated, with support of the HSEQ department.
* Ensure the risk control measures arising from the HIRA are properly implemented.
* Ensure availability of MS and RA



  





**Qualifications, Experiences, Skills**



* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, preferably with a Master’s degree in Management or Facilities Management; CMMS knowledge is also preferable
* 10 – 12 years’ experience in operations management including 5 years in a managerial role; exposure to Maintenance and Facilities Management in hospitality projects.

**Fuel your passion**
 The
 **Integrated Commercial Director – Field Development** 
 is responsible for leading complex commercial and proposal activities for integrated upstream field development opportunities. The role develops commercial frameworks, supports customer negotiations, and ensures proposals and agreements deliver shareholder value while addressing technical, operational, financial, and contractual risks.
   

  

 This position requires strong E\&P business development experience, knowledge of upstream field development practices, and the ability to translate end\-to\-end technical development plans into fit\-for\-purpose commercial structures.
   

  

**As an Integrated Commercial Director \- Field Development, you will be responsible for:**
* Develop proposals; may negotiate with customers; ensure deals deliver shareholder value; drive competitive pricing. May include compiling and submitting required tender documentation.
* Handle complex products, services, and systems requiring technical knowledge and understanding of the environment where the products or systems will be used. Products and systems are client\-specific and require technical analysis and system design to fit client conditions.
* Lead the commercial structuring of integrated field development opportunities, including pricing, scope definition, contracting strategy, risk allocation, and customer value proposition.
* Apply knowledge of upstream development practices across geoscience and engineering disciplines to support technically informed commercial solutions.
* Understand the technical context of end\-to\-end field development plans and develop accompanying commercial frameworks that support customer and business objectives.
* Manage complex long\-term sales processes. Contracts involve pricing and conditions of sales, rental, operation, maintenance, services, integrated solutions, and other field development\-related commercial arrangements.
* Support drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial agreements related to E\&P business development, including asset acquisition, joint operating agreements, commercial partnerships, and associated liabilities.
* Handle important business unit clients and senior customer interfaces.
* Coordinate sales teams involving engineering, legal, risk, finance, operations, product lines, and leadership.
* Participate in major sales and business development activities involving large, complex, or strategically important opportunities.
* Handle big or highly complex markets with large potential for growth.
* Ensure proposals and negotiated agreements comply with internal governance, risk management, approval processes, and shareholder value expectations.


**To be successful in this role you will:**
* Have a bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college.
* Have 10\+ years of experience working as a commercial advisor in an E\&P business development function.
* Have 10\+ years of experience drafting commercial agreements and negotiating terms related to asset acquisition, joint operating agreements, and associated liabilities.
* Have strong knowledge of upstream development practices across geoscience and engineering disciplines.
* Have the ability to understand the technical context of an end\-to\-end field development plan and structure an accompanying commercial framework.

* Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

 Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well\-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
   

  

**Working for you**
 Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:
   

  

  

* Contemporary work\-life balance policies and wellbeing activities

**What Will You Do**
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Business System Leader to drive the evolution and deployment of the Johnson Controls Business System across the EMEA region. In this highly strategic role, you will partner closely with senior leadership to translate business strategy into execution, build organizational capability, and deliver sustainable, measurable performance improvements.

* Demonstrated success leading large\-scale transformation and capability\-building initiatives

* Familiarity with digital transformation and analytics tools supporting operational excellence

data.jd_text:
**Confidential Opportunity – Head of Risk (UAE Regulated Financial Services)** 




  





 We are seeking an experienced Head of Risk to join a growing regulated financial services organization in the UAE.
 



  





 This is a unique opportunity for a risk leader who enjoys building, shaping, and scaling risk functions within a fast\-paced environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for the overall risk management framework of the business while remaining closely involved in the operational execution of risk management activities.
 



 The role is subject to regulatory approval and fit\-and\-proper assessment by the relevant UAE regulatory authority. The successful candidate will serve as the designated Head of Risk and principal risk management officer for the organization
 



  





 Unlike larger financial institutions with extensive risk departments, this position requires a balance of strategic leadership and hands\-on execution. The successful candidate must be comfortable operating at Board and regulator level while also driving the day\-to\-day development and enhancement of the risk function.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own and continuously enhance the Enterprise Risk Management Framework (ERM)
* Develop and maintain risk governance structures, policies, and reporting frameworks
* Establish and monitor risk appetite statements, risk registers, and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs)
* Lead enterprise\-wide risk assessments across operational, regulatory, technology, strategic, and emerging risks
* Prepare and present risk reporting to Executive Committees, Risk Committees, and Board\-level forums
* Act as the primary risk management contact for regulatory engagement and supervisory reviews
* Provide effective challenge and risk oversight across business functions
* Build and develop the Risk function in line with the organization's growth trajectory
* Support the development of a strong risk culture across the organization



  





**Required Experience** 



* 8\-15 years of progressive risk management experience within regulated financial services
* Experience leading or owning an Enterprise Risk Management Framework
* Strong understanding of risk governance, risk appetite, risk assessments, and Board reporting
* Experience within fintech, payments, banking, EMI, acquiring, issuing, lending, or other regulated financial services environments
* Demonstrated experience engaging with regulators, executive management, and governance committees
* Ability to operate effectively in a growth\-stage environment where strategic and operational responsibilities coexist



  





**Ideal Candidate** 




 You will be a strong match if you have:
 


* Previously held a Head of Risk, Risk Director, Senior Risk Manager, or equivalent position within a regulated financial services environment
* Experience building or enhancing risk frameworks rather than simply maintaining mature structures
* The credibility and capability to satisfy regulatory fit\-and\-proper requirements for a Head of Risk appointment
* A pragmatic and commercial approach to risk management
* The willingness to remain involved in operational delivery while leading the strategic direction of the function


- 


**Please Note** 




 This role is best suited to candidates who enjoy combining strategic leadership with hands\-on execution. Individuals whose experience is limited to highly specialized risk functions within large organizations, or whose background is primarily audit, compliance advisory, assurance, or consulting without direct ownership of enterprise risk management, may find the scope and nature of this position less aligned to their experience.
 



 All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence

data.jd_text:
Are you ready to lead a busy Operations Control Centre that coordinates operational safety, efficiency and resilience across our network? At
 **SolitAir** 
 , we’re seeking an experienced and adaptable leader to establish and head the Integrated Operations Control Centre (IOCC). This role will set the strategy, build the team, and oversee integrated operational control functions that ensure safe, compliant and on\-time service delivery.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
 As Head of IOCC, you will:
   

  

* Establish and operationally manage the IOCC, including staffing, processes, tools and performance metrics to deliver 24/7 operational control.
* Lead cross\-functional coordination between flight operations, maintenance control, ground operations, cargo planning, safety, and regulatory liaison to resolve disruptions and maintain continuity.
* Drive problem solving for complex operational events by applying structured analysis, root cause identification, and timely corrective actions to minimise impact on safety and schedule.
* Develop flexible operating procedures and escalation frameworks to respond to dynamic operational conditions, including irregular operations, AOG events and severe weather.
* Implement and maintain integrated systems and dashboards that provide real\-time situational awareness and decision support for IOCC staff and senior leadership.
* Champion a culture of continuous improvement, capturing lessons learned, training requirements and process enhancements to reduce recurrence of operational disruptions.
* Ensure all IOCC activities comply with relevant regulatory requirements and company policies, and coordinate timely reporting to regulators and stakeholders as required.
* Provide clear, effective communication in English across internal teams and external partners during normal and contingency operations.


****What We’re Looking For****
* Experience: Proven background in airline or aviation operational control roles, with significant experience leading operational teams and managing irregular operations.
* Problem Solving: Strong analytical capability and structured problem solving skills, able to lead investigations, define root causes and implement robust corrective actions.
* Flexibility: Demonstrated adaptability to changing priorities and operational pressures; comfortable leading a 24/7 function with variable hours and rapid decision\-making demands. This means you are likely to work over weekends and/or evenings as operational demands require.
* English: Excellent written and spoken English with the ability to prepare clear reports, brief senior leadership and communicate effectively across diverse teams.
* Leadership \& Communication: Strong people leadership skills, able to recruit, develop and motivate a high\-performing, inclusive team; confident at stakeholder engagement and crisis communication.
* Systems \& Data: Comfortable with operational control systems, real\-time dashboards and data\-driven decision making; experience with industry tools is desirable.
* Qualifications: Relevant degree or professional qualifications in aviation, operations management or related field preferred.


 At SolitAir, every role contributes to shaping the future of cargo aviation. We welcome applicants who bring practical experience, a collaborative mindset, and a commitment to operational excellence. This is a gender neutral role and we are committed to providing equal opportunities for all candidates.
   

  

**What We Offer**
* An inclusive workplace with opportunities for professional growth and development.
* The chance to build and lead a new, and growing, high\-impact operational function at the heart of our business.
* A role that offers visibility and cross functional problem solving \- at SolitAir you'll be able to see the difference you make to the success of our business


 If you are an experienced operational leader with strong problem solving skills, flexibility and excellent English communication, we encourage you to apply and help shape SolitAir’s operational future.

 We operate at the intersection of culture, commerce and innovation. Whether launching new brands, acquiring established ones, or unlocking growth opportunities across our portfolio, we move quickly, think globally and challenge conventional ways of working.
 



  





**The Role** 




 This is not a traditional Chief of Staff role.

 You will work across every function of the business, helping shape strategy while ensuring critical initiatives are delivered.  The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking with relentless execution. We are less interested in career consultants and more interested in operators who have helped build, scale and transform businesses from the inside.
 



  





 This role is designed for someone with the ambition and capability to become a future GM, COO or CEO.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 CEO Office \& Strategic Execution
 


* Partner directly with the CEO on the company's most important priorities.
* Translate strategy into clear action plans, accountability and measurable outcomes.
* Drive execution of strategic initiatives across all functions.
* Monitor business performance and identify opportunities, risks and bottlenecks.

 AI, Technology \& Business Transformation

 Organisational Effectiveness

 Strategic Projects \& Corporate Development

 Internal \& Corporate Communications
 


* Support company\-wide communication of strategic priorities and transformation programmes.

 Talent \& Leadership Support
 


* Support organisational and leadership development initiatives.
* Help identify capability gaps and opportunities to strengthen the organisation.
* Work alongside senior leaders to improve team effectiveness and performance.

**What you’ll bring** 



* 5\+ years of experience in strategy, consulting, private equity, venture capital, technology, e\-commerce, consumer or high\-growth businesses.

data.jd_text:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 



 We are seeking a highly driven self\-starter with exceptional program\-level delivery experience to join Anaplan in UAE. This is a rare, high\-impact opportunity to lay the groundwork and shape the success of our most strategic enterprise customers across the Middle East.
 



 At Anaplan, we are redefining how businesses plan and make decisions through our cutting\-edge Connected Planning platform, powered by our unique deterministic calculation engine and advanced AI capabilities. In this role, you will be at the forefront of this transformation.
 



 You will bring a proven track record of leading complex, high\-stakes implementations—ideally within Supply Chain, Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A), or Workforce Planning. Thriving at the intersection of delivery and strategic advisory, you will scope, negotiate, manage escalations, and serve as an indispensable partner to both customer and internal stakeholders. From C\-level executives to daily end\-users, you will excel at influencing decisions and cementing your status as a trusted advisor.
 



 This is a hands\-on leadership position tailor\-made for a delivery expert who can seamlessly orchestrate multiple enterprise programs, ensure strict adherence to budget and scope, and expertly pivot to recover projects that have drifted off track.
 



**Your Impact (What You’ll Do)** 



* **Drive Delivery Excellence:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end Anaplan deployments alongside internal teams and external partners, establishing robust governance, ensuring precise scoping, and proactively uncovering hidden assumptions.
* **Be the Strategic Anchor:** 
 Serve as the primary point of contact for delivery, building alignment with customer stakeholders ranging from operational leads up to the C\-suite.
* **Master Complex Programs:** 
 Navigate intricate, multi\-faceted programs, ensuring flawless delivery while expertly balancing scope, risk, budget, and resourcing.
* **Accelerate Decision\-Making:** 
 Anticipate bottlenecks and drive critical project decisions across design, testing, timelines, and organizational change management.
* **Build Consensus:** 
 Leverage top\-tier negotiation skills to resolve conflicts, maintain project momentum, and unite diverse teams behind a shared goal.
* **Champion Excellence:** 
 Advocate for and implement the "Anaplan Way" methodology, ensuring the delivery of scalable, highly intuitive, and user\-friendly solutions.
* **Deliver Transparency:** 
 Provide clear, actionable reporting on project status and overall portfolio health to both internal leadership and external stakeholders.



**Your DNA (What You Bring)** 



* **Enterprise Expertise:** 
 Demonstrable history of exemplary program or project management across complex, large\-scale enterprise initiatives.
* **Agile Mastery:** 
 Deep, hands\-on experience in Agile project delivery methodologies—this is essential for driving our fast\-paced implementations.
* **Turnaround Architect:** 
 Proven ability to recover and realign complex projects led by partners or vendors. We are looking for a track record of delivering—and rescuing—large\-scale projects under tight timelines and budgets.
* **Executive Influence:** 
 Exceptional customer engagement and communication skills, characterized by the ability to negotiate, influence senior leadership, and confidently act as a trusted strategic advisor.
* **Domain Knowledge (Bonus):** 
 While not strictly essential, domain expertise in Supply Chain, FP\&A, or Workforce Planning will highly differentiate your application.



**Why Join Us?** 
 As the first Principal Solution Implementation Manager in the region, you won't just be managing projects; you will be building a legacy. You'll work with industry\-defining AI and planning technology, partner with the world's leading brands, and have a tangible impact on how global enterprises operate.
 



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 



 Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
 At Emirates, we believe in connecting the world, to and through our global hub in Dubai, and in constantly innovating to ensure our customers 'Fly Better’.
   

  

 Emirates Group IT thrives on the dynamic nature of technology. Being pioneers in aviation innovation, we're always at the forefront, pushing boundaries. We're on the lookout for exceptional IT professionals to fortify our position as leaders in the industry. Embark on a journey with the world’s largest international airline and become a vital part of our cutting\-edge information and technology team as an
 **Agile Delivery Manager \- SkyCargo** 
 .
   

  

 We are hiring a Delivery Manager with strong experience in Aviation Cargo or Logistics to lead large\-scale, AI\-driven in\-house development initiatives. The role also requires proven expertise in managing RFT processes, vendor selection, and end\-to\-end implementation of technology solutions. The ideal candidate will drive delivery excellence, stakeholder alignment, and innovation across complex, multi\-vendor environments.
   

  

 As the
 **Agile Delivery Manager \- SkyCargo** 
 , you will be responsible for planning, leading, organising, and motivating scrum teams either within a Release Train or outside to achieve a high level of performance and quality in the delivery of outputs that provide exceptional value to end users and customers. The Agile Delivery Manager may be responsible for managing several concurrent high\-visibility initiatives using agile/hybrid (for Package Acquisition) methods in a fast\-paced environment that may involve multiple business units.
   

  

**In This Role You Will**
* Facilitate key ceremonies such as PI planning and Review, and play a consultative role to help put in place the appropriate people, processes, and tools supporting the Agile framework and coaching members of the team as needed to optimize the efficiency of the Release Train team.
* Act as a Champion in blending traditional project management principles and practices with an Agile development approach in the right proportions to fit initiatives of all sizes with the appropriate level of planning and provide the right balance of agility and predictability based on PMI\-ACP principles.
* Build a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame or retribution, with an emphasis on healing and problem\-solving. Protect and provide all support to the team/s using a servant leadership style whenever possible and lead by example. Facilitate getting the work done, practicing servant leadership, and encourage discussion, decision making,g and conflict resolution.
* Lead the Integrated Programme Planning (Lean Start Up). Working with portfolio teams and supporting the Technical Product Manager, drive and facilitate decomposition of Epic Roadmaps into Integrated Program backlog/plans (Features), ready for hand off into team\-level backlogs.
* Drive Quality and ensure the Definition of Done (DOD) is being followed; ensure each team member is fully engaged in the stories and making a meaningful contribution. Encourage a sustainable pace, adhering to the agreed quality management plan with the team. Maintain an agile project management tool (e.g., ScrumDesk, JIRA, etc.).
* Assist in team development through holding teams accountable for their commitments, removing roadblocks to their work, leveraging cross\-functional team skills to improve product backlog throughput, and mentoring and developing team members. Attend regular stand\-ups and scrum of scrums, in order to understand the team's progress and issues, and to flag up to the team, where necessary, any important external issues of which they need to be aware.
* Supports the Technical Product Manager in managing business expectations and transparency in both the product backlog and schedule for all initiatives. Supports IT Service Manager on service management, service performance, and continuous improvements.
* Define and manage a well\-defined process and champion ongoing process improvement initiatives to implement best practices for Agile Delivery Management. Implement an agile governance with key ceremonies, drives continuous improvement with constant assessments of velocity (team story point throughput), defect percentage improvements, etc., and also ensures that required governance and ceremonies are in place to give visibility and transparency to business stakeholders.
* Assist with the cost estimation/sizing exercise for both near\-term and future initiatives, and assist with preparing the total cost of ownership with the product team, maintain the actuals within the allocated budget, and ensure that forecasting for all the demands is accurately done for the FY.
* Together with the Product team, supports the RFx phases in the procurement process and the scheduling of such activities in relation to the product lifecycle.


 Qualification
   

  

**To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:**
* A Degree or Honours (12\+3\) or equivalent in Computer Engineering, or Software Engineering.
* 8\+ years of experience within Information Technology with proven leadership and project delivery experience in a matrix organisation with global teams for a large organisation.
* Experience in agile delivery within the context of a large technology change programme.
* Certified SAFe and PMI ACP (additional certifications such as PMI, PRINCE2, CSM desirable) with 5\+ Years of practical application of the Scrum Management discipline.
* Well\-versed in the use of tools of software delivery, e.g., ServiceNow ITBM, MS OFFICE suite, JIRA, Confluence, etc.
* Good architectural knowledge of large\-scale systems.
* Ability to effectively communicate specialist information in an understandable format to all stakeholders.
* Excellent communication skills, focusing on core Scrum values of openness, honesty, and respect.
* Hands\-on leader with strong people skills.
* Aviation Cargo or Logistics domain experience is preferred.


**Leadership Role:** 
 Yes
   

  

 Salary \& benefits
   

  

 Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax\-free salary. On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this managerial role also has an excellent leave and healthcare package. That’s on top of transport benefits, life insurance, and more. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast\-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers

data.jd_text:
KEO is a creative enterprise, where innovation is a way of life. We are uniquely resourced with end\-to\-end services to take clients from inspiration – through conceptualization – to realization of planning, design or project delivery in the built and natural environments. For over 60 years we’ve led with vision, contributing to many of the world’s most ambitious projects, iconic places, remarkable experiences and prosperous communities.
 



  





 As a highly integrated and agile AEP/PMCM firm, KEO is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. We are also ranked by World Architecture as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the \#1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey.
 



  





 We invite you to join us. Why?
 



  





 When you join KEO, you’ll discover more than just a job – you’ll find a supportive environment that fosters your professional development through internal global mobility and career development and does so within a culture that supports company\-wide health and well\-being through on\-demand counselling services and regular workplace clinics. You will be invited to celebrate community events such as sports days, fun\-runs, in\-house sports teams and beach clean ups. In addition to your competitive package and benefits you will have access to a suite of policies that include hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, employee referral rewards.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





 Our newest opportunity is for a talented Cloud and Infrastructure Platforms Director to to join our award\-winning team based in Dubai, UAE.
 



  





 This critical leadership role is responsible for defining, delivering, and managing the organization’s enterprise cloud, infrastructure, and platform strategy across regional and international operations. The successful candidate will lead the modernization of IT infrastructure, cloud adoption, cybersecurity resilience, digital workplace technologies, and enterprise platform services to support a rapidly growing construction consultancy business.
 



  





 The role requires a highly experienced technology leader with a strong background in hybrid cloud environments, enterprise infrastructure operations, IT governance, cybersecurity, and large\-scale transformation initiatives within complex, multi\-site organizations.
 



  





 We envisage success in this role to include;
 



  





**Strategic \& Platform Leadership** 




  




* Define and execute KEO's cloud\-first, platform\-first infrastructure strategy, leading the evolution from traditional operations toward a modern platform engineering model that enables self\-service, automated, and product\-oriented infrastructure capabilities.
* Manage and continuously improve service reliability at enterprise scale, owning KEO's infrastructure performance and availability posture in alignment with digital transformation goals and business priorities.



  





**Cloud \& Platform Engineering** 




  




* Own and evolve KEO's Microsoft Azure environment, leading the design, deployment, and lifecycle management of IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS platforms through cloud\-native architectures, infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC), and platform engineering principles to ensure scalability, security, cost\-optimization, and developer agility.
* Oversee identity and access management via Microsoft Entra ID, enforcing MFA, RBAC, and least\-privilege principles, and manage KEO's zero\-trust network architecture ensuring access is granted only through verified identity, context, and policy.
* Maintain certified digital platforms \- including Microsoft SharePoint and Autodesk Construction Cloud \- to their respective security and governance standards.
* Drive cloud cost optimization initiatives \- including right\-sizing, reserved capacity management, and workload scheduling \- to maximize return on cloud investment.



  





**Cybersecurity \& Digital Trust** 




  




* Champion KEO's cybersecurity posture across all infrastructure and platform operations, overseeing Microsoft Sentinel (SIEM) for real\-time threat detection, automated response playbooks, and rapid incident management, alongside cloud security posture management (CSPM) for continuous assessment and remediation of misconfigurations and vulnerabilities.
* Ensure zero\-trust, least\-privilege, and access control governance principles are consistently applied and independently verified via EY audits, and lead KEO's phishing simulation programme to drive continuous improvements in security awareness.
* Maintain and continuously improve Business Continuity Planning (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) programmes \- including automation of recovery workflows, regular testing, and audit\-readiness \- with appropriate escalation to IT leadership and executive oversight.



  





**Modern Service Management** 




  




* Lead a shift from traditional ITIL\-process orientation toward experience\-driven, outcome\-based service management, owning service reliability engineering practices including SLAs, SLOs, and error budgets across all platforms.
* Lead continuous service improvement cycles, platform lifecycle governance, and technology refresh programmes, ensuring all operations adhere to KEO's IT governance standards, security policies, regulatory requirements, and green IT sustainability commitments.



  





**Automation, DevOps \& SRE Mindset** 




  




* Champion an automation\-first culture, leading the implementation of infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipeline integration, self\-service cloud provisioning, and zero\-touch operations to eliminate manual processes at scale.
* Apply Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles \- including error budgets, reliability targets, and blameless post\-incident reviews \- to drive continuous improvement in platform deployment velocity, reliability, and recovery time.



  





**Data\-Driven \& AI\-Enabled Operations** 




  




* Lead the adoption of observability platforms and AIOps tooling to enable predictive performance monitoring, anomaly detection, and automated incident response, driving responsible AI adoption to enhance infrastructure efficiency, intelligent capacity planning, and proactive operations
* Use operational telemetry and data\-driven insights to inform platform investment decisions and continuous improvement initiatives, staying at the forefront of AI\-driven infrastructure operations and edge computing to evaluate and recommend adoption pathways aligned to KEO's strategy.



  





**Team Leadership \& People Development** 




  




* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing, geographically distributed infrastructure team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Set clear goals, provide regular feedback, and champion professional growth and certification of each team member.
* Build a psychologically safe team environment where automation innovation, constructive challenge, and knowledge sharing are actively encouraged.
* Promote cross\-functional collaboration with Digital Workplace, Enterprise Digital Solutions, and Technology Strategy teams to ensure “one IT” delivery



  





**Qualifications** 




  





 To be successful in this dynamic opportunity, we envision that your career journey to date will include 10–15\+ years of progressive experience in enterprise IT infrastructure, including a minimum of 3–5 years in a leadership capacity managing teams, cloud platforms, or enterprise infrastructure operations. You will hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or possess an equivalent combination of education and over 10 years of relevant professional experience.
 



  




* Proven, hands\-on experience managing Microsoft Azure cloud environments at enterprise scale, including hybrid cloud architecture, identity, and security services.
* Demonstrated experience leading a shift from traditional infrastructure management to modern platform engineering and DevOps\-aligned operations.
* Strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD for infrastructure, self\-service cloud provisioning, and zero\-touch operations.
* Experience applying Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles, including error budgets, SLOs, and blameless post\-incident review practices.
* Proven cloud financial management (FinOps) experience: cost optimization, chargeback models, consumption governance, and cloud cost dashboards.
* Deep expertise in cybersecurity operations: Microsoft Sentinel (SIEM), zero\-trust architecture, cloud security posture management (CSPM), Entra ID / Azure AD, and endpoint security.
* Experience managing third\-party governance and audit review processes.
* Familiarity with AI\-driven infrastructure operations, edge computing architectures, and platform product models.
* Experience in the AEC (Architecture, Engineering, and Construction) or professional services sector is advantageous.
* Understanding of sustainable/green IT infrastructure principles and their application to cloud operations.



  





 KEO’s performance is founded upon integrity, results, innovation, safety and our people. We embrace diversity and recognise its’ contribution to client success wherever we work.
 



  





 We are excited to hear how you can partner with our award\-winning team and treat all expressions of interest confidentially.

**Who We Are:** 
 At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award\-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest\-growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
   

  

**Summary:** 
 We're seeking a strategic and hands\-on
 **Head of Post\-Production** 
 to lead and elevate Huda Beauty's video content function. In this role, you will own the post\-production vision across brand campaigns, social\-first content, and marketing initiatives, while managing and mentoring a team of four in\-house editors.
   

  

 You'll work closely with Creative, Marketing, and Social teams to ensure best\-in\-class output, efficient workflows, and consistent on\-time delivery. This role requires deep post\-production expertise, strong leadership, and the ability to operate in a fast\-paced, high\-volume content environment. You'll be responsible for setting creative and technical standards, streamlining operations, developing talent, and ensuring creative excellence from concept through final delivery.
   

  

 This is a hybrid role: highly strategic, yet hands\-on when needed \- supporting shoots, defining technical approaches, and building a scalable ecosystem of videographers and freelance partners.
   

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Manage and mentor a team of 4 editors
* Lead, plan, and manage post\-production for a full slate of video projects
* Manage post\-production schedules and traffic control
* Create and implement processes and workflows that enable the team to work efficiently and independently
* Guide team development, helping junior members grow towards independence
* Oversee branded storytelling, ensuring delivery of best\-in\-class assets in line with brand vision
* Juggle multiple high\-priority post\-production projects in various stages, ensuring deadlines are met
* Identify workflow gaps in post\-production and lead continuous improvement initiatives
* Develop and refine a distinctive Huda Beauty editing style \- color grading, motion graphics/animation, sound design
* Work closely with the Head of Agency to build efficient project tracking, workflow systems, and deadline rigor
* Be a force for innovation \- integrate AI or other new tools into video production where appropriate
* Build robust storage solutions and archives
* Maintain a network of freelancers/vendors to scale up for projects when needed


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years' experience in post\-production management or a closely related field
* Deep understanding of all areas of post‑production: editing, color grading, VFX, sound design
* Ability to manage multiple projects at once under tight deadlines
* Experience working in agency, brand in\-house, or post\-production house environments
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, align, and drive decisions across multiple teams
* Prior experience managing teams of 5\+ direct reports and freelancers
* Proficient with editing software (Premiere Pro is required; After Effects, etc.)
* Excellent creativity, communication, and attention to detail
* Social\-first mindset with a deep understanding of digital and platform\-native video content


**Benefits**
* Monthly "Self Love Days" (at company discretion)
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in\-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting


*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.
   

  

 Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross\-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard\-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.
   

  

 That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.
   

  

 Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry\-changing realities.
   

  

 For our business, for clients, and for you
   

  

**REGIONAL HEAD OF OPERATIONS – CLOSE ENDED (MIDDLE EAST)**
**Location: UAE**
**About Apex:**
 The Apex Group is a global financial services provider with over 13,000 employees across 85 offices globally. We look to recruit bright, articulate, and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge and are prepared to work hard and love what they do.
   

  

 Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today and the more we grow, the more important that becomes. Whatever your career path or specialism, Apex provides a global platform to allow you to thrive.
   

  

**The role:**
 Apex Group has created a regionalised operational organisation structure, divided into sub\-product segments, that enables Apex to sustain service delivery levels of the highest standards and maximize productivity and efficiencies.
   

  

 In this position you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end operational performance of the closed\-ended funds business in the different countries within the Middle East region, reporting to the Regional head of Fund Solutions – MEAIM.
   

  

 You should have extensive experience in the administration of close\-ended funds. You should have a proven track record of demonstrating your knowledge of fund accounting and a proven track record in leading multi\-jurisdictional operational platforms.. The role requires a strong combination of operational leadership, client delivery excellence, commercial awareness and transformation capability.
   

  

**Technical Tasks:**
* Oversee and lead the end\-to\-end delivery of the fund accounting service for close\-ended funds, ensuring accuracy and compliance with fund governing documents and regulatory guidance.
* Provide leadership on complex client and operational matters requiring senior judgment.
* Ensure full adherence to the prevailing control environment.
* Be a leading participant in the continuous development of our operating processes and procedures.
* Be an escalation point for technical queries from all stakeholders in your region.
* Oversee the timely completion of all audits.
* Ensure local teams’ adherence to regulatory compliance and underlying reporting.


**Tasks/Responsibilities:**

* Develop and foster client relationships and ensure we exceed their expectations and are their provider of choice.
* Team collaboration across multiple jurisdictions globally including global operations centres and ensure that client deliverables are being met.
* Monitoring of actual versus target hours per fund/client and action as required. Ensure there is a continuous drive to improve our efficiency.
* Contribute to the achievement of regional financial and operational performance targets.
* Ensure effective \& timely resolutions to any errors identified.
* KPI’s to be consistently above the specified target for each team in your region (accuracy, timeliness, and delivery)

* People management with a focus on development, motivation, and succession planning/talent management.
* Identify training needs within your teams in the region and interact with our training department.
* Manage employee performance and salary review process.
* Partner with the relevant Country Head, HR lead and senior leadership team to implement effective strategies for employee engagement and retention.
* Ensure adherence to all internal and external audit standards.
* Ensure stakeholder awareness, engagement, and support through effective and timely communication.
* Actively support Groups strategy, plans, and values, contributing to the achievement of a high\-performance culture.
* Demonstrate visible leadership and promote collaboration and accountability across the multi\-jurisdictional teams.
* Develop, maintain and role model a culture that is open to change and innovation, and supports collaboration, respect, and accountability.
* Maintain knowledge of industry trends.


**Skills Required:**

* Strong accountancy knowledge, a professional designation such as CA, CPAA, or ACCA etc., would be an asset.
* Solid experience working with private markets / closed\-ended fund structures across multiple jurisdictions.
* Extensive practical experience, 15\+ years of fund accounting work experience.
* Experience managing a large team / managing regional or multi\-location teams.
* Extensive experience working with external clients and an ability to inspire confidence.
* Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English (both verbal and written).

* Ability to resolve complex issues in a timely manner.
* Advanced level MS Excel, proficient with MS Word, MS PowerPoint.

* A friendly, co\-operative, and supportive environment.

* An opportunity to make an impact in a leading product for Apex.

data.jd_text:
HKA is a leading global consultancy in risk mitigation, dispute resolution, expert witness and litigation support. We anticipate, investigate and resolve complex challenges by harnessing world\-leading multi\-disciplinary expertise and experience.
   

  

 As trusted independent consultants, experts and advisors, we deliver solutions amid uncertainty, dispute and overrun, and provide the insights that make the best possible outcomes a reality for public and private sector clients worldwide. Our experts have testified across the globe on many of the largest quantum, delay, engineering and commercial damages matters.
   

  

**At HKA, You Can Expect**
* A genuinely collaborative culture where we invest in growing our FACD practice and your career together.
* A pivotal role in shaping the future of our FACD offering across EMEA and globally.
* The opportunity to leverage HKA’s reputation as one of the world’s most respected expert witness firms to accelerate the growth of your valuation and financial damages portfolio.
* Access to an outstanding expert platform, cutting\-edge methodologies and a global network of specialists.


**The Opportunity**
 As a Senior Manager / Associate Director in our Forensic Accounting \& Commercial Damages (FACD) team, you’ll be part of a high‑performing global practice known for delivering market‑leading expert advisory services.
   

  

 This is an exciting stage for our Middle East team, offering the chance to step into a visible leadership role, working alongside Partners recognised internationally for their expertise in contentious valuations and forensic accounting.
   

  

**You will play a key role in the success and continued expansion of our International FACD practice by:**
* Leading substantial workstreams on complex disputes and managing smaller engagements end‑to‑end.
* Owning key client relationships and ensuring exceptional delivery.
* Guiding, coaching and developing junior colleagues as part of a growing team.
* Drafting articulate, concise and compelling expert reports, supporting our experts on high‑value disputes.
* Conducting and reviewing sophisticated financial, accounting and economic analyses with a high degree of technical rigour.
* Performing business valuations, using relevant tools and methodologies to generate robust and defensible opinions.
* Communicating insights and deliverables clearly to Partners, clients and legal teams.

data.jd_text:
Established in 2004, Dubai Holding is a global investment company with investments in more than 34 countries and a combined workforce of nearly 45,000 individuals. In line with the vision of Dubai’s leadership and economic diversification strategy, Dubai Holding companies have nurtured sectors, irrevocably transforming Dubai’s socio\-economic landscape and positioning Dubai as a diversified, globally integrated economy.
 



 Dubai Holding is committed to the diversification of Dubai’s non\-oil economy. Our portfolio, valued at over AED 280\+ billion, spans 10 sectors, including real estate, hospitality, leisure \& entertainment, ICT, design, education, media, retail, manufacturing \& logistics, and science.
 



  





**For the Good of Tomorrow** 




 Dubai Holding is currently seeking a
 **Senior Manager – Digital Services** 
 , reporting to the Director – Infrastructure Operations. The role holder is responsible for the strategy, delivery, and continuous evolution of the organisation's web platform ecosystem, spanning a portfolio of 100\+ digital properties, enterprise API integrations, cloud\-hosted web applications, and internal business automation solutions.
 



 The role holds end\-to\-end ownership of web platform operations across the organisation, orchestrating the combined capabilities of internal development teams, strategic third\-party vendors, and emerging technologies to deliver secure, performant, and accessible digital experiences at scale.
 



 A core contributor to the group\-wide digital strategy and technology roadmap, the role plays an integral role in shaping and executing the direction of the organization's web platform function — ensuring all solutions and initiatives are grounded in sound architectural principles, aligned to security, compliance, and governance requirements, and structured to deliver tangible business value.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities** 



* Define and own the organization's web platform architecture strategy, ensuring all digital solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned to business objectives.
* Act as the senior solution architect across all web development initiatives, bridging the gap between business requirements and technical delivery.
* Oversee the full lifecycle management of web platform components, from planning, procurement, and development through to deployment and decommissioning, operating within defined budgets, risk appetites, and compliance frameworks.
* Take executive ownership of the availability, stability, performance, and compliance of all web platform services — including 100\+ Web flow\-managed digital properties, Azure\-hosted web applications, and associated integration services — ensuring they remain fit for purpose and aligned with agreed service levels.
* Drive a proactive performance culture across the function, ensuring continuous monitoring, technical SEO and AEO optimization, analytics configuration, and resolution of platform issues before they impact the business or end\-user experience.
* Provide 24/7 senior operational oversight for the digital portfolio, serving as the escalation point for critical incidents and urgent business requests, and applying deep technical expertise to rapidly coordinate resolution and minimize business impact.
* Serve as the organization's senior authority on web security and data protection, owning compliance with information security standards, proactively monitoring for vulnerabilities, and driving the implementation of security improvements across the entire digital portfolio.
* Champion rigorous standards for web accessibility, ensuring all digital properties meet WCAG compliance requirements, and embedding accessibility principles from design inception through to production delivery.
* Own and govern the organization's cookies consent framework across 100\+ digital properties, overseeing technical implementation, monitoring ongoing compliance, and managing the strategic relationship with the cookies consent solution vendor.
* Ensure all web platform solutions adhere to data protection, information security, and accessibility standards — embedding required principles and design patterns from inception through to delivery.
* Design, build, and steward enterprise\-grade API integrations — including Salesforce and custom microservices — applying best practices in REST API design, security, and documentation to ensure robust, maintainable, and scalable integration architecture.
* Lead the evaluation, onboarding, and governance of SaaS solutions and enterprise platforms — including enterprise contract and license management, user access management, and vendor relationships — ensuring all tools are adopted effectively and deliver measurable value.
* Manage and evolve the organization's internal Power Platform capability, overseeing the design and delivery of automation flows and applications.
* Develop and manage the web platform and digital operations budget in excess of $1M, balancing cost efficiency with operational excellence, and continuously identifying opportunities for financial optimization without compromising service quality or delivery capability.
* Build and maintain strong collaborative relationships with business, commercial, and marketing stakeholders, acting as a trusted technical consultant on new digital initiatives and providing expert guidance on platform capabilities, constraints, and opportunities.
* Lead and develop a multidisciplinary digital team — comprising web developers, operations manager, and microservices developer — setting clear direction, providing meaningful performance feedback, and creating pathways for professional growth and career development.
* Drive upskilling and continuous development initiatives within the team in line with the capability requirements and service priorities of the function.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and ownership within the team, encouraging experimentation with emerging technologies while maintaining delivery discipline and quality standards.



  





**Who We Are Looking For** 




 Proven experience in enterprise web platform management, digital operations, or a closely related discipline, with a minimum of 8 years in a leadership role overseeing multi\-stakeholder digital environments.
 



  





**Education / Professional Certifications** 



* Master's degree in computer science
* PRINCE2 Practitioner
* UX Management certification



  





**Technical Competencies** 



* Front\-end and full\-stack development proficiency: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, Next.js, Astro, PHP
* Microsoft Azure platform knowledge, with hands\-on experience in App Services, deployment pipelines, and Azure DevOps
* REST API design, development, and validation; experience building secure, production\-grade integrations
* Low\-code/no\-code automation platforms: Power Apps, Power Automate, Zapier, Xano
* Database design and SQL; data engineering fundamentals
* Web Accessibility Standards (WCAG) and UX best practices
* Technical on\-site SEO and AEO strategy and implementation
* Analytics and tracking: Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, custom data layer configuration
* Webflow platform administration and development at enterprise scale
* DNS, networking fundamentals, and information security principles
* Version control and CI/CD workflows (Git)
* Figma and design\-to\-development collaboration



  





**As much as we would be delighted to entertain all applicants, due to high volumes of applications only successful applicants will be contacted within 14 business days.** 




**This job description is not all inclusive. Dubai Holding reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Dubai Holding is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.**

data.jd_text:
Pattern is a leading eCommerce accelerator with offices across the globe offering outsourced marketplace and ecommerce management services for brands worldwide. The Pattern Ecommerce Acceleration Platform leverages AI\-powered technology, industry expertise, and global distribution, logistics, and fulfilment services to help quality brands scale profitably on their own websites and through hundreds of marketplaces. Pattern works with some of the most recognized brands such as Thorne, Naturelo, Marshall, Nutricost, MegaFood, TIGI, Hair Burst and Sage and it ranks among the top 5 Amazon sellers globally.
   

  

 Pattern is expanding and we are looking for an experienced Ecommerce expert to join our MENA Team in Dubai to support the scaling of the business by driving the performance of the brands we represent on Amazon and other Marketplaces.
   

  

 You will own the relationship and financial performance of a portfolio of global brands managing their performance across marketplaces here in MENA. You will support the Associate Director of eCommercewith defining and implementing the E2E growth and profitability plan for your portfolio of brands by working cross\-functionally with Operations, Content, Advertising, Creative, Merchandising and Finance. You will also lead cross\-functional projects to implement processes to scale the organisation in MENA. You will be a strategic and commercial ecommerce professional who can engage partners and internal stakeholders towards a common goal. You will have a growth mindset and love navigating the challenges of working in fast changing landscapes.
   

  

**The core responsibilities of the eCommerce Manager reflect the following**
* Drive revenue growth on marketplaces across MENA through a data\-driven approach across a portfolio of brands through B2B and D2C marketplaces.
* Ensure that a clear activity plan is in place to achieve and surpass the budget targets, including promotional planning, seasonal phasing, NPD launches, advertising campaigns etc.
* Define the strategy and joint business plan with our brands to create mutually beneficial sales and marketing plans which grow market share.
* Represent your brands brilliantly across Marketplaces through best\-in\-class product content, including but not limited to images, enhanced content, keyword SEO, local language translation, advertising campaigns etc.
* Conduct analysis of brands performance using multiple data sources and tools on a regular basis to ensure that performance is continuously optimised across all touch points.
* Manage inventory, working alongside our merchandisers to maintain a healthy pipeline
* .Establish and maintain relationships with appropriate client partners, providing day\-to\-day contact on project status and changes.
* Have a passion for continuous improvement and building and automating processes.


**What will I need to thrive in this role?﻿**
* Demonstrated success in managing an ecommerce business
* 2\-5 years experience in an ecommerce role
* Strong academic background (2:1 or above)
* Previous experience managing and growing 3P business on Marketplaces (Amazon and Noon)
* Creative thinker and problem solver
* Highly organized and disciplined
* Willing to be nimble and adaptable to change
* Able to work under pressure and manage workloads effectively
* Arabic fluency preferred to facilitate communication with local market clients


**We Are Looking For Individuals Who Are**
**Game Changers** 
 \- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.
   

  

**Data Fanatics** 
 \- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.
   

  

**Partner Obsessed** 
 \- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations and delivers results that exceed them, prioritises the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.
   

  

**Team of Doers** 
 \- Someone who is a part of team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.

**Position Overview**
