 Specifies and directs the implementation and completion of one or more major projects or programs, including responsibility for managing safety, scope, cost, schedule and risk, and ensuring appropriate reporting and governance is in place. Responsible for delivery of project(s)/program(s)/portfolio to agreed scope, specifications, schedule and budget, for managing change and customer relationships. Delivers project(s)/program(s)/portfolio which often involves a high level of complexity and risk with multiple workstreams and high financial risk. Oversight of multiple project managers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* P \& L responsibility with associated commercial and financial accountability including revenue delivery, margin and overhead management, budget and forecast determination and attainment, risk and opportunity reviews, cost controls, accounts payable/billing and cash collection
* Contributes to and reviews the project proposal and plan to establish timeframe, procedures for accomplishing the project, resource requirements, and allotment of available resources to various phases of the project. Ensures adherence to corporate policy and best practice, and sets project evaluation parameters.
* Negotiates changes to project scope with the customer. Follows Change Management process to identify and approve modifications to scope, cost, schedule and quality
* Pursues and develop opportunities for innovation, such as digitalisation and technology use, work share and high value engineering centres, to bring value to Wood and customer
* Approves project procedures and project execution plan including the scope of work, deliverables list, master schedule, budget, org charts, risk register etc
* Ensures competence of project team members to carry out assigned work
* Oversees proposals and call\-offs (may be single projects) within delegation of authority, ensuring compliance with contracting policy and standards of ethical conduct.
* Monitors adherence to schedule, cost and quality and proactively intervenes to avoid slippage
* Ensures that the required project management software systems are established for the project and the supporting training is completed
* Ensure the project assurance protocol and schedule are established
* Involved in establishing terms and conditions, and wider scope and larger size of projects may require more visibility in the community as well as activity in attracting project staff
* Responsible for the project HSSE leadership, ensures a program of initiatives and auditing schedule are established, and that HSSE and quality management issues are proactively addressed
* Drives good practices, including corporate initiatives, across projects and programs
* Resolves complex issues which are escalated by project team
* Participate in assurance activities and peer reviews
* The complexity, potential impact and political sensitivity of projects/programmes of this size (particularly in an international context), frequently require the project director to be involved in closing the deal, attracting specialized staff from outside the organization, and managing relationships with local officials and community groups as well as the customer and contractors, all based on their credibility and proven track record


**Qualifications**
* University degree (bachelors or masters) in Engineering
* Project Management Professional (PMP), Associate in Project Management (APM) or equivalent certification is preferred
* Typically requires more than 20 years of broad and extensive pertinent experience, including minimum 10 years project management experience, mastering their area and knowledgeable about impacts on other areas; of which substantial experience successfully managing major/complex international or remote location projects.
* Requires strong technical skill as relevant to the project scope(s)
* Good level of experience in the related field, industry, and locations of the work
* Has thorough knowledge of project success and benefits management
* Expert in stakeholder management with extensive experience in managing challenging stakeholders and able to coach and advise others in this area
* Thorough understanding of requirements management from creation to monitoring to verification of complex project requirements and their linkage to business benefits.
* Knowledge of work flow management, established policies for engineering ownership, globalization of projects and request for tender process
* Experienced in assembling and managing multi\-phase project budgets, including risk contingencies
* Expert Practitioner in Risk Management processes, well versed in how risks are transposed into cost, time and contingency estimates and forecasts
* Advanced knowledge of various forms of vendor contracts across many types of goods and services; able to create new appropriate contracting frameworks and negotiate to successful conclusion.
* Able to manage complex major project start\-up, produce and communicate the project execution plan
* Expert understanding of both explicit and implicit dependencies and able to explain these and build into recommendations
* Experience of implementing successful project performance improvement activities and techniques for recovering poor performance
* Knowledge of supplier categorisation and experienced in devising appropriate commercial acquisition strategies
* Understands the needs of information management requirements in the project phases (operation), internal (contractual, statutory) and asset (customer) documentation.
* Able to negotiate appropriate close\-out terms with all key stakeholders.
* Ability to effectively manage resources (personnel, equipment, materials etc)
* Sound practice and experience of commercial and technical risk management.
* Able to drive cash flow management as well as projection/forecast of cost at completion


**About Us**
 Wood is a global leader in consulting and engineering, helping to unlock solutions to critical challenges in energy and materials markets. We provide consulting, projects and operations solutions in 45 countries, employing around 25,000 people. www.woodplc.com
   

  

**Diversity Statement**
 We are an equal opportunity employer that recognises the value of a diverse workforce. All suitably qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment on the basis of objective criteria and without regard to the following (which is a non\-exhaustive list): race, colour, age, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or other characteristics in accordance with the relevant governing laws.

data.jd_text:
ESMT Berlin is a leading global business school with its campus in the heart of Berlin. Founded by 25 global companies, ESMT offers master, MBA, and PhD programs, as well as executive education on its campus in Berlin, in locations around the world, online, and in online blended format. We strongly believe in cross\-team collaboration to achieve our mission to develop entrepreneurial leaders who think globally and act responsibly.
 



  





 DEEP \- Institute for Deep Tech Innovation \- is ESMT’s innovation hub dedicated to amplifying our ecosystem’s ability to generate and scale science\-based businesses. We empower scientists to commercialize technologies, support deep tech startups to scale internationally and connect leading research organizations to connect with the startup and innovation ecosystem effectively.
 



  





 DEEP is running targeted and ambitious activities in the fields of Healthcare, Natural Capital, Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence and Compute, currently expanding to Qatar
 



  





 Join our DEEP Qatar team on\-site as a
 



  





**Operations Lead DEEP Qatar** 




 (m/f/x, 40 hrs./week, starting in August\-September 2026, on\-site in Doha)
 



  





 and help shape the future by bringing your expertise and passion to ESMT.
 



  





  





**How you’ll make a difference** 




 The Operations Lead is responsible for the operational backbone of DEEP Qatar. They keep the Qatar site running, manage operational tracking of the program budget, and provide operational support across the three flagship programs (DEEP Academy, DEEP Pioneers, and CDL Doha).
 



 They bring local knowledge of business practices and cultural nuances in Qatar and the wider GCC to support the team in navigating the local environment effectively. In year one, this means supporting the establishment of an operation from scratch in a new market. In year two and beyond, it means scaling that operation as the programs mature.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 









**Entity, governance, and office operations** 




 Primarily responsible for keeping the Qatar entity operational. Stay on top of day\-to\-day compliance obligations such as accounting, HR, legal, IT, and office operations. Support the relationship with the company secretary and external legal counsel. Support the operational management of banking relationships, including account administration, vendor payments, and expense systems. Manage office leases, vendor contracts, and supplier relationships. Lead the operational logistics for local new\-hire onboarding.
 



**Program budget and operations support** 




 Manage operational tracking of the various program budgets. Track costs, reconcile spend against budget allocations, and report regularly to the Director. Support the Program Manager with project\-level budget management.
 



 Provide operational support across DEEP Academy, DEEP Pioneers, and CDL Doha, including support for Academy curriculum refinement and ecosystem day preparation alongside the Director and Program Manager. Coordinate with the Berlin team on operational alignment, shared services, and reporting.
 



**Business systems and processes** 




 Set up and maintain the tools and processes that support the Director and the wider team in business development, partnership management, and operational delivery. This includes CRM, pipeline tracking, internal reporting, and operational workflows.
 



**Local partnership and ecosystem intelligence** 




 Support the Director with institutional knowledge of local business practices and cultural nuances in Qatar and the GCC region. Provide intelligence and brief the team on the regional entrepreneur and innovation ecosystem, including key accelerators, networks, and communities relevant to Pioneers and CDL scouting. Maintain awareness of local vendors relevant to program delivery and share that intelligence with the team.
 



**Equipment and IT** 




 Lead local equipment management, including sourcing, maintenance, and inventory of IT hardware, screens, AV equipment, and connectivity. Resolve day\-to\-day local IT and infrastructure issues so the team can work without disruption.
 



  





**What makes you a great fit.** 




 You are an operator with strong institutional knowledge of how things work in Qatar and the wider GCC. You combine the operational rigour to run an entity, track a budget and build systems with the local instinct to spot what matters and flag it early. You have direct experience of working with or inside Qatari government, or sovereign or quasi\-government institutions, and you bring that experience to bear in helping the team navigate the local environment effectively. You are comfortable being hands\-on across operations, finance and systems in a small, scaling team without a playbook.
 



 Must\-haves
 


* 5 to 8 years of professional experience with meaningful time spent living or working in Qatar or the wider GCC
* Strong working knowledge of local business practices, customs and how decisions get made in the region
* Operational management experience in an international organisation, including budget tracking and financial reporting
* Working Arabic
* Experience in standing up new operations or geographies
* Comfortable operating in a small, scaling team with a limited playbook



 Strong preferences
 


* Institutional experience of the Qatari government, or sovereign or quasi\-government agencies
* Background in startup, accelerator, university or innovation ecosystem
* Experience setting up and managing CRM, pipeline tracking or operational systems
* Experience managing IT, vendor and supplier relationships in a small\-team environment



 Nice to have
 


* Existing relationships with QSTP, Qatar Foundation, QRDI, QIA or the major Qatari universities.



  





**What makes this more than just a job** 




 ESMT offers a collegial and international work environment, with employees representing more than 55 nationalities. We encourage a self\-driven mind\-set and contributions that create meaningful and lasting impact. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering a fair and inclusive workplace where individuals of all identities and backgrounds are welcomed and valued. Fostering diversity, equity, and inclusion enriches our employees, students, and broader community.
 



  





**We look forward to receiving your application and learning more about you!** 




 Please submit your application via our online application form, including the following documents:
 


* Motivation letter
* CV with relevant certificates and references
* Salary expectations and possible start date.



  





**Contact:**




 ESMT Berlin
 



 Viktoriya Rodina
 



 Human Resources Coordinator
 



 Schlossplatz 1
 



 10178 Berlin
 



 Tel: 030 21231 0

 Reflecting The Market Focus For The Office In Both Brownfield And Greenfield Opportunities, Multi\-skilled Personnel Are Sought, In Particular Those With Experience In
   

  

* Onshore Oil and Gas
* Offshore Oil and Gas


**Responsibilities**
* Champions both Wood and client Health, Safety, Environmental and Quality cultures. Leads by example in ‘raising the shield’, demonstrating the ‘courage to intervene’. Ensures that procedures are followed and that a high standard of safety and quality is achieved in all associated work.
* Plan, direct, co\-ordinate, and control the work
* Execute Projects in accordance with corporate practices and Project procedures
* Developing and implementing a project execution plan and project schedules that meets with Company and Contract requirements
* Provide leadership and commitment to the Project HSSE and Quality plan

* To focus upon customer care and customer feedback
* To understand the Project ‘business case’ and drivers

* Clearly define and communicate the project objectives and organization to the Project team

* To monitor and expedite account receivables for the Project
* To document lessons learned and to review/implement lessons learned from other Projects
* To close out the project


**Qualifications**
* Undergraduate degree in an engineering discipline
* Minimum of 15\-20 years of relevant experience
* Ideally candidates will have further education and certification in the field of Project Management, PMP or APM for example
* Must have good working experience of the Microsoft Office applications in the development of documents, presentations, trackers and schedules etc
* Is a self\-motivated, proactive and highly driven individual with high standards, attention to detail and capable of demonstrating initiative
* High level of commercial aptitude and awareness. Should be able to interpret and follow the Contract whilst raising potential delays, change and commercial matters to Project Sponsors in good time
* Must be an excellent communicator, being a leader in the success of multi\-discipline team delivery. Motivates teams in a positive manner to ensure a proactive approach in the delivery of timely solutions
* Highly experienced with risk and change management across the full project lifecycle, ideally having exposure to both design and site works. Highlights and quantifies change when it impacts the work
* Experienced across multiple project phases such as Concept/Feasibility, Pre\-FEED, FEED, Detailed Design, Procurement, Construction, Commissioning, Star\-Up and Warrantee

* Able to make decisions and drive decision processes
* Excellent analytical and abstract reasoning skills, plus excellent organization skills
* Well\-developed management and administrative skills
* Works within a team to establish direction, alignment and commitment
* Well\-developed interpersonal skills. Ability to get along with diverse personalities. Tactful, mature, and flexible
* High energy level, comfortable performing multifaceted projects
* Demonstrated servant leadership ability, team management, and interpersonal skills
* Well organized, credible and decisive

* Take ownership of scopes of work, coordinating the engineering disciplines and supporting functions to deliver successful outcomes
* Have demonstrable experience of working independently / remotely from technical leadership personnel (although functional leadership will be within the Doha office).
* Have demonstrable experience of working within a small project office, supporting cross discipline activities beyond their core discipline
* Be willing and able to represent Wood in both onshore and offshore surveys, holding relevant certification or willing to undertake suitable training such as BOSIET and H2S Awareness.
* Must have a proficient level of both written and spoken communication skills in the English language, able to interpret and disseminate complex scope and contract documents

 Wood is a global leader in consulting and engineering, helping to unlock solutions to critical challenges in energy and materials markets. We provide consulting, projects and operations solutions in 45 countries, employing around 25,000 people. www.woodplc.com

 The IT Project Manager is responsible for managing, coordinating, and monitoring a portfolio of IT projects from initiation through closure, ensuring successful delivery within scope, schedule, budget, and quality standards while aligning with organizational objectives and strategic plans.

* Build and maintain strong working relationships with business units, IT teams, vendors, and external stakeholders.

* Monitor project progress, identify risks and issues, and implement appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Prepare and maintain project documentation, including project charters, plans, status reports, risk registers, and closure reports.
* Provide regular project updates and progress reports to management and stakeholders.
* Facilitate project meetings, workshops, and stakeholder discussions to ensure alignment and effective communication.
* Manage project scope, schedule, budget, resources, and quality throughout the project lifecycle.
* Resolve project\-related challenges and escalate issues where necessary.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, governance requirements, security standards, and audit requirements.
* Maintain confidentiality and safeguard sensitive business and project information.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to the enhancement of project management practices.
* Stay current with industry trends, technologies, and project management best practices.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
* PMP (Project Management Professional) certification is mandatory.
* MBA or Master's Degree is preferred.


**Experience**

* Proven experience in banking, financial services, or highly regulated industries is preferred.
* Experience managing multiple projects and cross\-functional teams.
* Demonstrated success in vendor management, stakeholder management, and project governance.


**Required Skills**
* Strong project management and leadership skills.
* Excellent stakeholder and relationship management capabilities.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.

* Self\-motivated, proactive, and results\-oriented.

 Location

 Employment Type

**Preferred Certifications**
* PMP (Mandatory)

data.jd_text:
**🚀 Welcome to Your Next Adventure!**
 The Vertical Operations Director is responsible for owning and scaling the operational performance of Snoonu’s key business verticals, including grocery, laundry, ticketing, and any future verticals launched under Snoonu’s ecosystem.
   

  

 This role ensures that each vertical operates with clear ownership, strong execution, high service quality, and profitable growth, while maintaining Snoonu’s customer obsession and operational standards.
   

  

 The Vertical Operations Director is not only responsible for day\-to\-day operations, but also for building scalable operating models, improving unit economics, solving cross\-functional issues, and ensuring that each Non\-food vertical is ready to grow in Qatar and future markets.
   

  

**🛠 What You’ll Get Your Hands On**
* Grocery Operations


 Own the operational performance of grocery, supermarket, convenience, and quick\-commerce partners.
   

  

* Ensure product availability, stock accuracy, pricing accuracy, and substitution processes are properly managed.
* Reduce missing items, wrong items, out\-of\-stock issues, and delayed grocery orders.
* Improve picking, packing, and handover processes with partners.
* Work with category, merchant, logistics, and product teams to improve the grocery customer journey.
* Build operating standards for grocery partners, including item accuracy, cold\-chain sensitivity, packaging, and delivery readiness.
* Monitor grocery fulfillment time and customer complaint trends.
* Support the development of dark\-store or quick\-commerce models if required.
* Improve grocery basket experience, repeat purchase, and reliability.
* Laundry Operations


 Own the operational performance of laundry partners and end\-to\-end laundry order flow.
   

  

* Manage the full laundry journey from pickup to partner processing to delivery.
* Ensure clear SLAs for pickup, cleaning, ironing, packaging, and return delivery.
* Reduce delays, damaged items, missing items, wrong items, and customer complaints.
* Build quality control standards for laundry partners.
* Ensure proper item tagging, tracking, and handover processes.
* Work with product and logistics teams to improve scheduling, pickup windows, and customer notifications.
* Create escalation processes for high\-value items, lost items, or damaged items.
* Improve customer trust in the laundry vertical through reliability, transparency, and service recovery.
* Ticketing Operations


 Own the operational execution of ticketing services, events, bookings, and related customer experiences.
   

  

* Ensure ticket inventory, availability, pricing, and event details are accurate.
* Coordinate with event organizers, venues, partners, product, finance, and customer support.
* Manage operational readiness before, during, and after major events.
* Reduce customer issues related to ticket access, QR codes, refunds, cancellations, and event changes.
* Create clear SOPs for event\-day support and escalation.
* Ensure smooth settlement and reporting with ticketing partners.
* Support major event launches with risk assessment and operational planning.
* Build scalable ticketing processes for future expansion into entertainment, experiences, sports, and tourism.


**Additional Verticals And Business Areas**
 Based on Snoonu’s business model, the Vertical Operations Director may also oversee or support the following areas:
   

  

* Retail Operations


 For flowers, pharmacies, electronics, beauty, gifts, fashion, and general retail partners.
   

  

* Improving item accuracy, merchant readiness, fulfillment time, packaging, and delivery handover.
* Reducing cancellations, unavailable items, wrong items, and poor packaging complaints.
* Building SOPs for sensitive categories such as pharmacy, flowers, electronics, and gifts.
* Supporting category\-specific service standards.
* Marketplace Operations


 Own the overall marketplace health across multiple verticals.
   

  

* Monitor supply availability across merchants and categories.
* Ensure strong coordination between merchant operations, logistics, product, and customer support.
* Improve operational KPIs across all marketplace verticals.
* Identify marketplace gaps such as low availability, weak fulfillment, poor merchant compliance, or high complaint rates.
* Support new vertical launches with proper operating models and readiness checks.
* New Vertical Launch Operations


 Lead operational readiness for new Snoonu verticals before launch.
   

  

* Define the operating model for each new vertical.
* Build SOPs, SLAs, partner requirements, customer support flows, and escalation rules.
* Run pilot launches before scaling.
* Identify operational risks before public launch.
* Work with product to ensure the customer journey is ready.
* Work with finance to validate pricing, commission, refunds, and settlement processes.
* Ensure logistics capacity and delivery requirements are clear.


**🧙‍♂️ The Magic You Bring**
* Vertical Strategy and Operating Model ( Define the operating model for each vertical; Set operational priorities, KPIs, and service standards; Translate Snoonu’s business goals into clear execution plans).
* Operational Performance ( Own the day\-to\-day performance of each vertical; Monitor key metrics; Identify operational bottlenecks and solve them with clear owners; Ensure every vertical has weekly performance reviews and action plans).
* Customer Experience ( Ensure every vertical delivers a customer experience aligned with Snoonu’s standards; Work closely with Customer Experience and Customer Support to understand complaints and root causes; Reduce repeated failures that create customer dissatisfaction; Ensure service recovery rules are clear for each vertical; Protect the customer first, then fix the root cause internally) .
* Partner and Merchant Operational Excellence ( Set clear operational requirements for merchants and partners; Hold partners accountable for repeated failures; Work with commercial and account management teams to improve partner performance; Ensure partners understand Snoonu’s standards for preparation, availability, packaging, handover, and customer experience; Recommend corrective actions for underperforming partners).
* Cross\-Functional Leadership ( This role must connect all departments to ensure that vertical issues are solved end\-to\-end).
* SOPs, SLAs, and Governance ( Create and maintain SOPs for each vertical; Define clear SLAs for merchants, operations, logistics, and support teams; Build escalation processes for critical issues; Ensure every team knows who owns each type of problem; Standardize processes across verticals to reduce confusion and improve execution) .
* Data, Reporting, and Business Reviews ( Build dashboards for each vertical; Track daily, weekly, and monthly performance; Identify trends, risks, and repeated failures; Present clear business reviews to leadership; Convert data into action plans, not just reports).
* Profitability and Unit Economics ( Work with finance and commercial teams to improve vertical profitability; Monitor cost\-to\-serve across each vertical; Identify operational inefficiencies that affect margins; Improve delivery batching, fulfillment efficiency, partner terms, and refund leakage; Ensure growth does not come at the cost of poor economics).
* Team Leadership ( Build and lead strong vertical operations teams; Define clear responsibilities for each vertical manager; Set performance expectations and accountability; Coach team members to solve problems independently; Build a leadership culture where every vertical has a clear owner).


**Inside Snoonu’s Universe**
 Snoonu is Qatar’s homegrown Super App, reinventing daily life with blazing\-fast delivery, shopping, and more – all in one place. Powered by tech, driven by a global team, and obsessed with making life easier.
   

  

**The Dream We’re Chasing**
 To be the first Qatari Ultra App that propels the region and its community through innovation and technology. We have global ambitions where what we do surpasses norms and limitations every time.
   

  

**The Quest We’re On**
 To radically transform how people live by leveraging technology to connect them with endless possibilities.
   

  

**Our Everyday Superpowers**
**👥 Be Customer Obsessed** 
 : “Focus on the customer and all else will follow.”
   

  

**💪 Act with Integrity:** 
 “We are honest, ethical, and trustworthy in everything we do.”
   

  

**🧪 Be Curious and Creative:** 
 “We constantly innovate and create solutions to bring a lasting positive impact.”
   

  

**🏅Lead by Example and Take Ownership:** 
 “Be the change you want to see and take ownership.”
   

  

**🚀 Work Smart and Deliver Results** 
 : “You can do more by doing less, better, and faster.”
   

  

**👨‍💼 It's All About People:** 
 “Be a team player; together we are stronger.”
   

  

**Perks \& Worklife Magic At Snoonu**
**🌐 Global Vibes** 
 – Collaborate with a worldwide crew.
   

  

**🧠 Brain Boosters** 
 – Learning budgets, access to courses, and tools for your growth.
   

  

 🚒
 **Builder’s Playground** 
 – Own your tasks, own your path! We’re big on autonomy.
   

  

 🏝️
 **Flexible Time Off** 
 – We take recharging seriously. Generous leave and wellness policies.
   

  

 🛠️
 **Agile Everything** 
 – Scrum isn’t a buzzword here. It’s how we roll, from product to ops.
   

  

**Great Place to Work® Certified**
 We’re certified as a Great Place to Work®, a recognition that celebrates a culture we’ve built together where people come first, always. This certification reflects our commitment to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, empowered, and inspired to do their best work.
   

  

**Certified for Excellence**
 Our ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certifications demonstrate our dedication to world\-class quality and a safe, supportive workplace, reinforcing our promise to deliver exceptional service while prioritizing the wellbeing of our people.
   

  

**Beyond the Code: Giving Back Matters**
 We don’t just build apps. We’re committed to doing business sustainably and giving back to the community that fuels us. From eco\-conscious practices to CSR projects, we’re always finding ways to do better—and we invite you to be a part of that mission.
   

  

**Diversity Isn’t Just a Buzzword**
 At Snoonu, fairness and inclusion are the foundation of everything we do. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace that welcomes people from every walk of life. Be bold. Be you. Thrive here.
   

  

**Let’s Build the Future Together**
 Apply now to join a team where your contributions spark a change and your voice is heard. Let’s make some magic together.
   

  

 Stay in the loop—connect with us on LinkedIn!

**About The Ned Doha:**
 Housed within Doha’s iconic former Ministry of Interior building, The Ned Doha is not just a hotel — it is a refined luxury destination where heritage, elegance, and contemporary sophistication come together to create an exceptional experience.
   

  

 With seven distinctive dining concepts, 90 beautifully designed bedrooms, elegant event spaces, and Ned’s Club—our private members’ club complete with a rooftop terrace, spa, gym, and a breathtaking 30\-metre outdoor pool—The Ned Doha blends heritage, creativity, and modern luxury into one vibrant experience.
   

  

**The Role:**
 We are looking for an experienced and inspiring Director of Banquet Operations to lead our banquet team and oversee the seamless execution of events across our dynamic and luxury environment.
   

  

 This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate hospitality professional who thrives in a fast\-paced setting and enjoys leading teams to deliver outstanding guest experiences.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing:**
* Lead and oversee the day\-to\-day banquet operations, ensuring the successful execution of all events and functions
* Work closely with Sales, Events, Culinary, and F\&B teams to ensure seamless coordination and exceptional service delivery
* Drive operational excellence by maintaining high standards of quality, presentation, and guest satisfaction
* Lead, coach, and inspire a diverse team while fostering a positive and high\-performing culture
* Monitor staffing requirements, scheduling, productivity, and labor costs to maximize efficiency
* Ensure all events are executed in line with company standards, guest expectations, and operational procedures
* Maintain strong financial awareness including budgeting, forecasting, and cost control initiatives
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance guest experiences and improve operational processes
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, hygiene, and company policies at all times


**About You:**
* Previous experience in a senior banquet leadership role, ideally within luxury hospitality brands
* Strong knowledge of banquet operations, event management, and Food \& Beverage service standards
* Proven leadership skills with experience managing and developing large teams
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment while maintaining exceptional attention to detail
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* Financial and commercial awareness with experience managing budgets and operational targets
* Passion for creating memorable guest experiences and delivering service excellence


**What’s In It for You?**
* Competitive tax\-free annual salary package from up to QAR 290,000
* 21 calendar days annual leave and 11 paid public holidays
* Sick leave benefits as per Qatar Labour Law
* Private Medical Insurance for self
* End of Service benefits
* Complimentary meals at Neddy’s, our team restaurant (breakfast, lunch \& dinner)
* Exclusive hotel and dining rates for you, your family, and friends
* Outstanding learning, development, and career progression opportunities
* Reward and recognition programmes

data.jd_text:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.
   

  

 Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Meet our Professional Services Team!**
 Successful implementation and value from the Sprinklr platform starts with us. As customers advance their strategies and invest more in social media as a business driver, we’re looking for experienced project managers to help realise those ambitions. As a member of our team, you’ll support our customers through the initial stages of their Sprinklr journey and work with a team of passionate consultants, solutions designers, analytics experts, as well as sales and service delivery leaders to make it happen.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Sprinklr is looking for a Global Program Manager to lead one strategic enterprise program for a public\-sector client in Doha. You will be responsible and accountable for the end\-to\-end delivery of the program, working with a retained team dedicated to the client.
   

  

 This is an on\-site role based in Doha, Qatar, supporting a public\-sector client. The successful candidate will be expected to work from the client site on a full\-time basis.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Own and manage one strategic enterprise program for a public\-sector client, coordinating the retained team and controlling program scope, change control processes, risks, issues, and mitigation plans.
* Partner with consulting teams, leaders and other internal departments or regional teams to coordinate and drive delivery.
* Ensure that overall program is effective, whilst running individual projects according to schedule and keeping within budget.
* Develop relationships and ensure the appropriate participation of key client \& internal stakeholders and executives.
* Develop, build, and maintain durable and trusted relationships with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Develop knowledge of the Sprinklr platform components and module\-synergies \- so as to be able to develop realistic and meaningful project plans and high\-level solutions.
* Ensure that each project is reported and forecasted accurately to all external and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure that all project/program risks, issues and change requests are managed effectively.
* Manage client service expectations and briefs and drive successful, measurable outcomes for the client.
* Set the tone for the team and strive for quality and excellence in all aspects of delivery.
* Provide weekly project status and burn reports to the relevant project stakeholders.
* Maintain awareness of the current industry environment that shapes opportunities for client solutions.


**Experience:**
* Experience managing enterprise SaaS programs for government, public\-sector, or highly regulated clients.
* Ability to operate directly from the client site, manage daily executive interactions, and build trusted relationships with senior public\-sector stakeholders.
* Extensive client management experience, including close collaboration with business owners and executive\-level clients.
* Experienced managing projects in IT, SaaS, Social, or Software environment.
* Experienced working with multi\-geo, multicultural delivery teams.
* Prior experience delivering programs in Qatar or the wider GCC region is a strong advantage.
* Experienced working on large scale project management in leading multi\-organizational initiatives, and driving team accountability to achieve goals.
* Ability to identify and resolve issues, manage risk, develop detailed work plans and specifications, perform resource allocations and run team meetings.
* Demonstrated ability to assume a leadership role in managing project, departmental and enterprise risks related to projects, systems and business analysis.
* Strong influencing skills and negotiation / mediation skills.
* Ability to motivate and focus people resources where there is no direct reporting relationship.
* Proven mentoring, supervisory, and team\-building skills.
* Ability to resolve problems with keen instincts and organizational experience.
* Strong knowledge of software development life cycles, web technologies, web development processes.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Fluency in English is mandatory; Arabic is highly desirable to support effective local stakeholder engagement.
* Experience in Agile project management a plus.
* Certification of any kind for Project Management (Prince2, PMP, SCRUM etc.)


**We focus on our mission** 
 : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
   

  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.


**We believe in our product** 
 : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
   

  

**We invest in our people** 
 : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
   

  

 To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
   

  

 To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
   

  

**EEO \- Our philosophy** 
 : Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
   

  

 Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
   

  

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** 
 Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
   

  

 If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

data.jd_text:
ESMT Berlin is a leading global business school with its campus in the heart of Berlin. Founded by 25 global companies, ESMT offers master, MBA, and PhD programs, as well as executive education on its campus in Berlin, in locations around the world, online, and in online blended format. We strongly believe in cross\-team collaboration to achieve our mission to develop entrepreneurial leaders who think globally and act responsibly.
 



  





 DEEP \- Institute for Deep Tech Innovation \- is ESMT’s innovation hub dedicated to amplifying our ecosystem’s ability to generate and scale science\-based businesses. We empower scientists to commercialize technologies, support deep tech startups to scale internationally and connect leading research organizations to connect with the startup and innovation ecosystem effectively.
 



  





 DEEP is running targeted and ambitious activities in the fields of Healthcare, Natural Capital, Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence and Compute, currently expanding to Qatar
 



  





 Join our DEEP Qatar team on\-site as a
 



  





**Program Manager, DEEP Qatar** 




 (m/f/x, 40 hrs./week, starting in August\-September 2026, on\-site in Doha)
 



  





 and help shape the future by bringing your expertise and passion to ESMT.
 



  





**How you'll make a difference** 




 The Program Manager is central to executing DEEP Qatar's local initiatives and supporting the delivery of the three flagship programs: DEEP Academy, DEEP Pioneers, and CDL Doha. They make sure every cohort week, venture session, and mentor gathering runs flawlessly on the ground in Doha, and help establish DEEP Qatar's brand presence locally through digital channels and a physical presence at ecosystem events.
 



 They work closely with the Program Operations team in Berlin to maintain consistency with global CDL standards, and with the Doha\-based Venture Managers on local delivery and venture intake. In year one, this is a build\-as\-you\-go role, requiring the entrepreneurialism to figure things out in a new market without a local playbook.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 




  





**Program delivery** 




 Own end\-to\-end local build and delivery for cohort sessions across DEEP Academy, DEEP Pioneers, and CDL Doha. Manage scheduling, logistics, venues, catering, and travel for participants, mentors, and faculty. Manage faculty, speakers, and practitioners across the programs, including onboarding, attendance, briefings, and on\-site coordination. Serve as the first point of contact for participants during cohort weeks. Ensure programs run to CDL global standards while adapting to the local context. Own project\-level budget management across programs, tracking spend and reporting into the overall Qatar program budget managed by the Operations Lead. Manage inbound inquiries.
 



**Berlin coordination** 




 Work closely with the Program Operations team in Berlin (led by the Head of Operations) and the Berlin\-based Program Managers to ensure alignment across the DEEP network. Provide local execution support for Berlin\-led activities that involve Qatar and draw on Berlin's support for Qatar\-led cohorts, particularly during the first year of the programs.
 



**Venture Manager support** 




 Provide local logistical support to Venture Managers across the program verticals, including coordinating venture visits, founder sessions, and ecosystem touchpoints in Qatar. Support Venture Managers with the application process and onboarding of candidates and ventures into the programs.
 



**Ecosystem days and gatherings** 




 Lead the operational delivery of DEEP Qatar's ecosystem days, including gatherings that connect CDL ventures and mentors with the local startup, innovation, investment, and corporate community in Qatar. Manage logistics, venues, speakers, attendee management, and on\-the\-day execution alongside the Director, Operations Lead, and Venture Managers.
 



**Brand and local presence** 




 Support the establishment and growth of DEEP Qatar's brand presence in the local ecosystem through social media channels (such as LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and others) and produce content that feeds into Berlin's central channels. Coordinate with the Berlin team on brand consistency and execution. Represent DEEP Qatar at relevant ecosystem events, demo days, and gatherings alongside the Director.
 



**Vendor and supplier management** 




 Manage local vendors and suppliers required for program delivery, including venues, catering, AV, travel, and accommodation. Build a reliable Doha supplier network from a standing start.
 



**Participant data and reporting** 




 Track participant data, attendance, feedback, and core program KPIs. Provide regular delivery reports to the Director and Berlin counterparts.
 



  





**What makes you a great fit** 




 You are a program operator who takes pride in flawless delivery. You have run multiple concurrent programs or events to a high standard, ideally in an accelerator, university executive education, professional services, or events context. You are the calm center during intense cohort weeks. You are entrepreneurial enough to figure things out in a new market with no local playbook, and disciplined enough to run programs to a global standard. You are comfortable working across cultures and flexible when working across time zones.
 



 You enjoy being the person who makes things work. You are comfortable being hands\-on with logistics one moment and engaging with a senior researcher or venture founder the next.
 



**Must\-haves** 



* 4–6 years of program delivery experience
* Track record of running multiple concurrent programs or events to a high standard
* Experience in an accelerator, university executive education, professional services, or events environment
* Currently based in Qatar or the wider GCC, or open to relocating to Doha
* High attention to detail and strong organizational discipline



**Strong preferences** 



* GCC\-based experience or background
* Experience in a startup, accelerator, or university ecosystem



**Nice to have** 



* Working proficiency in Arabic



  





  





**What makes this more than just a job** 




 ESMT offers a collegial and international work environment, with employees representing more than 55 nationalities. We encourage a self\-driven mind\-set and contributions that create meaningful and lasting impact. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering a fair and inclusive workplace where individuals of all identities and backgrounds are welcomed and valued. Fostering diversity, equity, and inclusion enriches our employees, students, and broader community.
 



  





  





**We look forward to receiving your application and learning more about you!** 




 Please submit your application via our online application form, including the following documents:
 


* Motivation letter
* CV with relevant certificates and references
* Salary expectations and possible start date.



  





**Contact:**




 ESMT Berlin
 



 Viktoriya Rodina
 



 Human Resources Coordinator
 



 Schlossplatz 1
 



 10178 Berlin
 



 Tel: 030 21231 0

**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The incumbent will assist QNB Capital’s team with translation requests under the supervision of QNB Capital’s Managing Director. The incumbent will draft, translate, review or proofread the translation of a range of materials, including official correspondence, letters, presentations, speeches, emails, and financial/legal documents, among others. The incumbent will ensure that all translated documents are formatted and presented appropriately in standard business formats using Microsoft Word and Microsoft PowerPoint. The incumbent will assist the QNB Capital team with various tasks that require Arabic language skills.
   

  

 Main Responsibilities
   

  

* Shareholder \& Financial:
* Implements KPI’s and best practices for Translator
* Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimize cost, avoid waste, and optimize benefits for the bank.
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent.

* Build and maintain strong/effective relationships with related departments/units to achieve the Group's objectives.
* Provide timely/accurate data to external/internal Auditors, Compliance, Financial Control and Risk when required.
* Learning \& Knowledge:
* Maintain professional competence related to all activities, events and developments of financial services and capital markets related activities, laws, standards and regulations.
* Identify related areas for self\-professional development and act to enhance self\-professional development.

* Seek out opportunities to remain current with all developments in professional field.

* Understand and effectively perform your role under the Three Lines of Defense principle to identify measure, monitor, manage and report risks.
* Ensure systematic good outcomes for clients in accordance with Conduct Risk policy.
* Support the framework of RCSA, KRI, Incident reporting and remediation, as appropriate, in accordance with the Operational Risk Management requirements.
* Maintain appropriate knowledge to ensure full qualification to undertake the role.
* Complete all mandatory training provided by the Bank, attain, and maintain the required levels of competence.
* Attend mandatory (internal and external) seminars as instructed by the Bank.
* Other:

* Maintaining utmost confidentiality concerning customer and internal bank information obtained during the course of business and provide such information on a need\-to\-know basis only to Senior Management of QNB, Audit and Compliance functions, and relevant Regulators.
* Maintain high professional standards to uphold QNB's reputation and to strengthen its market leadership position.
* All other ad hoc duties/activities related to QNB that management might request from time to time.
* Act with integrity, competence, diligence, respect, and in an ethical manner with the public, clients, prospective clients, employers, employees, colleagues.
* Place the integrity of the investment profession and the interests of clients above their own personal interests.
* Practice in a professional and ethical manner.


**Education And Experience Requirements**

* Proficiency in all standard business software applications, office communication tools and technologies with excellent skills in MS Word and PowerPoint.
* Familiarity with Finance, Banking, Economics and Legal concepts and terms is preferred.

* Personal integrity and self\-management.

* Ability to handle tight deadlines and work well under pressure.

* Knowledge of graphic and narrative techniques for the presentation of data.

**Job Summary**
 The Digital Office Manager holds a pivotal role in steering the organization's digital evolution. As the strategic leader overseeing digital initiatives, you will be at the forefront of innovation, responsible for driving the entire lifecycle of digital projects, from conception to realization.
   

  

 The Digital Office Manager reporting directly to the Chief Technical Officer (CTO) and collaborate closely with key stakeholders across the business to understand the intricacies of operational challenges. The primary focus will be on identifying emerging technologies and cutting\-edge processes and orchestrating their seamless integration into our business operations.
   

  

 Digital Office Manager will serve as the connection between conceptualizing transformative ideas and executing practical solutions. The mission is not only to keep a vigilant eye on the technological landscape but also to align these advancements with our organizational goals. By leveraging your expertise, the role holder will contribute to the development and implementation of innovative strategies that drive our digital transformation agenda forward.
   

  

 The role demands a visionary mindset and a proactive approach to problem\-solving. The Digital Office Manager will be instrumental in shaping and executing our digital strategy, ensuring that each digital engagement is finely tuned to meet our business objectives. The impact will extend beyond traditional boundaries by guiding the team in harnessing the power of digital technologies to address complex challenges and optimize operational efficiency.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* To ensure interpreting the digital strategy and to identify innovative solutions supporting strategy implementation.
* Drive QAFCO's digital vision and strategy definition, acting as the steward for the digital initiatives' roadmap across the organization.
* Identify and ideate digital business opportunities across the value chain, based on strategic and operational challenges or threats observed within the organization.
* Oversee the development of an integrated digital budget and spend plan across relevant QAFCO functions, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives.
* Identify synergies for developing and implementing digital solutions, collaborating with respective owners to ensure cohesive integration.
* Review digital value realization (i.e., ROI) across functions, ensuring that digital investments align with business objectives and deliver tangible outcomes.
* Develop relevant digital expertise through a Center of Excellence model, tailored to meet evolving business needs and technological advancements.
* Oversee the digital use case lifecycle delivery, from design and prototyping to full\-scale roll\-out, ensuring seamless execution and integration into existing processes.
* Lead and oversee the development of sustainable partnerships with local and global innovation ecosystems, fostering collaboration and driving digital innovation within QAFCO.
* Act as the single point of contact and key advisor to relevant QAFCO executives for digital topics and the future of the business, providing strategic guidance and insights.
* Act as the face of QAFCO in local and global digital and innovation events, seminars, and associations, representing the organization and fostering relationships with key stakeholders in the digital ecosystem.
* Interpret the digital strategy and identify innovative solutions supporting strategy implementation.
* Manage and evaluate the portfolio/pipeline of innovative ideas collected from across the company.
* Work closely with relevant business stakeholders to understand operational challenges or threats.
* Lead teams to build and implement digital products, tracking implementation progress and ensuring alignment with business and IT.
* Monitor the implementation of the digital strategy and roadmap, identifying risks, issues, and challenges, and seeking mitigation measures.
* Lead the ideation program to identify digital opportunities, ensuring compliance with relevant quality, health, safety, and environmental management procedures and controls.


**Desired Candidate Profile**
* Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field.
* Minimum of 10 years of relevant professional experience in digital implementation, innovation, or a related field, with minimum 5 years in a managerial role, preferably within the Oil \& Gas or Petrochemical Industry.
* Certifications in project management, such as PMP (Project Management Professional) would be added as an advantage.

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary:**




 The Digital Office Manager holds a pivotal role in steering the organization's digital evolution. As the strategic leader overseeing digital initiatives, you will be at the forefront of innovation, responsible for driving the entire lifecycle of digital projects, from conception to realization.
 



  





 The Digital Office Manager reporting directly to the Chief Technical Officer (CTO) and collaborate closely with key stakeholders across the business to understand the intricacies of operational challenges. The primary focus will be on identifying emerging technologies and cutting\-edge processes and orchestrating their seamless integration into our business operations.
 



  





 The Digital Office Manager will serve as the connection between conceptualizing transformative ideas and executing practical solutions. The mission is not only to keep a vigilant eye on the technological landscape but also to align these advancements with our organizational goals. By leveraging your expertise, the role holder will contribute to the development and implementation of innovative strategies that drive our digital transformation agenda forward.
 



  





 The role demands a visionary mindset and a proactive approach to problem\-solving. The Digital Office Manager will be instrumental in shaping and executing our digital strategy, ensuring that each digital engagement is finely tuned to meet our business objectives. The impact will extend beyond traditional boundaries by guiding the team in harnessing the power of digital technologies to address complex challenges and optimize operational efficiency.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:**



* To ensure interpreting the digital strategy and to identify innovative solutions supporting strategy implementation.
* Drive QAFCO's digital vision and strategy definition, acting as the steward for the digital initiatives' roadmap across the organization.
* Identify and ideate digital business opportunities across the value chain, based on strategic and operational challenges or threats observed within the organization.
* Oversee the development of an integrated digital budget and spend plan across relevant QAFCO functions, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives.
* Identify synergies for developing and implementing digital solutions, collaborating with respective owners to ensure cohesive integration.
* Review digital value realization (i.e., ROI) across functions, ensuring that digital investments align with business objectives and deliver tangible outcomes.
* Develop relevant digital expertise through a Center of Excellence model, tailored to meet evolving business needs and technological advancements.
* Oversee the digital use case lifecycle delivery, from design and prototyping to full\-scale roll\-out, ensuring seamless execution and integration into existing processes.
* Lead and oversee the development of sustainable partnerships with local and global innovation ecosystems, fostering collaboration and driving digital innovation within QAFCO.
* Act as the single point of contact and key advisor to relevant QAFCO executives for digital topics and the future of the business, providing strategic guidance and insights.
* Act as the face of QAFCO in local and global digital and innovation events, seminars, and associations, representing the organization and fostering relationships with key stakeholders in the digital ecosystem.
* Interpret the digital strategy and identify innovative solutions supporting strategy implementation.
* Manage and evaluate the portfolio/pipeline of innovative ideas collected from across the company.
* Work closely with relevant business stakeholders to understand operational challenges or threats.
* Lead teams to build and implement digital products, tracking implementation progress and ensuring alignment with business and IT.
* Monitor the implementation of the digital strategy and roadmap, identifying risks, issues, and challenges, and seeking mitigation measures.
* Lead the ideation program to identify digital opportunities, ensuring compliance with relevant quality, health, safety, and environmental management procedures and controls.



  





**Desired Candidate Profile:**



* Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field.
* Minimum of 10 years of relevant professional experience in digital implementation, innovation, or a related field, with minimum 5 years in a managerial role, preferably within the Oil \& Gas or Petrochemical Industry.
* Certifications in project management, such as PMP (Project Management Professional) would be added as an advantage.

data.jd_text:
A leading regional bank is seeking a highly accomplished professional to spearhead the management of complex corporate restructuring and recovery mandates.
 



  





 This executive leadership role is responsible for managing and resolving stressed corporate exposures, developing recovery and restructuring strategies, preserving asset value, and maximizing recoveries across a diverse portfolio of corporate and commercial relationships.
 



 The successful candidate will work closely with senior management, business units, legal counsel, and external stakeholders to deliver effective turnaround, restructuring, and recovery solutions while ensuring sound risk management and regulatory compliance.
 



  





**Main Responsibilities** 




  




* Lead the Corporate Recovery \& Restructuring function and oversee the management of stressed and non\-performing corporate credit exposures.
* Develop and implement recovery, restructuring, and turnaround strategies for complex corporate relationships.
* Negotiate restructuring arrangements, settlements, and recovery plans with borrowers and other stakeholders.
* Assess business viability, cash flows, collateral positions, and recovery prospects to formulate optimal resolution strategies.
* Work closely with Corporate Banking, Credit Risk, Legal, and external advisors to manage problem accounts effectively.
* Oversee legal recovery actions, enforcement proceedings, and collateral realization where required.
* Monitor portfolio performance and recommend proactive measures to mitigate potential losses.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and governance standards.
* Provide strategic insights and portfolio updates to Executive Management and relevant committees.
* Lead and develop a team of recovery and restructuring professionals, fostering a high\-performance culture.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, Law, or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification is preferred.
* Minimum 15 years of banking experience, with significant exposure to Corporate Recovery, Restructuring, Special Assets, Credit Risk, or Workout functions.
* Proven track record in managing large and complex corporate restructuring and recovery cases.
* Strong understanding of corporate finance, credit analysis, restructuring frameworks, insolvency processes, and legal recovery mechanisms.
* Experience dealing with large corporate groups, family\-owned businesses, and syndicated lending arrangements.
* Strong negotiation, stakeholder management, analytical, and leadership capabilities.



  





**Key Competencies** 




  




* Strategic Thinking
* Corporate Restructuring \& Turnaround Management
* Credit Risk Management
* Stakeholder Negotiation
* Portfolio Management
* Regulatory \& Governance Compliance
* Leadership \& Team Development

**Executive Director – Data Centre Business Unit \| Qatar** 




  





 An exceptional opportunity has arisen with a leading organisation at the forefront of delivering mission\-critical digital infrastructure across the Middle East.
 



  





 We are seeking an accomplished
 **Executive Director – Data Centre Business Unit** 
 to lead and drive the strategic growth, operational performance, and successful delivery of a rapidly expanding portfolio of hyperscale and large\-scale colocation data centre projects across the MENA region.
 



  





 Reporting to the Executive Leadership Team, this role carries full
 **P\&L responsibility** 
 for the business unit and will oversee all aspects of business operations, including strategy development, business growth, client engagement, project delivery, commercial performance, and talent leadership. The successful candidate will play a critical role in positioning the organisation as a market leader within the region's evolving data centre sector.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Develop and execute the strategic vision, business plan, and growth objectives for the Data Centre Business Unit.
* Provide executive leadership across all functions, ensuring the successful delivery of hyperscale and colocation data centre projects.
* Hold overall accountability for the business unit's financial performance, including revenue growth, profitability, forecasting, budgeting, and cost control.
* Lead business development initiatives, identifying new market opportunities and securing strategic partnerships with clients, investors, and key industry stakeholders.
* Build and maintain executive\-level relationships with hyperscale operators, developers, consultants, EPC contractors, technology partners, and government entities.
* Oversee the performance of multidisciplinary teams across project management, engineering, construction, commercial, procurement, and operations functions.
* Ensure projects are delivered in line with contractual obligations, programme milestones, quality standards, and client expectations.
* Drive operational excellence through the implementation of best practices, governance frameworks, and robust risk management processes.
* Champion a culture of safety, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement across the business unit.
* Lead organisational planning, workforce development, succession planning, and the recruitment and retention of high\-performing talent.
* Provide strategic oversight of major bids, contract negotiations, and commercial agreements.
* Monitor market trends, emerging technologies, and competitive activity to inform business strategy and maintain market leadership.
* Represent the organisation at executive forums, industry events, and client engagements to strengthen brand presence and industry relationships.
* Deliver regular performance reporting and strategic recommendations to the Board and Executive Leadership Team.



  





**Requirements:** 



* Degree qualified in Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline. A Master's degree or MBA would be advantageous.
* A minimum of 15 years' experience within the construction, engineering, or digital infrastructure sectors, including significant exposure to mission\-critical facilities and data centres.
* Proven experience leading a business unit, division, or major operational function with full P\&L responsibility.
* Demonstrated success in developing and executing growth strategies within the data centre, mission\-critical, or major infrastructure sectors.
* Extensive experience managing complex stakeholder environments and maintaining relationships at C\-suite and executive levels.
* Strong commercial acumen with expertise in contract negotiations, financial management, and business performance optimisation.
* Track record of successfully leading large multidisciplinary teams across multiple projects and geographical locations.
* Comprehensive understanding of data centre delivery models, including hyperscale and colocation environments.
* Middle East experience is highly desirable, with an understanding of regional market dynamics and procurement practices.
* Familiarity with hyperscale client standards and delivery expectations, including those of AWS, Microsoft, Google, Meta, or Oracle, would be advantageous.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, influencing, and decision\-making skills, with the ability to inspire teams and drive organisational success.



  





 This is a unique opportunity to lead a high\-growth business at the centre of the Middle East's digital transformation agenda. The successful candidate will have the platform to shape strategy, expand market presence, and deliver world\-class data centre infrastructure that will support the region's future economic and technological ambitions.

* Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel; experience with analytics or IT performance tools is a strong advantage

**Why Join** 




 This is a high\-impact role at the centre of IT strategy execution, offering visibility across all major technology initiatives and direct engagement with senior IT leadership. You will play a pivotal role in shaping how performance, governance, and transformation success are defined and delivered.
