data.jd_text:
Akura Medical, a Shifamed portfolio company, is advancing a differentiated platform for the treatment of venous thromboembolism (VTE), which affects up to 900,000 Americans each year. The company recently received US IDE approval for its QUADRA\-PE study evaluating the Katana™ Thrombectomy System in acute pulmonary embolism patients. In parallel, Akura Medical is developing NavIQ™, a software platform that transforms CT angiograms into 3D pulmonary vascular models to enhance visualization, procedural planning, and clot assessment towards better safety, efficacy, and ease of use. Akura has recently completed a $53 million first close of its Series C financing, led by the Qatar Investment Authority, supporting the launch of a joint venture and a new R\&D and manufacturing center in Doha, Qatar.
 



  





 ABOUT SHIFAMED
 



 Founded in 2009 by serial entrepreneur Amr Salahieh, Shifamed LLC is a privately held medical device innovation hub focused on the development of novel medical products to address clinical needs in the rapidly evolving fields of cardiology and ophthalmology.
 



  





**Description:** 




  





 The Clinical Affairs Manager (MENA Region) will serve as the primary clinical and operational lead for establishing and managing clinical trials across multiple countries in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region on behalf of Akura Medical. Based in Doha, Qatar, this individual will be responsible for all aspects of clinical study execution in the region from site identification and regulatory submissions through enrollment, data collection, and closeout. The ideal candidate is a highly self\-sufficient, resourceful professional who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment with limited on\-the\-ground infrastructure. A strong preference will be given to candidates with clinical/procedural expertise in interventional cardiology, interventional radiology, or vascular surgery who can provide direct case coverage and physician\-level technical support for interventional procedures alongside treating physicians.
 



  





**Responsibilities, Skills \& Hands\-On Experience:** 




  





 Regional Clinical Trial Setup \& Management
 


* Serve as the primary operational lead for clinical studies in the MENA region for both NavIQ and Akura Medical’s PE thrombectomy device programs.
* Lead the planning, design, and execution of clinical studies (IDE, post\-market, PMCF, registries, and observational studies) in alignment with business and regulatory strategy.
* Ensures the project is planned and conducted in accordance with all applicable regulations, standard operating procedures, and good clinical practices (GCP).
* Develop, review, and manage clinical study documentation, including protocols, informed consent forms, case report forms (CRFs), statistical plans (as applicable), and clinical trial agreements.
* Coordinate site identification, evaluation, selection, initiation, monitoring, and close‑out activities across multiple MENA countries (including Qatar, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and others as applicable).
* Drive all site start\-up activities including regulatory and ethics committee (EC/IRB) submissions, budget negotiations, and contract finalization.
* Manage and maintain inspection\-ready Trial Master File (TMF) and related clinical documentation in compliance with applicable regulations.
* Provide oversight of site performance, enrollment, data quality, and protocol compliance.
* Develops detailed project plans, and monitors project milestones against performance indicators.
* Coordinate investigational device shipments, accountability logs, and supply chain logistics within the region.
* Plans, directs, creates, and communicates the study timeline including but not limited to generating reports to provide regular status updates to the US\-based clinical team and senior management.



 Vendor \& Budget Oversight
 


* Manage and oversee clinical research organizations (CROs), laboratories, and other vendors to ensure delivery of contracted services.
* Develop and manage study budgets, forecasts, and resource plans; monitor expenditures against approved budgets.
* Identify and mitigate operational, timeline, and budgetary risks.



 Regulatory \& Compliance
 


* Navigate country\-specific regulatory landscapes across MENA to obtain necessary approvals for investigational device studies.
* Ensure all clinical activities comply with ICH GCP, ISO 14155, local regulatory requirements, and sponsor SOPs.
* Support preparation of regulatory submissions, audits, and inspections.
* Prepare sites for potential regulatory inspections; serve as the primary regional contact for regulatory queries.
* Manage risk assessment and mitigation.



 Clinical \& Physician Support
 


* Provide direct procedural support and case coverage alongside interventional cardiologists, interventional radiologists, and vascular surgeons performing PE thrombectomy procedures using NavIQ and Akura devices (preferred).
* Train physicians, clinical staff, and coordinators on device use, study protocols, and data collection requirements.
* Serve as the primary technical and clinical liaison between study sites and the sponsor.
* Attend cases as needed and provide real\-time guidance and troubleshooting support in the catheterization lab or hybrid OR.



 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
 


* Provide guidance, training, and operational oversight to Clinical Research Associates (CRAs) and other study team members, as applicable.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of clinical operations processes, procedures, and best practices.
* Work closely with US\-based clinical affairs, regulatory, R\&D, and quality teams to align regional activities with overall program goals.
* Support planning and execution of investigator meetings, site training sessions, and regional advisory boards.



  





**Education \& Work Experience:** 



* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related healthcare field (advanced degree or clinical licensure preferred e.g., MD, RN, RT, PA, or equivalent).
* 5–7 years of experience in clinical research, with minimum of 2 years in the medical device industry.
* Demonstrated experience managing pre\-market and/or post\-market medical device clinical studies.
* Hands\-on experience in interventional cardiology, interventional radiology, or vascular surgery (either as a clinician, clinical specialist, or field clinical engineer).
* Direct experience in the MENA region is highly preferred; ability to provide direct case coverage is a significant advantage.
* Familiarity with PE treatment, VTE management, or catheter\-based thrombectomy procedures is strongly preferred.
* Deep understanding of MENA regulatory environments and experience navigating multi\-country clinical submissions (Saudi Arabia SFDA, UAE MOH/DOH, Qatar MOPH, and others).
* Strong knowledge of good clinical practice (ICH GCP, ISO 14155\), and international regulatory requirements for medical device trials.
* Excellent interpersonal skills with demonstrated experience building relationships with KOLs, physicians, and hospital administration across the MENA region.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic language proficiency is a significant plus.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); experience with EDC systems and electronic TMF platforms.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively within the MENA region (50–70% travel expected).
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional environment.
* Demonstrated leadership and problem\-solving capabilities.



  





 Our salary ranges are calculated by role, level, and location. Please note that your position within that range will be determined by your job\-related knowledge, location, skills, experience, relevant education, and training/certifications.
 



  





 NOTICE TO CANDIDATES: Please be aware that Shifamed and its portfolio companies do not conduct interviews or extend offers through mobile web chat applications. Please report any such occurrences to hr@shifamed.com.

data.jd_text:
We exist to create positive change for people and the planet. Join us and make a difference too!
   

  

****Overview / Purpose Of The Position****
 The internal and supplier assurance (ISA) business partners with clients to build trust within their organisations and across their value chains. ISA has undergone tremendous growth, and this strategic role will support this growth across the EMEA region by shaping our approach to delivering client solutions, enabling us to add greater value to our clients and enhance our client centricity, whilst harmonising with global and other regional efforts.
   

  

 The Head of Operations will build the EMEA operational framework for this business line, integrating it seamlessly into the company's established processes while ensuring it operates with commercial discipline, efficiency, and scalability, all whilst ensuring alignment with the global ISA community to drive standardisation.
   

  

 This role requires a leader who can create a tightly integrated delivery engine that ensures quality, efficiency, margin control, and regulatory readiness, without duplicating the company’s infrastructure. The successful candidate will combine strong operational leadership with a solid understanding of professional services, preferably within audit or advisory environments.
   

  

****Responsibilities \& Accountabilities****
* Process: This role will collaborate with relevant stakeholders to define the client journey for ISA throughout EMEA whilst working closely with global teams to ensure alignment.


**This Will Result In a Process That:**
* Is clearer, better understood, and aligned and embedded across the globe.
* Is more efficient and effective in servicing both EMEA and global client contracts.
* Is considerate and aligned to the future direction and growth of the ISA business.
* incorporates governance and transparency at its core.
* Effectively leverages existing best practices
* Operational delivery: This role will be responsible for working with direct reports and other regional leaders to mobilise our teams to deploy a client\-centric solution across our clients. They will maintain within the region the competencies and roles required to support the operational delivery of the ISA programs, and collaborate with the respective regions to develop these competencies more widely to support EMEA programs.


**This Will Result In:**
* A clear framework of the competencies required when delivering an ISA program.
* Greater understanding of and alignment with the competencies adopted across the regions.
* Increased capacity and capability to support the ISA programs.
* Improved program performance and impact on the client organisation
* The sales teams feel more supported when engaging with or building client proposals, and confident in our ability and expertise to deliver the solution.
* Global Hub: This role will be responsible for aligning EMEA operations with the global Hub


 This will result in greater clarity in the roles and responsibilities of the hub
   

  

* Governance: This role will work collaboratively with the respective compliance teams to ensure ISA controls and processes are appropriate, proportionate to the risk, embedded and effective.


**This Will Result In:**
* Risk mitigation to a reasonable level
* The forming and maintaining of strong external relationships with internal compliance teams
* The forming and maintaining of strong external relationships with associations and regulators, keeping abreast of changes, and ensuring they are translated into our ways of working
* Performance:
* This role will be responsible for delivering ISA revenue and growth across EMEA, whilst working with the global team to drive global growth and revenue. This will result in
* Deeper understanding of ISA performance at a client and program level
* An established cadence of performance monitoring
* Greater focus and emphasis on improving business performance.
* More insights to feed into business forecast and strategic resource planning.


**Travel requirements:** 
 EMEA travel as required to support business and client activity.
   

  

 VP1
   

  

****About Us****
 BSI is a business improvement and standards company and for over a century BSI has been recognized for having a positive impact on organizations and society, building trust and enhancing lives.
   

  

 Today BSI partners with more than 77,500 clients in 195 countries and engages with a 15,000 strong global community of experts, industry and consumer groups, organizations and governments.
   

  

 Utilizing its extensive expertise in key industry sectors \- including automotive, aerospace, built environment, food and retail, and healthcare \- BSI delivers on its purpose by helping its clients fulfil theirs.
   

  

 Living by our core values of Client\-Centricity, Agility, and Collaboration, BSI provides organizations with the confidence to grow by partnering with them to tackle society’s critical issues – from climate change to building trust in digital transformation and everything in between \- to accelerate progress towards a better society and a sustainable world.
   

  

 BSI is an Equal Opportunity Employer dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

data.jd_text:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers its members to perform at a higher level by providing a deep understanding of the interactions between their unique physiology and chosen behaviors.
   

  

 We’re looking for a talented leader to help open WHOOP Labs Doha, our first international product research facility. The Doha lab will partner with the WHOOP Labs Boston team to conduct mixed\-methods research to support physiology, user experience, and consumer studies. To serve the company’s diverse testing and validation needs, WHOOP Labs completes tens of thousands of data collections a year and creates best in class experience for our participants. WHOOP Labs Doha will set the bar for product innovation research in the GCC, setting strategy for participant experience and contributing to advancing WHOOP technology.
   

  

 We’re looking for someone with a proven track record collaborating internationally and leading a cross\-functional team, who is excited to work with our members and isn’t afraid to roll up their sleeves and get sweaty. This position is in\-person in Doha, Qatar with potential travel to Boston, MA 1\-2 times per year.
   

  

**This role is based in the Doha, Qatar. We will only consider candidates who currently live in Doha, Qatar.**
**Responsibilities**
* Own the development and execution of the WHOOP Labs Doha opening strategy, including team hiring, participant compensation structure, and setting operating hours
* Champion research integrity, including ensuring that data collection tools and team practices align with local regulations for ethical human subjects research
* Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of program initiatives and track progress towards goals
* Ensure clear communication between the Boston and Doha labs, developing ways of working that support multi\-facility research execution
* Represent Doha culture and unique participant experience factors in broader strategic conversations with the rest of the WHOOP human subjects research team
* Build the WHOOP Labs Doha brand and represent WHOOP in the GCC region
* Reports to the Director of Human Subjects Research


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in a field related to human subjects research such as psychology, neuroscience, exercise physiology, or consumer science
* 5\+ years of full\-time professional experience in a related area
* 2\+ years of success leading a diversely skilled team
* Experience working on a distributed international team preferred
* Deep knowledge of local culture and ability to thoughtfully communicate localization considerations for research at WHOOP Labs Doha
* Understanding of best practices regarding human subjects research, including how to obtain IRB approval for new research projects; research ethics, data privacy, and consent
* Track record of successful project management, including resource allocation, timeline management, and risk mitigation
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills, ability to plan ahead while still being flexible and able to work around challenges
* Strong networking and collaboration skills, with experience in building partnerships and engaging with external stakeholders
* Ability to present findings to stakeholders and effectively communicate with company leaders
* Excitement to work in a high\-energy, fast\-paced startup environment
* Understanding of branding and marketing as it applies to research in industry spaces
* Fluency in verbal and written English, WHOOP’s working language


**This role is based in the Doha, Qatar. We will only consider candidates who currently live in Doha, Qatar.**
 Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.
   

  

 WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E\-verify to determine employment eligibility. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

 At Rosewood Doha, we create an environment where passion meets purpose – and where careers have meaning.

**Our Associate Experience:** 




 We believe exceptional work deserves exceptional care. At Rosewood Doha, we offer a thoughtfully designed associate experience that supports your wellbeing, growth and life beyond work. This includes:
 



 \-

data.raw_snippet:

 QCRI is seeking an Executive Director to provide strategic and visionary leadership in high\-priority areas of computer science and artificial intelligence. Preference will be given to candidates with a clear, uninterrupted, and active research track record in computing\-relate
data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose** 




 QCRI is seeking an Executive Director to provide strategic and visionary leadership in high\-priority areas of computer science and artificial intelligence. Preference will be given to candidates with a clear, uninterrupted, and active research track record in computing\-related disciplines, along with a strong awareness of emerging developments in AI. The Executive Director is responsible for advancing QCRI’s research excellence, innovation, and global impact. This includes setting the institute’s strategic research direction, fostering a dynamic and collaborative research environment, securing diverse funding sources, and strengthening partnerships with leading universities, research centers, industry partners, and global technology companies. The Executive Director oversees the institute’s budget, recruitment, and mentorship activities.
 



  





**Job Description** 




 The Executive Director should articulate a clear and compelling vision that leverages emerging global trends while capitalizing on strategic opportunities in Qatar and the broader region. The Executive Director is expected to:
 



 • Develop and implement a research strategy aligned with HBKU, Qatar Foundation, national priorities, and global scientific opportunities.
 



 • Provide scientific and organizational leadership to advance QCRI’s mission and research excellence.
 



 • Lead interdisciplinary, mission\-driven research programs that address national and global challenges.
 



 • Build strategic partnerships with industry, government, academia, and leading global technology organizations.
 



 • Strengthen QCRI’s international reputation through scientific leadership, collaborations, and major research initiatives.
 



 • Drive research impact through publications, technologies, platforms, products, and contributions to policy and practice.
 



 • Expand external funding and strategic investments to support research growth and sustainability.
 



 • Promote and lead collaboration across HBKU, Qatar Foundation, and external partners to maximize research and innovation impact.
 



 • Recruit, develop, and retain outstanding researchers and promote a high\-performance research culture.
 



 • Mentor and support the development of early\-career researchers and emerging scientific leaders, with particular emphasis on building local research talent.
 



  





**Minimum Knowledge, Skills \& Experience** 



* Ph.D. in Computer Science or a closely related field, with an internationally recognized record of research excellence and scientific impact.
* Extensive progressive experience in research and technology development and in overseeing large\-scale programs and teams.
* Demonstrated experience in leading and managing research, innovation, and technology development projects.
* Proven ability to build, lead, mentor, and motivate high\-performing multidisciplinary research teams.
* Strong understanding of national and international frameworks, policies, and ethical considerations related to computing, artificial intelligence, and digital technologies.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills; proficiency in Arabic is an advantage.

data.jd_text:
**🚀 Welcome to Your Next Adventure!**
 We are looking for a Deputy Director – Food Operations to fully own the operational performance of our Food vertical.
   

  

 This is a standalone, high\-impact role focused on execution, optimization, and profitability. You will work directly with the COO to translate strategy into disciplined operational outcomes. Food is a high\-frequency, high\-pressure business — it demands precision, speed, and strong judgment under constant movement.
   

  

 You will be responsible for the operational engine of the Food vertical: vendor performance, delivery efficiency, cost structures, contribution margins, and overall vertical performance health. Every operational lever that impacts reliability, scalability, and profitability will sit under your direct ownership.
   

  

 This is not a coordination role. It is a performance role.
   

  

**🛠 What You’ll Get Your Hands On**
* Operational Strategy \& Execution
* Partner closely with the COO to define and execute the Food operations roadmap.
* Convert strategic priorities into measurable KPIs and execution plans.
* Ensure sustainable order growth while protecting contribution margins and operational stability.
* Drive operational readiness for expansions, new initiatives, and structural improvements across the vertical.
* Food Vertical Performance \& Unit Economics
* Own the core performance metrics of the Food vertical including fulfillment rate, SLA adherence, cancellation rate, delivery time, cost per order, rider productivity, and customer satisfaction.
* Continuously optimize supply\-demand balance in dense operating environments.
* Refine incentive structures for riders and restaurant partners with a clear understanding of their economic impact.
* Work closely with Finance to model profitability scenarios and implement cost control initiatives.
* You should deeply understand how prep time affects dispatch logic, how batching impacts utilization, and how operational mechanics influence margin.
* Process Optimization \& Scalability
* Identify inefficiencies across the Food operational lifecycle and eliminate them through structured, data\-driven problem solving. Standardize SOPs and improve operational consistency.
* Collaborate with Product and Tech to automate manual workflows and enhance dispatch, batching, and visibility tools.
* Lead root cause analysis for service failures and implement corrective action frameworks that prevent recurrence.
* Restaurant Operations \& Partner Success
* Monitor and improve restaurant operational metrics including prep time accuracy, acceptance rates, SLA compliance, and order quality.
* Work closely with Commercial to ensure operational feasibility during onboarding and scaling.
* Reduce friction between restaurants and logistics by introducing structured performance frameworks and clear accountability mechanisms.
* Analytics \& Performance Discipline
* Lead weekly and monthly performance reviews backed by data and actionable insights.
* Build and refine dashboards, reporting structures, and performance scorecards that directly influence operational decisions.
* Leverage demand forecasting, cohort analysis, and behavioural data to identify growth and efficiency levers. When metrics shift, you understand why — and you act decisively.

* 10\+ years of operational experience, with at least 5–7 years in food delivery, high\-frequency platforms, or tech\-enabled logistics environments.

* Background in logistics, food operations, commercial strategy, or product operations within leading global platforms is strongly preferred. You must understand supply\-demand balance, incentive systems, batching logic, dispatch optimization, and unit economics at a structural level.

data.jd_text:
**Role Procurement Manager\-Hospitality Industry preferably.** 








 Department Operations Division Society Sport Center Reporting To Operations Director Direct Reports Senior Procurement O icer, Warehouse Supervisor
 



  





 Works Closely With: Operations Director, Finance Manager, Club Manager (Centro Mall), Regional Ops Manager, Head of Living, Facilities Management Supervisor, F\&B Manager, IT Systems \& Support Technician, External Suppliers \& Contractors 
 



  





**Role and Purpose:** 




  





 The Procurement Manager is responsible for leading and delivering e ective procurement across the Society portfolio, ensuring we source high\-quality goods and services that represent best value while protecting our premium brand standards. This role plays a key part in supporting our growth as Qatar's leading multi\-brand wellness and lifestyle group by building strong supplier partnerships, driving commercial e iciencies, and enabling the seamless delivery of products and services that underpin an exceptional member experience. The Procurement Manager reports directly to the Operations Director and leads a team comprising the Senior Procurement O icer, Facility Management Supervisor, and Warehouse Supervisor. 
 



  





**Key Responsibilities :** 




 Strategy \& Planning • Develop and deliver a Group procurement strategy aligned to business objectives, growth plans, and Society's premium brand standards.
 



 • Build and maintain a procurement roadmap covering all categories — fitness equipment, F\&B, spa \& wellness, facilities, maintenance, retail, IT, and professional services.
 



 • Identify opportunities for consolidation, cost optimisation, and total cost of ownership improvements across all spending categories.
 



 • Contribute to annual budget planning alongside Finance and Operations, ensuring procurement commitments are accurately reflected. Sourcing \& Supplier Management 
 



 Lead competitive sourcing processes (RFI, RFQ, RFP) across all procurement categories, ensuring transparency and best value.
 



 • Identify, qualify, and onboard suppliers capable of meeting Society's quality, sustainability, performance, and compliance standards.
 



 • Maintain a curated supplier register for Qatar and GCC markets, including preferred and approved vendor lists.
 



 • Manage the full supplier lifecycle — onboarding, performance monitoring, review, renewal, and exit — with clear KPIs and SLAs.
 



 • Build and sustain strategic supplier partnerships, acting as the primary relationship owner for key Group accounts. Contract Negotiation \& Commercial Management
 



 • Negotiate commercial terms, pricing structures, payment terms, and contractual obligations across all supplier agreements.
 



 • Own the Group's supplier contract library, ensuring all agreements are current, compliant, and commercially advantageous.
 



 • Work closely with Finance and, where required, legal counsel on contractual risk, warranties, indemnities, and dispute resolution.
 



 • Monitor spend against contracts and budgets, escalating variances and recommending corrective actions. Facilities, Maintenance \& Capital Projects
 



 • Procure planned and reactive maintenance services, engineering support, and specialist contractors across all sites.
 



 • Support capital projects including club refurbishments, new location openings, and fitness equipment upgrades.
 



 • Work in partnership with the Facility Management Supervisor to ensure all facilitiesrelated procurement is delivered on time and within budget.
 



 • Ensure compliance with Qatar health, safety, and building regulations across all contractor and supplier engagements. Operations \& Category Management
 



 • Manage procurement across key categories: gym equipment, F\&B supplies, spa products, retail merchandise, uniforms, IT hardware and software, marketing materials, and professional services.
 



 • Coordinate with the Warehouse Supervisor to ensure stock levels, receiving processes, and inventory management align with operational requirements.
 



 • Manage import logistics, customs clearance coordination, and supplier lead times to minimise supply chain disruption. • Drive continuous improvement in procurement processes, systems, and controls. Governance \& Compliance
 



 • Ensure all procurement activity complies with Qatar commercial law, Group financial policies, and Al Mana Group governance frameworks.
 



 • Maintain accurate procurement records, spend analytics, and reporting for the Operations Director and Finance Manager. 
 



 Implement and enforce purchasing controls, authorisation limits, and approval workflows. Team Leadership • Lead, develop, and performance\-manage the Senior Procurement O icer and Warehouse Supervisor.
 



 • Set clear objectives, provide regular feedback, and support the professional development of direct reports.
 



 • Foster a collaborative, high\-performance culture within the procurement function. 
 



**What Success Looks Like (KPIs)** 




 • Cost savings and value delivered against procurement budget targets
 



 . • Supplier performance: SLA and KPI compliance across key categories
 



 . • Contract coverage: percentage of spend under active, managed contracts.
 



 • PPM completion rate and reactive maintenance SLA compliance (via Facility Management Supervisor).
 



 • Procurement cycle time: speed from requisition to purchase order.
 



 • 100% compliance with Qatar commercial regulations and Al Mana Group governance standards.
 



 • Senior Procurement O icer and Warehouse Supervisor team engagement and development.
 



  





**Experience \& Qualifications Experience** 




  





 • Minimum 5 years' experience in a Procurement Manager or Senior Procurement role within a hospitality, leisure, wellness, or multi\-site F\&B environment, where category breadth and premium service standards are essential.
 



 • Demonstrated expertise in end\-to\-end procurement: strategy, sourcing, supplier management, contract negotiation, and performance monitoring
 



 • Proven track record procuring across a broad range of hospitality categories — F\&B and beverage supplies; FF\&E (furniture, fixtures \& equipment); OS\&E (operating supplies \& equipment); fitness and gym equipment; spa \& wellness; uniforms and linen; cleaning, hygiene and consumables; facilities, MEP and maintenance; retail merchandise; IT; marketing; and professional services.
 



 • Hands\-on experience across both capital procurement (fit\-out, FF\&E, equipment and new openings) and day\-to\-day operational procurement (consumables, supplies and services).
 



 • Experience supporting venue openings and refurbishments — including FF\&E and OS\&E specification, sourcing and delivery to opening deadlines — within a hospitality or leisure setting.
 



 • Experience managing complex supplier contracts and negotiating commercial agreements in a GCC or international environment.  
 



 Proven experience managing procurement budgets and delivering cost savings without compromising quality or brand standards.
 



 • Track record of leading and developing a small procurement or operations team. • Experience working cross\-functionally with Finance, Operations, and Facilities teams.
 



 • Familiarity with Qatar or GCC supplier markets, import/logistics processes, and relevant commercial regulations is highly desirable.
 



 • Experience with procurement technology (ERP systems, e\-procurement platforms, spend analytics tools) is advantageous.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Finance, or a related field.
 



 • CIPS Level 4 or above (Chartered Institute of Procurement \& Supply) — or working towards. CIPS Level 5/6 (MCIPS) is highly desirable.
 



 • Additional qualifications in facilities management, project management (PRINCE2\), or health \& safety (NEBOSH/IOSH) are advantageous.
 



 • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (advanced), ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or equivalent), and contract management software. 
 



  





**Key Competencies** 




 • Commercial acumen — confident negotiator with a strong grasp of cost drivers, contract structures, and value optimization.
 



 • Strategic thinking — ability to set and deliver a procurement strategy that supports business growth and brand excellence.
 



 • Supplier relationship management — skilled at building and sustaining partnerships with suppliers at all levels.
 



 • Analytical capability — strong spend analysis, cost modelling, and data\-driven decision\-making skills.
 



 • Leadership — confident team leader who sets clear direction, develops capability, and holds people accountable.
 



 • Stakeholder management — credible and influential at all levels across the Group.
 



 • Attention to detail — rigorous approach to contract review, spend tracking, and compliance.
 



 • Organisation \& prioritisation — able to manage a broad workload across multiple categories and sites simultaneously.
 



 • Integrity \& governance — demonstrates the highest standards of commercial ethics and governance.  
 



  





  





  





 Interested applicant can apply on careers@society.qa

 We are looking for an Engineering Lead to own and drive Snoonu's Conversational AI and Driver Automation platform — a portfolio spanning IVR systems, multi\-channel chatbots, and a production\-grade multi\-agent Agentic AI framework built on AWS Bedrock. You will lead a focused team of AI Engineers and Python Backend Engineers, turning operational SOPs into autonomous, reliable workflows that serve drivers in real time across Qatar.
   

  

 In this role you will set the technical direction, establish engineering standards, and own delivery end\-to\-end — from architecture decisions and code reviews to observability and cost governance. You will work directly with the R\&D Director and Product to shape what gets built next, then lead your team to ship it with excellence.
   

  

**🛠 What You’ll Get Your Hands On**
 Team Leadership \& Delivery:
   

  

* 
+ Lead, mentor, and grow a cross\-functional team of AI Engineers and Python Backend Engineers — driving technical quality, delivery velocity, and engineering culture.
+ Own sprint planning, technical scope definition, and delivery commitments for the conversational AI and driver automation domain.
+ Conduct design reviews, define coding standards, and maintain engineering quality across IVR, chatbot, and agentic system codebases.
+ Act as the primary technical interface between Engineering, Product, and Operations for all driver\-facing automation initiatives.
+ Partner with the R\&D Director to shape the team's technical roadmap, evaluate emerging AI capabilities, and surface the next high\-leverage bets.


**IVR \& Voice Automation**
* 
+ Own the architecture and continuous improvement of Snoonu's IVR system, ensuring reliability, low latency, and clean escalation paths for driver calls.
+ Drive design decisions for call flow logic, intent/slot management, DTMF routing, and voice\-to\-action fulfillment.
+ Define and monitor SLAs for IVR uptime, misroute rate, and escalation\-to\-human ratios.


**Conversational AI \& Chatbots**
* 
+ Lead the design and delivery of Snoonu's multi\-agent AI chatbot service for driver support across real\-time chat channels.
+ Own the four\-agent architecture — Coordinator, Data Collector, Rules Agent, and Action Executor — running on AWS Bedrock Agents or similar architecture.
+ Ensure chatbot flows handle driver intents reliably: order removal, vehicle mismatch, ETA extensions, merchant disputes, and escalations.
+ Drive LLM evaluation cycles, prompt strategy, and Bedrock Guardrail design to ensure responses are consistent, safe, and operationally correct.


 Integrate chatbot services with order management, CRM (Salesforce), Slack operations channels, and driver\-facing apps via secure, event\-driven patterns.
   

  

**Agentic AI \& SOP Automation**
* 
+ Lead the buildout and operation of the SOPs\-as\-Code framework — encoding operational SOPs as machine\-readable policies executed by the multi\-agent system.
+ Own the Config File architecture and Config Reader Agent pipeline that converts PDFbased SOPs into deployable agent configurations on AWS Bedrock.
+ Govern the structured rules engine (condition/operator/value schema) to ensure deterministic, auditable decisions with no LLM interpretation ambiguity.
+ Design and enforce human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, escalation triggers, confidence thresholds, and operator override capabilities.
+ Establish versioning, rollback, and safe deployment practices for SOP configuration changes in production.


**AWS Infrastructure \& MLOps**
* 
+ Own the cloud backbone for AI services: Lambda, ECS/Fargate, SQS/SNS, DynamoDB, MongoDB, S3, CloudWatch, and AWS Bedrock.
+ Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for prompt versioning, agent configuration rollout, and automated eval gates before production deployment.
+ Define observability standards — per\-agent\-turn latency SLAs, Bedrock cost tracking, drift detection, and failure alerting.
+ Lead capacity and cost planning as interaction volumes scale across driver and operations channels.


**R\&D \& Innovation**
* 
+ Evaluate frontier LLMs (Claude Sonnet/Opus, open\-weight models) and orchestration frameworks (Bedrock Agents, LangGraph, CrewAI) against Snoonu's operational constraints.
+ Identify and prototype the next AI capability Snoonu should dominate — from experiment to validated proof\-of\-concept with clear go/no\-go criteria.
+ Produce architecture decision records, prompt engineering playbooks, and technical documentation for team\-wide use.


**🧙‍♂️ The Magic You Bring**
**Education**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Software Engineering, or a related field.


**Experience**
* 6–10 years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in a tech lead or engineering management role.
* Demonstrated track record of shipping production conversational AI, IVR, or agentic systems end\-to\-end — not just models, but the full stack from architecture to monitoring. Portfolio, GitHub, or detailed case studies required.
* Hands\-on experience with multi\-agent orchestration on AWS Bedrock or equivalent agentic frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen).
* Prior experience leading a team of 3–8 engineers, with a coaching\-first approach to technical growth.
* Strong Python and backend development skills; able to write, review, and hold the bar on production\-grade code.
* Engineering multiplier: makes every engineer on the team faster and better through design guidance, code reviews, and clear technical direction.
* Ownership without ego: defines problems, architects solutions, ships results — accountable for outcomes across the full platform, not just assigned tickets.
* Operational intelligence: understands the business context of driver support, logistics operations, and the real cost of failure in real\-time systems.
* Senior communicator: articulates trade\-offs (agent reliability vs. automation rate, cost vs. latency) clearly to non\-engineers and influences roadmap decisions through clarity of thought.
* Structured under ambiguity: brings process and rigor to fast\-moving R\&D environments where requirements evolve alongside the build.
* Bias for action: prototypes fast, validates early, and ships iteratively — while maintaining the quality bars that prevent production incidents.
* Collaborative and direct: raises architectural risks early, pushes back on under\-specified requirements, and surfaces trade\-offs before they become delivery blockers.


**Conversational AI \& LLMs (Core)**
* Deep experience with AWS Bedrock — Agents, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, and model invocation; strong preference for Claude Sonnet/Opus via Bedrock.
* Multi\-agent system design: orchestration patterns, agents\-as\-tools, inter\-agent handoffs, context propagation, and failure isolation.
* Prompt engineering: system prompt design, structured output, tool\-use, multi\-turn reasoning, eval\-driven iteration, and red\-teaming for safety.
* Structured rules engines: condition/operator/value schemas for deterministic, noninterpretive decision logic — mandatory in production agentic systems.
* RAG pipelines: embedding models, vector databases (OpenSearch, Pinecone, pgvector), hybrid retrieval, and knowledge base tuning.


**IVR \& Voice**
* IVR architecture: call flow design, intent/slot management, DTMF handling, escalationto\-human routing, and SLA monitoring.
* Experience with STT/TTS pipelines or voice bot platforms is a strong plus.


**AWS Services (Core)**
* Lambda, API Gateway, SQS/SNS, Step Functions, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch — event\-driven and serverless architectures.
* AWS Bedrock Agents: agent creation, alias management, tool action group configuration, and Guardrail policy management.
* IAM, VPC, Secrets Manager — security and environment best practices for AI service deployments.
* CI/CD for AI services: prompt versioning, agent config deployment pipelines, automated evals, and rollback gates.


**Backend \& Engineering**
* Python — async, OOP, clean code; REST API design with FastAPI or Flask.
* MongoDB and DynamoDB — schema design, indexing, querying, and operational monitoring.
* Docker, ECS/Fargate; Git, automated testing, and CI/CD workflows.
* Salesforce integration (APIs, events, data sync) is a strong plus.


**✨ Bonus Points If You Have**
* Knowledge of logistics, food delivery, or real\-time operations domains.
* Arabic language NLP or experience building for Arabic\-speaking markets.
* Familiarity with open\-weight model inference (Ollama, vLLM, HuggingFace Transformers).
* Exposure to multi\-modal AI or voice\-first interaction design.


**Inside Snoonu’s Universe**
 Snoonu is Qatar’s homegrown Super App, reinventing daily life with blazing\-fast delivery, shopping, and more – all in one place. Powered by tech, driven by a global team, and obsessed with making life easier.
   

  

**The Dream We’re Chasing**
 To be the first Qatari Ultra App that propels the region and its community through innovation and technology. We have global ambitions where what we do surpasses norms and limitations every time.
   

  

**The Quest We’re On**
 To radically transform how people live by leveraging technology to connect them with endless possibilities.
   

  

**Our Everyday Superpowers**
**👥 Be Customer Obsessed** 
 : “Focus on the customer and all else will follow.”
   

  

**💪 Act with Integrity:** 
 “We are honest, ethical, and trustworthy in everything we do.”
   

  

**🧪 Be Curious and Creative:** 
 “We constantly innovate and create solutions to bring a lasting positive impact.”
   

  

**🏅Lead by Example and Take Ownership:** 
 “Be the change you want to see and take ownership.”
   

  

**🚀 Work Smart and Deliver Results** 
 : “You can do more by doing less, better, and faster.”
   

  

**👨‍💼 It's All About People:** 
 “Be a team player; together we are stronger.”
   

  

**Perks \& Worklife Magic At Snoonu**
**🌐 Global Vibes** 
 – Collaborate with a worldwide crew.
   

  

**🧠 Brain Boosters** 
 – Learning budgets, access to courses, and tools for your growth.
   

  

 🚒
 **Builder’s Playground**

**Great Place to Work® Certified**
 We’re certified as a Great Place to Work®, a recognition that celebrates a culture we’ve built together where people come first, always. This certification reflects our commitment to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, empowered, and inspired to do their best work.
   

  

**Certified for Excellence**

**Beyond the Code: Giving Back Matters**
 We don’t just build apps. We’re committed to doing business sustainably and giving back to the community that fuels us. From eco\-conscious practices to CSR projects, we’re always finding ways to do better—and we invite you to be a part of that mission.
   

  

**Diversity Isn’t Just a Buzzword**

data.jd_text:
The Director of Engineering is responsible for the strategic leadership, operational management, and continuous improvement of all engineering functions within the hotel. This role oversees the maintenance and reliability of the property's physical assets, including building infrastructure, mechanical, electrical, plumbing (MEP) systems, HVAC, fire and life safety systems, energy management systems, and all back\-of\-house facilities.
 



  





 The incumbent ensures that all engineering operations support the delivery of exceptional guest experiences while maintaining the highest standards of safety, regulatory compliance, sustainability, and financial performance. The Director of Engineering develops long\-term asset management strategies, leads capital improvement initiatives, and drives preventive and predictive maintenance programs to maximize equipment reliability and lifecycle value.
 



  





 As a member of the Executive Committee, the Director of Engineering collaborates closely with hotel leadership to align engineering objectives with overall business goals and serves as the lead coordinator for emergency preparedness and response activities related to facility operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Engineering Operations \& Technical Leadership** 




  




* Provide strategic leadership and oversight of all engineering and maintenance operations across the property.
* Direct the operation, maintenance, and optimization of HVAC systems, chillers, cooling towers, boilers, refrigeration systems, electrical distribution networks, generators, UPS systems, plumbing infrastructure, water treatment systems, swimming pool systems, kitchen and laundry equipment, elevators, and Building Management Systems (BMS).
* Establish and implement preventive and predictive maintenance programs to ensure optimal equipment reliability and minimize operational disruptions.
* Monitor engineering performance indicators, identify opportunities for improvement, and implement corrective actions to enhance operational efficiency.
* Ensure all engineering activities comply with established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and manufacturer recommendations.



  





**Asset Management \& Capital Planning** 




  




* Develop and execute long\-term engineering strategies aligned with the hotel's business objectives and brand standards.
* Lead the development and execution of the annual Engineering Business Plan and departmental objectives.
* Prepare, justify, and manage the annual engineering operating budget and capital expenditure plans.
* Develop and maintain a 5 to 10\-year asset replacement strategy for major plant and equipment.
* Manage renovation projects, equipment upgrades, and capital improvement initiatives from planning through commissioning.
* Supervise contractors, consultants, and project teams to ensure projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and to required specifications.



  





**Financial Management** 




  




* Monitor departmental expenditures and maintain effective control over engineering operating costs.
* Analyze financial reports, payroll summaries, utility consumption trends, and P\&L statements to identify areas for optimization.
* Implement cost\-saving initiatives related to energy consumption, maintenance practices, procurement strategies, and service agreements.
* Ensure effective inventory management and control of engineering tools, spare parts, and consumables.
* Contribute to the annual budgeting and forecasting process.



  





**Energy \& Sustainability Management** 




  




* Lead energy conservation initiatives aimed at reducing utility consumption while maintaining guest comfort and operational efficiency.
* Monitor and optimize electricity, water, gas, and fuel usage through data\-driven analysis and system enhancements.
* Promote sustainable engineering practices and support environmental initiatives aligned with corporate sustainability objectives.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements that enhance operational performance and reduce environmental impact.



  





**Fire, Life Safety \& Regulatory Compliance** 




  




* Ensure full compliance with all applicable local regulations, Qatar Civil Defence requirements, health and safety standards, environmental regulations, and hotel brand standards.
* Maintain the operational readiness of all fire detection, fire suppression, emergency lighting, evacuation, and life safety systems.
* Oversee the testing, inspection, certification, and maintenance of all statutory systems and equipment.
* Ensure all permits, licenses, certifications, and maintenance records remain current and readily available for audit purposes.
* Serve as the Chairperson of the Emergency Response Team and lead preparedness planning for facility\-related emergencies.



  





**Team Leadership \& Talent Development** 




  




* Lead, mentor, and develop the engineering management team and technical staff to foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Establish clear performance expectations and conduct regular performance evaluations.
* Identify training needs and facilitate technical and leadership development initiatives.
* Promote a safe working environment through effective implementation of health and safety practices.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, labor regulations, and disciplinary procedures.
* Encourage employee engagement through open communication, recognition programs, and succession planning initiatives.



  





**Guest Experience \& Service Excellence** 




  




* Support hotel operations by ensuring all guest\-facing facilities remain in excellent working condition.
* Respond proactively to engineering\-related guest concerns and implement corrective measures to prevent recurrence.
* Collaborate with operational departments to minimize disruption during maintenance activities.
* Drive initiatives that enhance comfort, reliability, and overall guest satisfaction through engineering excellence.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  





**Education** 




  




* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, Facilities Management, or a related discipline from an accredited institution.
* Professional certifications in HVAC, electrical systems, facilities management, energy management, or project management will be considered an advantage.



  





**Experience** 




  




* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive engineering experience within luxury hospitality environments, including at least 3–5 years in a senior engineering leadership role.
* Proven experience managing large\-scale hotel engineering operations, preferably within internationally recognized five\-star hotels or resorts.
* Demonstrated expertise in preventive maintenance programs, asset lifecycle management, and capital project execution.
* Experience managing engineering budgets, utility optimization programs, and vendor relationships.



  





**Technical Competencies** 




  




* Strong knowledge of HVAC systems, refrigeration plants, electrical distribution systems, plumbing systems, water treatment processes, fire and life safety systems, Building Management Systems (BMS), and Energy Management Systems (EMS).
* Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS).
* Thorough understanding of Qatar Civil Defence regulations, local statutory requirements, and international hospitality engineering standards.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, technical manuals, and financial reports.



  





**Leadership Competencies** 




  




* Strategic thinking and business acumen.
* Strong decision\-making and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent project management and organizational skills.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to lead high\-performing teams in a fast\-paced hospitality environment.
* Commitment to service excellence, continuous improvement, and operational integrity

 Who We Are
   

  

 The Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures\-and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

**About BCG Platinion**
 BCG Platinion's presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. We achieve digital excellence for clients with sustained solutions to the most complex and time\-sensitive challenge. We guide clients into the future to push the status quo, overcome tech limitations, and enable our clients to go further in their digital journeys than what has ever been possible in the past. At BCG Platinion, we deliver business value through the innovative use of technology at a rapid pace. We roll up our sleeves to transform business, revolutionize approaches, satisfy customers, and change the game through Architecture, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Application and Risk functions. We balance vision with a pragmatic path to change transforming strategies into leading\-edge tech platforms, at scale.
   

  

**Practice Area**
 BCG Platinion launched in Germany in 2000 to add deep technical expertise to the Boston Consulting Group’s existing capabilities. Today, our presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. Our New York\-based North American team began in 2014 and in 2017 acquired MAYA Design, a Pittsburgh\-based digital design and innovation lab, to grow our capabilities around technology and design.
   

  

 We support our clients’ total digital transformation through technology, design, cybersecurity, and risk management \& financial engineering capabilities. And together with BCG, BCG Platinion’s interdisciplinary team of technical experts enable customized technical solutions and accelerate delivery value through new business platforms, application consolidations, and major system implementations.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a Principal IT/Digital in the Energy Practice, you will work closely with our client's leadership teams to understand their key challenges, define IT strategies, win buy\-in for your recommendations and lead fellow BCG case team members to transform client potential into performance with high\-impact assignments. You will deploy customized IT strategies, digital platforms and architecture in order to leverage the digital potential of our customers in order to deliver long lasting value. You will evaluate and coach our clients' technology teams, manage quality and risk while maintaining client expectations and escalations. Besides the functional guidance of the project team you will also be operationally responsible for the execution and management of the solution. Together with our clients you will develop convincing IT strategies, concepts and solutions that have a lasting impact on the organization, operating model, digital, and/or data landscape.
   

  

 You will manage diverse teams of consulting talent. Your role will be to help those teams flourish by provoking thought, team mentoring, knowledge sharing, giving frequent feedback and creating opportunities for team members to learn and grow. You will also personally develop and grow by being exposed to new and complex challenges daily.
   

  

 Clients will also seek your advice as a thought leader on business issues that extend beyond the immediate scope of you project work. Finally as a Principal you will contribute to the Practice Area development and help to strengthen the BCG Platinion brand as a AI and digital leader.

* Communicating complex topics clearly

 You will work in a collaborative environment with continuous development opportunities, growing toward Director\-level roles while deepening expertise in Energy and IT/ digital transformation.

data.jd_text:
**About Bureau Veritas**
 Bureau Veritas is a world leader in testing, inspection and certification (TIC) services, operating across 140\+ countries. Our MCA Sustainability Services team helps organisations across the Middle East, Caspian \& Africa measure, verify and improve their environmental and social performance. The CER (Certification) product line is BV's fastest\-growing sustainability stream in the region, covering GHG verification, carbon accounting, ESG assurance, sustainability advisory, social audits and supply chain due diligence.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Sustainability Specialist is a country\-based technical and commercial delivery role focused exclusively on Bureau Veritas’ Certification (CER) sustainability service line. Two positions are open: one in Egypt (Cairo) and one in Qatar (Doha), each embedded within their respective market.
   

  

 Reporting to the local head of CER product line and functionally to the MCA Director of Sustainability, the Specialist will be the primary CER sustainability presence in\-country: delivering client advisory mandates, leading proposal development, building the local CER pipeline and supporting BV’s brand in sustainability circles. This position is client\-facing and carries direct delivery responsibility across carbon advisory, ESG reporting, assurance and related CER services.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Delivery \& Advisory**
* Lead and deliver sustainability advisory mandates in\-country across core CER focus areas:


* 
+ Carbon accounting, GHG baseline assessments and Scope 1/2/3 inventories (ISO 14064 / GHG Protocol)
+ Organisational and product carbon footprint calculations and decarbonisation roadmaps
+ ESG strategy development, materiality assessments and CDP/SBTi alignment
+ Sustainability report assurance under ISAE 3000 / ISSA 5000
+ CBAM exposure assessments and supply chain ESG due diligence
+ IFRS S2 readiness assessments and climate\-related financial disclosure support
+ EcoVadis score improvement programmes and ESG rating advisory
+ Conduct GHG verification audits and CER certification assessments in accordance with BV methodology and applicable international standards
+ Prepare high\-quality technical deliverables: verification reports, advisory frameworks, gap analyses, decarbonisation plans and client presentations
+ Coordinate with the MCA regional team and Egypt Technical Hub for peer review, QA/QC and technical sign\-off on complex mandates
+ Stay current with regulatory developments relevant to in\-country clients: local ESG disclosure requirements, CBAM updates, ISSB/IFRS S2 implementation timelines

**Business Development \& Proposals**+ Lead or co\-lead the preparation of CER sustainability proposals, RFP responses and commercial offers for clients in Egypt / Qatar
+ Identify and qualify new CER business opportunities in\-country, building a local pipeline across carbon advisory, ESG reporting, assurance, social audits and supply chain services
+ Support regional BD campaigns including CBAM advisory, sustainability assurance, IFRS S2 readiness and GHG verification drives
+ Prepare and deliver tailored client presentations, pitches and capability documents for local market audiences
+ Participate in bid/no\-bid decisions with the regional Director and maintain accurate, real\-time pipeline records in Salesforce
+ Develop in\-country relationships with potential referral sources: law firms, financial advisors, sustainability consultancies and industry associations

**Client \& Stakeholder Management**+ Serve as the primary BV point of contact for CER sustainability clients in\-country — managing the full relationship from proposal through delivery, reporting and invoicing
+ Liaise with local regulatory bodies, stock exchanges, accreditation authorities and relevant government entities on CER matters
+ Represent Bureau Veritas at local sustainability events, ESG forums, carbon market conferences and industry roundtables
+ Manage repeat business opportunities, client satisfaction and contract renewals within the CER portfolio

**Operational \& Reporting**+ Maintain accurate Salesforce records for all in\-country CER opportunities: pipeline values, stages, submission dates and win/loss outcomes
+ Prepare monthly country performance reports and pipeline inputs for MCA Director and area leadership
+ Ensure all CER mandates comply with BV quality standards, methodology requirements and relevant accreditation obligations
+ Contribute country\-specific content to the MCA proposal library: case studies, client references, CVs and service descriptions
+ Participate in monthly MCA thematic training sessions and contribute to the quarterly regional sustainability newsletter

**Requirements**
**Essential**+ 4–6 years of experience in sustainability consulting, ESG advisory, GHG verification or CER\-related services in Egypt, Qatar or the broader MENA region
+ Solid technical command of core CER sustainability disciplines:


* 
+ GHG accounting and verification: ISO 14064, GHG Protocol, Scope 1/2/3 inventories
+ Carbon footprint methodologies and net\-zero/decarbonisation advisory
+ ESG reporting frameworks: GRI, ISSB/IFRS S2, ESRS, CDP, TCFD
+ Sustainability assurance standards: ISAE 3000, ISSA 5000
+ CBAM and cross\-border carbon due diligence
+ Supply chain ESG mapping and third\-party risk (C97\)
+ Excellent written English — ability to produce clear, professional technical reports, advisory deliverables and commercial proposals independently
+ Client\-facing experience: ability to manage relationships, lead discovery meetings and present findings to senior stakeholders
+ Bachelor’s degree in sustainability, environmental science, engineering, business or a related field

**Preferred**+ Professional certification: GHG Verifier, ISO 14064 Lead Auditor, GRI Certified Practitioner, CDP\-accredited advisor, or equivalent
+ Knowledge of local market regulatory context:


- 

* Egypt: FRA sustainability disclosure requirements, Egyptian Exchange ESG guidelines, national GHG registry developments
* Qatar: QSE ESG reporting requirements, National Vision 2030 sustainability pillars, QFC regulatory environment
* Arabic language proficiency — strongly preferred for both roles given client and regulatory engagement
* Experience with Salesforce or equivalent CRM tools for pipeline management
* Familiarity with EcoVadis, MSCI ESG, S\&P Global, or other ESG ratings platforms
* Knowledge of social auditing principles (SMETA, SA8000\) as an additional CER service area


**What We Offer**
* Country\-embedded, client\-facing role with real delivery responsibility and direct market impact
* High visibility to MCA Sustainability Director and regional leadership from day one
* Exposure to sustainability mandates and clients across 35\+ countries within the MCA region
* Competitive salary benchmarked to local market (Egypt — Cairo / Qatar — Doha)
* Access to BV’s global CER methodology, tools, accreditations and technical expertise network
* Clear career pathway into senior specialist, area lead or technical expert roles within BV MCA Sustainability
* Professional development through BV’s internal training programmes and external sustainability certification support

**DESCRIPTION:**

 **Project Manager –**

data.jd_text:
**About the Company** 




  





  





 A landmark, large\-scale mixed\-use destination development is underway in Qatar — one of the most ambitious leisure, retail, and real estate projects in the region. Spanning entertainment, hospitality, retail, and residential components across a significant land area in the greater Doha area, this project represents a generational investment in Qatar's tourism and economic diversification ambitions.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




  





  





 The project is at a pivotal stage of development, and we are seeking an exceptional Contracts \& Commercial Director to lead the full commercial and contracts function from the ground up. Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer, the Contracts \& Commercial Director will be the most senior commercial authority on the project. This is a leadership role with strategic accountability for all contracts, procurement, cost management, and commercial governance across the entire development programme — spanning design, construction, fit\-out, retail leasing infrastructure, and operational commissioning phases. The successful candidate will build and lead a high\-performing commercial team, establish robust contract frameworks, protect the project's financial interests, and ensure that all commercial decisions are aligned with the project's master development strategy.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* **Contracts Management**
* Own end\-to\-end contract strategy, administration, and execution across all project workstreams including civil works, MEP, fit\-out, retail, leisure, and hospitality packages
* Lead the preparation, negotiation, and award of all major contracts (FIDIC, NEC, bespoke forms), ensuring appropriate risk allocation and commercial protection
* Manage the full claims lifecycle — anticipation, assessment, negotiation, and resolution — minimising exposure and disputes
* Establish and maintain a contract register, variation management system, and claims log with full governance and audit trail
* Interface with legal counsel on contractual disputes, arbitration, and enforcement matters
* 
* **Commercial Management**
* Develop and implement the project's overarching commercial strategy in alignment with the CEO and development board
* Own the project cost plan, budget, and cost\-to\-complete reporting, providing accurate and timely commercial reporting to senior leadership and ownership
* Lead value engineering initiatives without compromising design intent or operational quality
* Drive procurement strategy — packaging, market engagement, tendering, evaluation, and award — for all consultants, contractors, and specialist vendors
* Establish commercial governance frameworks including delegation of authority, approval workflows, and commercial risk registers
* Oversee the benchmarking of contract prices against market rates and comparable regional projects
* 
* **Retail \& Real Estate Commercial**
* Provide commercial oversight on retail leasing structures, anchor tenant agreements, and fit\-out contribution frameworks
* Advise on commercial terms for real estate sales, land disposal, and development management agreements
* Support the delivery of F\&B, hospitality, and entertainment operator agreements from a contracts and commercial perspective
* 
* **Leadership \& Team Building**
* Recruit, build, and mentor a multi\-disciplinary commercial team (quantity surveyors, contracts managers, commercial analysts)
* Foster a high\-performance, ethical, and collaborative commercial culture across the project
* Act as a trusted commercial advisor to the CEO and executive leadership team
* Represent the project in dealings with government entities, master developers, and regulatory bodies where commercial matters arise



  





  





  





**Qualifications** 




  





  




* Essential
* Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in contracts and commercial management, with at least 5 years at Director level
* Proven experience on large\-scale retail, real estate, or mixed\-use destination development projects (total contract value ≥ QAR 500M)
* Deep expertise in FIDIC (Red, Yellow, Silver Books) and/or NEC contract suites
* Demonstrated track record in claims management, dispute avoidance, and commercial dispute resolution
* Experience building and leading commercial teams in a project delivery environment
* Degree qualified in Quantity Surveying, Commercial Management, Engineering, Law, or a related discipline
* 
* Highly Desirable
* MRICS / FRICS qualification or equivalent professional accreditation
* Prior experience on landmark GCC destination, leisure, or entertainment projects (e.g. Lusail City, Place Vendôme Qatar, Diriyah Gate, NEOM, Yas Island, Expo City)
* Familiarity with Qatari regulatory, procurement, and legal framework
* Experience with retail leasing commercial structures and entertainment/hospitality operator agreements
* Arabic language proficiency (advantageous, not mandatory)
* Master's degree in a relevant discipline
