data.jd_text:
**Head Of Physical Education (whole School \- Male)**
**Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK), Qatar**
**Job Overview**
**Head of Physical Education (Whole School \- Male)**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor is looking to appoint an outstanding Head of Physical Education (Whole School \- Male) to join a well\-established, supportive team in a highly successful and expanding school.
   

  

**The closing date for applications 30th June 2026\.**
**The start date for this role is 1st August 2026\.**
**About You**
 You are an outstanding team leader with the track record for developing a vision for excellence and continual improvement. You excel in leading and managing people by creating a culture where colleagues are both supported and challenged to deliver the best possible learning experience for students. You can develop a highly motivated team by nurturing positive working relationships built on respect, trust, support, and recognition. You lead improvement through rigorous self\-evaluation of department performance and use quality assurance feedback to identify improvement priorities moving forward. You demonstrate excellent management skills such as resource management, curriculum planning, data analysis, performance tracking, task delegation, organisation of meetings and creating teacher timetables.
   

  

 You lead a learning culture where students are supported, challenged, and inspired to be the best they can be \- students in classes across the department will believe there are no limits to what can be achieved. Your excellent motivation and communication skills enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within all lessons across the department.
   

  

 Receptive to feedback and ready to embrace change, you will be keen to share best practice with colleagues and peers. As a strong ambassador for the school, you will be able to develop new ways to engage students and parents across both our school (NAISAK), and the wider Nord Anglia Education communities. Your strong motivation and communication skills will also enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within the classroom.
   

  

 You will have the following:
   

  

  

* university degree in your specialist subject
* teaching qualification
* substantial Secondary level teaching experience, and knowledge of the Physical Education National curriculum, and IGCSE and A Level curriculums


 You will also be able to meet visa\-related restrictions for Qatar, including possession of a Bachelor's degree and a teaching qualification from a face\-to\-face (non\-online) course.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join our dynamic international education environment, where you will lead the delivery a fit\-for\-purpose curriculum, built on the UK National Curriculum and preparing students for external examinations at IGSCE/AS\-A levels. You will lead the development of a culture in which students are challenged to be ambitious learners and teachers are required to be innovative to enhance the student experience and outcomes. You will understand the diverse international language environment within our school community to manage effective curriculum programmes to not only teach Physical Education subject content but also continue to support English language development for students across all areas of the school curriculum. Developing a high\-quality extra\-curricular programme for sport and health is a key priority, with a dual\-focus on development\-for\-all and competition.
   

  

 Your educational philosophy will equip you to meet the needs of all learners and be able to teach students with a range of prior achievement, knowledge, and skills. Your expertise and planning adaptability will allow you to map out pathways for all students to progress in your subject, creating opportunities for all learners to achieve success based on individualised targets. You will contribute to good practice by demonstrating a collegiate approach to departmental development and sharing strategies with colleagues.
   

  

 As Head of Physical Education, you will be responsible for leading the planning, delivery and evaluation of the curriculum, teaching and learning, assessment, reporting, student behaviour, and professional development of teachers across the Physical Education department.
   

  

 Please refer to the job description of the role for the following information:
   

  

  

* Job purpose
* Reporting to
* Key relationships
* Key results areas
* Performance measurement


**About Our School**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK) is a highly successful, growing school with a committed and inspirational team of teaching professionals at its heart. Our close\-knit, supportive team is proud to be at the centre of the local community, educating over 1350 young people aged 3\-18\. Secondary is 4\-form entry at Key Stage 3, and 3\-form entry in KS4 upwards, with approximately 530 students aged 11\-18\.
   

  

 Our school resides in the town of Al Khor, 35 minutes north of Doha (the capital of Qatar). We educate both local and expat students through a bespoke Secondary curriculum which draws on both the Physical Education National curriculum and the Qatar Ministry of Education curriculum.
   

  

 The school is focused on supporting students towards enhanced Physical Education language acquisition, excellent academic outcomes and outstanding learning experiences through STEAM, Performing Arts, extra\-curricular activities, residential trips, and international awards for wider achievement.
   

  

 The school prides itself on fostering student wellbeing, personalisation of learning and a strong sense of multiculturalism and global citizenship. We also have strong through\-school links and ensure consistent progression from Primary to Secondary to offer all our students a rewarding learning journey. The Primary school buildings have recently undergone further refurbishment following the opening of a brand\-new Secondary building in August 2019\. Our students also now benefit from a new 25m outdoor pool.
   

  

 To learn more about NAISAK, please visit
   

  

 https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/nais\-al\-khor
   

  

**About Nord Anglia Education**
 Each Nord Anglia Education school is unique in character and designed to meet the needs of its community. We are united by our philosophy, to be ambitious for our students, our people, and our family of schools. We believe that being part of our family of schools gives them a special advantage. Working together, we can achieve more than we can individually. Our schools have access to a wide range of resources and support to enhance their success. We also create unique opportunities to benefit our students and people, such as the Global Campus, Nord Anglia University, and our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King's College London.
   

  

 When you join a Nord Anglia Education school, you join a global community of more than 16,000 people working together to support our students' success. We offer you unsurpassed opportunities to innovate and develop best practice across our family, to access extensive professional development, and to gain exceptional experience and career development in our schools. At Nord Anglia, you will have opportunities to progress more, learn more, and collaborate more.
   

  

 Our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King's College London, offer our teachers unrivalled access to leading experts in their fields. We also offer selected candidates from our staff worldwide an opportunity to earn their Executive Master's in International Education in an exclusive collaboration with King's College London.
   

  

 Alongside great training and a competitive package, you'll enjoy the chance to live and work in one of the world's most vibrant countries.
   

  

 As a Nord Anglia Education teacher, you enjoy the following benefits:
   

  

  

* A fast\-paced, global experience so that you can progress on a global scale
* An enabling environment founded on creativity, challenge and collaboration
* A culture that is fair and consultative
* Unique opportunities to grow professionally and develop your career
* Opportunities to apply for further leadership positions


**SELECTION PROCESS**
 Applicants should submit a CV, letter of application, and the details of two professional referees, one of which should be your current Principal/Head Teacher. Interviews will be conducted at the school or via Microsoft Teams.
   

  

 Please visit us online at www.nordangliaeducation.jobs
   

  

 Please note, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
   

  

**We reserve the rights to close this position early if we find the ideal candidate.**
**SAFEGUARDING**
 At Nord Anglia Education we are committed to providing a world class, safe, happy environment in which children and young people can thrive and learn. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all our pupils irrespective of race, ability, religion, gender, or culture.
   

  

 All post holders having regular unsupervised contact with children are subject to appropriate national and international vetting procedures including satisfactory criminal record checks from both your country of residence/birth and any country of residence within the last 10 years.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunities employer, and we welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons.

**Job Summary:** 




 The Corporate Performance Officer is responsible for ensuring MCQ’s strategy is effectively translated into measurable outcomes by defining and tracking Key Performance Indicators, analyzing performance gaps, and delivering actionable insights to senior leadership. The role plays a critical part in monitoring organizational progress, driving accountability across business units, and enabling data\-driven decision\-making to keep the company aligned with and on track to achieve its strategic objectives.
 



**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:** 




**Operational** 



* Support continuous enhancement of corporate performance management frameworks, in alignment of global best practices and standards.
* Deliver successful monitoring of MCQ’s performance governance frameworks and models as aligned with MCQ Strategy.
* Monitor and report on the organization’s portfolio of programs and projects, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and performance targets.
* Develop and maintain performance dashboards and reports to track and visualize Key Performance Indicators at both project and corporate levels.
* Perform analysis and insights of performance data to identify gaps, opportunities, risks, and identify escalation points (if any).
* Provide regular updates and performance insights to the Head of PMO and Corporate Performance, supporting informed decision\-making.
* Contribute to effective stakeholder engagement to ensure alignment, transparency, and accountability in performance delivery.



  





**Policies, Systems, Processes \& Procedures** 



* Support the development and periodic review of departmental policies, delegation of authority, processes, and standard operating procedures to strengthen performance management.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of process roadmaps that align operational activities with strategic priorities.



**Continuous Improvement** 



* Identify and support opportunities for continuous improvement in performance management systems and processes, incorporating global best practices, efficiency enhancements, and cost optimization.
* Promote a performance\-driven culture by supporting initiatives that enhance transparency, accountability, and organizational effectiveness.



**Reporting** 



* Prepare and deliver consolidated performance reports, and executive\-level dashboards.
* Develop high\-quality presentations (PowerPoint) with clear data visualization and strategic insights for senior leadership.
* Support the development of analytical reports and white papers that provide insights into organizational performance and inform strategic decision\-making.
* Contribute to the governance of enterprise performance frameworks.

**Minimum Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in business; Finance or a similar discipline from a reputable university.
* Command of English language. Fluency in Arabic is preferred.



**Minimum Experience:** 



* Minimum five (5\) years of related experience.
* Experience in leading and supporting corporate performance reporting in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience in analytical tools, such as MS Excel or equivalent.
* Proficient Excel, PowerPoint skills and data visualization capabilities.
* Basic Power BI and/or Tableau.



  





**Required Competencies** 




**Functional Competencies:** 



* Business intelligence, business analytics \& dashboarding tools
* Proficiency in tools like Power BI or Tableau to build and manage performance dashboards and reports
* Developing clear, structured reports and presentations (usually in Excel and PowerPoint) for senior leadership decision\-making.



**Behavioral competencies:** 



* Innovative growth mindset.
* Good personal discipline with consistency and accuracy.
* Attention to detail.
* Innate communications skills with the ability to work with diverse stakeholders.
* Strong interpersonal, time management and problem\-solving skills.
* Systematic and orderly planning with attention to details



  





**Applicants who meet the requirements outlined in the job description should apply.**

We are conducting a confidential search for a highly accomplished Chief Investment Officer (CIO) to lead the investment strategy, portfolio management, and product development activities of a growing investment platform. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing a diversified multi\-asset investment portfolio while driving the development and structuring of innovative investment products to support business growth and client objectives.

 Investment Leadership
 


* Develop and execute the organization's investment strategy across multiple asset classes, including public equities, fixed income, private equity, private credit, real estate, infrastructure, and alternative investments.
* Lead strategic asset allocation and portfolio construction decisions.
* Monitor portfolio performance, risk exposures, market trends, and economic developments.
* Present investment recommendations and portfolio updates to executive management, investment committees, and boards.
* Ensure investment activities align with regulatory requirements, governance frameworks, and risk appetite.



  





 Product Structuring \& Development
 


* Lead the design, structuring, launch, and ongoing management of investment products and investment vehicles.
* Develop innovative solutions tailored to institutional, family office, and high\-net\-worth investor requirements.
* Collaborate with legal, compliance, operations, finance, and distribution teams to bring products to market.
* Evaluate and establish appropriate fund structures, mandates, and investment frameworks.
* Support fundraising initiatives through product positioning and investor engagement.



  





 Investment Origination \& Execution
 


* Identify and evaluate investment opportunities across asset classes and geographies.
* Lead due diligence processes and investment recommendations.
* Oversee external managers, advisors, and strategic investment partners.
* Drive portfolio optimization and capital deployment decisions.



  





 Leadership \& Stakeholder Management
 


* Build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing investment team.
* Foster a strong investment culture focused on performance, discipline, and innovation.
* Maintain relationships with investors, regulators, financial institutions, and industry stakeholders.
* Act as a key spokesperson on investment matters internally and externally.



  





 Qualifications \& Experience
 


* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

* Minimum 15 years of progressive investment management experience.
* Proven experience managing diversified multi\-asset portfolios.
* Strong experience in investment product structuring, fund formation, and product development.
* Demonstrated track record across public and private market investments.
* Experience working with institutional investors, family offices, sovereign wealth funds, asset managers, or investment platforms.
* Strong understanding of investment risk management, portfolio construction, and capital markets.
* Experience serving on Investment Committees or similar governance bodies preferred.



  





 Key Competencies
 


* Strategic investment leadership
* Multi\-asset portfolio management
* Product structuring and innovation
* Capital markets expertise
* Investment due diligence and execution
* Fund and investment vehicle design
* Stakeholder management and investor relations
* Team leadership and talent development
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Commercial and entrepreneurial mindset



  





 Ideal Background
 



 Candidates may currently hold positions such as:
 


* Chief Investment Officer
* Deputy Chief Investment Officer
* Head of Investments
* Head of Asset Management
* Portfolio Director
* Managing Director – Investments
* Senior Portfolio Manager
* Head of Multi\-Asset Investments



  





 Experience gained within investment banks, asset managers, sovereign wealth funds, family offices, private markets firms, pension funds, or leading financial institutions will be highly regarded.

data.jd_text:
Description synthétique du poste
   

  

 Sous la responsabilité du Conseil d'administration (CA) de l’Alliance Française (AF) de Manama, et sous l'autorité du conseiller de coopération et d'action culturelle (COCAC), vous êtes responsable de l’exécution du projet d’établissement, du bon fonctionnement et du développement de l’Alliance ainsi que du suivi de l’ensemble des actions qui y sont menées, en conformité avec les lois locales. Trois mois suivant votre prise de fonction vous vous verrez remettre votre lettre de mission cosignée par la Direction générale de la Mondialisation, le président de l'Alliance et la Fondation des Alliances Françaises. Au plus tard six mois après votre prise de fonction, vous devrez présenter un projet d'établissement et un plan d'action soumis à l‘approbation du conseil d’administration et visé par l'ambassade, qui couvrira la durée de votre mission.
   

  

 Activités principales
   

  

 L'Alliance Française de Manama accueille 500 à 600 élèves différents par année. L'Alliance est propriétaire de ses locaux, toutefois le foncier demeure la propriété du Ministère bahreïnien des Finances. Elle possède 7 salles de classe équipées en TBI. L’ensemble du parc informatique a été renouvelé, avec connexion internet en fibre optique et 5G. L'AF assure aussi des cours hors de ses locaux (Écoles internationales, dont le Lycée français, Ministères, Universités, personnalités VIP) et cherche à développer les cours hors les murs. Et dispose d'un auditorium de 120 places. Dans ce cadre, vous êtes responsable des missions suivantes: Élaboration, proposition et impulsion de la stratégie de l'établissement ; Mise en place des priorités linguistiques et culturelles définies par l'Ambassade, par la Fondation Alliance française, sous l'autorité du CA de l’AF, de l'Ambassadeur et du COCAC ; Élaboration du budget de l'établissement, gestion du personnel, mise en place d'outils d'analyse et de suivi ; Etablissement d'étroites relations avec les professionnels de la culture et les autorités du pays d'affectation ; Représentation de l'Alliance Française en justice et dans tous les actes de la vie civile ; Compte rendu des réalisations et du contexte au Conseiller culturel, à l'Ambassadeur, à la Fondation et à la Direction Générale de la Mondialisation (DGM) du Ministère de l'Europe et des affaires étrangères (MEAE).
   

  

 Diplômes ou expérience professionnelle recommandée pour exercer les fonctions

data.jd_text:
Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for a Head of Local Shops to join our team and be part of our growth. If you’re a team leader who is hungry for a new adventure, a multinational workplace is waiting for you.
   

  

 As the Head of Local Shops, you will be responsible for the success of talabat in your country, create work\-class experience for customers, defining the operating procedures and KPIs.
   

  

* Strategy: Your mission will be to define strategic priorities, develop roadmaps, and make financial decisions
* Execution: You will participate in the development of the commercial strategy, operations and growth of the vertical
* Process Optimization and Management: You will have the opportunity to create and improve processes, for example managing partnerships to contribute to growth.
* You will work in close collaboration with the regional NFV, product, operations and marketing teams to implement new products and processes.
* Reconcile locals’ needs and technical capabilities to optimize our business performance
* Lead cross\-functional team alignment to make our internal and external operations more efficient and scalable
* You will own the definition of KPIs and sales targets and drive operations to meet goals
* Constantly monitor fulfillment processes and recommend improvements to increase productivity and drive total revenue
* Understand the needs of stakeholders with competing priorities, while delivering solutions that satisfy both mutually
* Set a clear mission for your team and deploy strategies focused to meet these goals.
* Taking the company’s vision and interpreting this to the local market, ensuring we’re constantly evolving, innovating, and prioritizing the right projects to meet business needs.
* Collaborating with the product, regional departments – working with all the supporting departments to ensure your market has their needs catered for, and are coordinated with upcoming changes to product, processes, and strategy.


**Qualifications**
* You have at least 7 years of experience in relevant role
* You have significant experience in management and project management and you know how to define a strategy at a local level
* You feel comfortable in a rapidly changing environment.
* You are able to make decisions with through analysis
* You are able to move quickly from long\-term thinking to immediate action.
* You are very adaptable to change and have the ability to execute quickly.
* You have excellent interpersonal skills and are able to collaborate with a variety of interlocutors, both internal and external
* You work in full autonomy and also collaborate with stakeholders, you are curious and eager to learn more about all aspects of talabat and its industry to acquire skills and knowledge very quickly and become a field expert.

data.jd_text:
**Summary**
 The purpose of this position is to oversee and coordinate the operation and administration of the installation food and beverage division. The incumbent will be a "hands on" manager of the operations at all times. The Food and Beverage department consists of food/club operations in several locations, Included in these locations, but not limited to dining facilities, branded food operations, club operations, catering facilities, amusement \& vending machines and entertainment and Bingo programs.
   

  

 Duties
   

  

 Help
   

  

 Under the direction of NSA Bahrain MWR Director monitors. directs and administers policies, programs and goals for F\&B Division operations, including full\-service dining and other facilities, lounge bars, catering, snack bars, mobile units and branded food concessionaire operations.
   

  

 Responsible for coordinating the efforts of managers and for providing overall management of all phases of Food and Club operations from initial determination of menus to its final prepared, consumable state. Oversees purchase requests of equipment, supplies and food items.
   

  

 Provides reconciliation, labor cost analysis and financial viability determinations. May provide food/beverage service support for special holiday events, recreation tournaments and official functions. Serves as technical advisor on the establishment of contract food service facilities, direct and indirect operating standards, inspecting and ensuring technical contract compliance.
   

  

 Plans, organizes work and manages internal procedures and resources to ensure maximum productivity and economies. Prepares internal office financial plan and related records and reports /exercises authority on approved budget.
   

  

 Monitors programs and schedules surveys on a regular basis and initiates corrective action to ensure support of operating programs of MWR.
   

  

 Develops long range plans in conjunction with internal managers and exercises internal personnel management authorities as delegated by the MWR Director with regard to subordinate supervisors and employees within the office.
   

  

 Manages new property resources and provides advice on renovations and improvements. Maintains and enforces security of funds, merchandise, supplies and equipment to preclude or minimize the potential for fraud, waste and abuse.
   

  

 Ensures all machinery, equipment and facilities within the branch are maintained in a quality fashion at all times and in conformity with medical inspection standards. Periodically inspects equipment and working conditions of all branch facilities for hazards to prevent accidents and fires.
   

  

 Promotes safety programs for subordinates and requires compliance with safety standards.
   

  

 The incumbent provides administrative and technical supervision, training and establishes individual performance standards to the Food and Beverage Operations of the installation, Fleet Readiness Division. Assures that all food handling personnel are up to date with applicable health certifications. Effectively supports the Navy's Equal Opportunity policies and ensures compliance with fire, safety and other environment issues.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Help
   

  

 Conditions of employment
   

  

* There may be some exposure to extreme heat and cold when in the kitchen and cold storage area


**Qualifications**
**Resumes must include information which demonstrates experience and knowledge, skills, and ability (KSAs) as they relate to this position. Applicants are encouraged to be clear and specific when describing their experience level and KSAs.**
**A qualified candidate must possess at least one of the following:**
 Three full years of progressively responsible specialized experience in the Federal service, or the equivalent in the private or public sector, overseeing food and beverage operations that included responsibility for financial planning, inventory controls, marketing, and ensuring compliance with health and safety standards.
   

  

 OR
   

  

 A Ph.D. or equivalent doctoral degree, or three full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to such a degree.
   

  

 OR
   

  

 A combination of education and experience to meet total qualification requirements for the GS\-11 grade level.
   

  

**A qualified candidate also possesses the following:**
 Comprehensive knowledge or Federal. DoD and club policies, requirements, administrative practices and procedures related to the planning, budgeting, scheduling and coordinating of installation club systems, social and recreational programs and the efficient operation and utilization or facilities and equipment. Skill in negotiating major program issues and operational requirements with personnel inside and outside the Navy and local installation, community organizations and patrons.
   

  

 Knowledge and skill in directing the application of club management principles. concepts and methodology to a variety of conventional and unusually difficult and complex assignments involving the full range or club social and recreational activities including operations and maintenance, financial management, assignment utilization, facility improvements, management\-patron relations and merchandise and equipment management.
   

  

 Knowledge of proper military protocol and decorum extended to general officers, commanders, their guests and dignitaries.
   

  

 Knowledge of audit procedures: financial planning and management; food and beverage controls and accountability; and how inventory controls are developed. implemented and analyzed for their effectiveness.
   

  

 Knowledge of quality of food and beverage preparation, presentation and storage co develop and supervise an effective, attractive preparation presentation sanitary food and beverage program targeted to the specific markets serviced by each club in the system. This knowledge requires an extensive understanding of food beverage menu development, catering, tastes, habits and preferences of each segment of the market. i.e. junior enlisted personnel/senior officers, military retirees. etc.
   

  

 Knowledge of marketing techniques and demographic data to determine the installation's market, develop programs which appeal to the market and to create innovative, dynamic promotions and advertisements to support these programs.
   

  

 Knowledge of key military and civilian (Local National, APF and NAF) personnel regulations, procedures and policies to direct staff.
   

  

 Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing. This is necessary to effectively present important information such as financial and operating data. to a varied audience (e.g. Commander. subordinates and membership).
   

  

 Education
   

  

 There is no positive educational requirement for this position.
   

  

 Additional information
   

  

 Candidates should be committed to improving the efficiency of the Federal government, passionate about the ideals of our American republic, and committed to upholding the rule of law and the United States Constitution.
   

  

 Help
   

  

 A career with the U.S. government provides employees with a comprehensive benefits package. As a federal employee, you and your family will have access to a range of benefits that are designed to make your federal career very rewarding. Opens in a new windowLearn more about federal benefits.
   

  

 Review our benefits
   

  

 Eligibility for benefits depends on the type of position you hold and whether your position is full\-time, part\-time or intermittent. Contact the hiring agency for more information on the specific benefits offered.

data.jd_text:
We are building a next‑generation private equity platform in Bahrain and are looking for a senior AI leader to embed advanced analytics and GenAI across the full investment lifecycle. This is a hands‑on, high‑visibility role working directly with the investment team and portfolio leadership to turn AI into tangible value creation.
 



  





**What you’ll do** 




  




* Shape and own the AI strategy across deal sourcing, screening, diligence, IC, portfolio monitoring and exits.
* Design and deploy LLM‑driven tools, RAG pipelines and agentic workflows into day‑to‑day investment processes and dashboards.
* Partner with operating partners and portfolio management teams to unlock AI‑driven value creation (pricing, revenue analytics, cost efficiency, automation).
* Set AI governance standards covering data privacy, model risk, vendor selection and responsible AI guardrails in a regulated institutional environment.
* Drive firm‑wide adoption through training, playbooks, proof‑of‑concepts and LP‑facing narratives that highlight the firm’s digital edge.



  





**What you bring** 




  




* 10–15 years in AI, data or digital transformation, ideally with experience in PE‑backed businesses, top‑tier consulting or financial services.
* Deep technical fluency with LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows and modern data stacks (e.g. Python, SQL), with the ability to prototype and guide build teams.
* Strong understanding of the private equity lifecycle, IC standards and value creation frameworks – you can translate AI into IRR and MOIC impact.
* Evidence of deploying AI solutions in institutional or regulated environments with robust data privacy and model‑risk practices.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer/Data Science, Engineering or a related quantitative field; MBA is an advantage.



  





**Why this platform** 




  




* Join a Manama‑headquartered financial group with a growing alternatives and private equity footprint across the GCC and global markets.
* Work at the intersection of AI and private equity in one of the GCC’s most established financial centres, with direct exposure to senior leadership and portfolio C‑suites.

 SERB is a fast\-growing global specialty pharma company designed to address rare and urgent conditions by delivering life\-saving medicines when time and complexity leave no room for failure.
   

  

 We operate end\-to\-end across 100\+ countries, ensuring 70\+ essential medicines for rare diseases, emergency care, and medical countermeasures reach patients and clinicians with urgency – wherever and whenever they are needed.Shaped over the past 25 years by an entrepreneurial, disruptive spirit, SERB combines the focus and agility of a biotech with the scale, reach, and reliability of a global pharmaceutical company — always grounded in medical purpose, not corporate convention.
   

  

 Our 600\+ employees are driven by three core values:
   

  

* Patients first, always Patients are not a concept — they are why we act, especially when time matters most.
* Impact focused We are agile, entrepreneurial, and disciplined \- working smart and learning continuously to deliver results that matter, with the consistency, quality, and trust that critical care demands.

 Guided by a clear ambition and a relentless focus on patients, SERB continues to expand through selective, innovative acquisitions, launching new treatments and entering new geographies. Across every step — from integration to delivery — our people act with passion, ownership, and determination to ensure life\-saving medicines become available to patients who need them, worldwide.
   

  

**Broad Overview:**
 The Commercial Director for MENA leads the commercial performance and launch execution of newly registered MA products across the Gulf and Levant. With close cross\-functional collaboration with Marketing, Medical (MSLs), RA, QA, and Supply Chain, the position ensures compliant, high\-quality execution and reinforces SERB’s presence across key hospital and tender\-driven markets.
   

  

 The role will be home based (location Riyadh) and the incumbent will be required to travel approx. 60% of their time across the GCC.

* Ensure strict adherence to SERB compliance and promotional codes across all field activities.
* Lead commercial risk assessments and implement corrective action plans where needed.

data.jd_text:

 The profile will be a naturally dependable member of the leadership team that is able to bring about improvement and measurable positive changes in output and efficiency over time.

data.jd_text:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 As a Service Project Manager at Siemens Energy, you will be at the forefront of driving impactful projects that enhance our global energy solutions. This role targets experienced project managers with a background in electrical engineering, renewable energy, or mechatronics, who are adept at navigating complex challenges and leading diverse teams. Your work will directly contribute to Siemens Energy’s mission of delivering sustainable energy solutions, fostering innovation, and ensuring compliance with quality standards. Expect a collaborative team culture that values diversity, creativity, and continuous improvement, where your leadership will inspire and empower others to achieve shared goals.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Lead cross\-functional teams across various locations, ensuring effective collaboration and accountability for project outcomes.
* Develop and implement structured communication plans to maintain transparency with stakeholders and facilitate milestone tracking.
* Manage the full project lifecycle, from scope definition to closure, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Utilize Siemens Energy tools and digital platforms for data\-driven decision\-making, process optimization, and comprehensive reporting.
* Drive change through coaching and mentoring, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement within the team.
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks using procurement plans and responsibility matrices, ensuring project health and compliance.


**What You Bring**
* A Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechatronics, or a related field, with specialization or certification in project management (IPMA\-C or PMP is a plus).
* 5 to 10 years of experience in project management or team leadership, with a proven track record of managing complex projects in a multinational and multicultural environment.
* Strong documentation skills for project reporting, milestone tracking, and stakeholder communication, with familiarity in audit processes and quality gates (QMiP, FAC, etc.).
* Proficiency in project lifecycle management, budgeting, risk analysis, and contract handling using Siemens Energy standards and tools.
* Excellent interpersonal skills for managing relationships, resolving conflicts, and communicating effectively with diverse stakeholders.
* Initiative, adaptability, and ownership in achieving project outcomes under dynamic conditions, with a focus on innovation and analytical thinking.


**About The Team**
 Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
* Opportunities to work with a global team
* Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects
* Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens\-Energy platform


 https://jobs.siemens\-energy.com/jobs
   

  

 The job posting will remain open for applications for 14 days from the posting date.

data.jd_text:
The Project Manager's role is essential in ensuring the successful delivery of projects. The role holder will lead the implementation of small to large projects and collaborate with cross\-functional teams and a range of internal and external stakeholders. This role will deploy the full range of the department's tools and processes to ensure the successful design and deployment and delivery of all assigned projects throughout their full lifecycles with a strong focus on achieving the intended benefits and operational performance goals.
 


**General Responsibilities**
* Manage and execute projects under the guidance of the Senior Project Manager and the Project Delivery Lead Management to ensure they are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with predefined and agreed objectives and quality standards.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive project schedules, and budgets. Continuously monitor project progress, identifying and addressing issues, risks and changes as they arise.
* Work with the Director Project Delivery Lead Management to define project milestones/objectives and deliverables for projects and establish a framework for monitoring and reporting project performance.
* Collaborate with project team members to identify and implement improvement strategies that enhance project delivery efficiency and effectiveness and mitigate issues and risks.
* Work closely with various departments within the Centre of Excellence (COE) to ensure seamless coordination and alignment of project activities with overall business objectives.
* Foster effective communication and collaboration among project team members and stakeholders to ensure everyone is aligned with project goals, objectives and the status of all assigned projects.
* Implement and uphold rigorous quality assurance processes to ensure that projects meet or exceed quality standards and customer expectations.
* Conduct regular project audits to verify adherence to established quality guidelines and identify areas for improvement.
* Identify potential project issues, risks, changes and collaborate within the Project Delivery Teams to develop contingency and mitigation plans to proactively address challenges that may impact project delivery.
* Allocate and manage project resources efficiently, including personnel, budget, and equipment, to optimize project delivery and ensure the efficient utilization of resources.
* Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including project plans, progress reports, all project logs and documentation of lessons learned, in line with organizational standards.
* Provide regular updates and reports on project status to the Director Project Delivery Lead Management, Chief Operational Excellence Officer, and relevant stakeholders.
* Recommend training and development interventions for team members to build their capabilities.
* Contribute to the identification of opportunities for the continuous improvement of systems, processes, and practices to increase productivity and operational efficiency.
* Implement all relevant Department's policies, processes, procedures, and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.
* Contribute to the preparation of timely and accurate reports to meet departmental requirements, policies, and standards.


**Requirements**
**Qualification**
* Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent from a recognized and accredited university is required.
* Master's degree in Project Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent from a recognized and accredited university is preferred.
* PMP or Prince2 certification is required.
* Demonstrated proficiency in oral and written business English.
* **7\+ years of experience in project management or a related field preferably into Supplychain industries, including planning, execution, delivery, and reporting.**
* Proven experience in project management, including planning, execution, delivery, reporting and effective communication.
* Experience working with leadership and senior stakeholders and coordinating across internal cross\-functional teams.
* Experience with any one of PMP\-style project controls, Prince2, risk and change management, or structured reporting and governance.
* Broader experience across PMP\-style project controls, Prince2, risk and change management, and structured reporting and governance is preferred.
* Experience in logistics and supply chain projects is preferred.

* Fluency in English for professional project communication; ability to operate confidently in customer meetings, reviews, and negotiations.


**Transform the everyday with us**
 We value your outstanding identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.

We encourage applications from a diverse talent pool and are happy to give the opportunity to discuss flexibility and reasonable adjustment requirements. Many of our teams are working optimally in a remote, virtual adding to our ability to offer more flexibility on how you handle your time.
   

  

 Please note: Only complete applications can be considered in the selection process.

****Role Purpose****
 The Operations Director holds full strategic and operational accountability for the manufacturing facility. This is a senior leadership role responsib
data.jd_text:
We are partnering with a frozen food manufacturer in Saudi Arabia to appoint an Operations Director (Head of Factory).
   

  

****Role Purpose****
 The Operations Director holds full strategic and operational accountability for the manufacturing facility. This is a senior leadership role responsible for shaping and executing the plant's operational strategy, building a high\-performing organization, and delivering against ambitious targets for output, quality, cost, and safety.
   

  

 The successful candidate will set the operational agenda, modernize and scale the facility, and embed a culture of excellence that positions the plant as a benchmark in the frozen food sector.
   

  

****Strategic Leadership****
* Define and execute the operational strategy for the facility, aligned with the company's growth ambitions and commercial plans.
* Lead the transformation and modernization of the plant, including capacity expansion, automation, and capital investment planning.
* Translate business objectives into clear operational targets and a roadmap that the wider operations team can deliver against.
* Serve as a key member of the senior leadership team, contributing to overall business direction and decision\-making.


****Operational Excellence****
* Drive operational excellence across the facility through lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, and structured continuous improvement programs.
* Improve key metrics including OEE, yield, throughput, labor productivity, and waste reduction, with sustained year\-on\-year gains.
* Establish robust planning and scheduling disciplines that ensure on\-time, in\-full delivery against demand.
* Lead root\-cause problem solving and a culture of data\-driven decision making across all shifts and functions.


****Production \& Facility Management****
* Own the full production operation, from raw material intake through processing, freezing, packing, and dispatch.
* Ensure the reliability and performance of all plant assets, including cold\-chain, freezing, and refrigeration infrastructure, through proactive and preventive maintenance.
* Oversee facility management, utilities, and capital projects to keep the plant running safely and efficiently at all times.


****Quality \& Food Safety****
* Ensure full compliance with all food safety, quality, and regulatory standards, including SFDA, HACCP, ISO 22000, GMP, and customer\-specific requirements.
* Maintain audit readiness at all times and uphold the highest standards of hygiene, traceability, and product integrity.
* Build quality and food safety into the culture of the plant, not just the systems.


****People \& Organization****
* Lead, develop, and inspire a large multi\-disciplinary workforce across production, quality, engineering, and supply chain.
* Build organizational capability through hiring, succession planning, training, and performance management.
* Foster a culture of safety, accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement at every level.


****Financial \& Commercial****
* Own the facility's operating budget and capital plan, with full P\&L accountability for the cost of operations.
* Drive cost optimization across labor, materials, energy, and overhead without compromising quality or safety.
* Partner closely with commercial, supply chain, and procurement teams to align production with sales, inventory, and service targets.


****Candidate Profile****
* 15\+ years in food manufacturing operations, with significant experience in frozen, chilled, or processed food production.
* Proven track record at Operations Director, Plant Director, or Head of Factory level, leading a full facility at scale.
* Demonstrated success delivering operational excellence, plant transformation, and measurable improvements in cost, efficiency, and quality.
* Deep expertise in food safety and quality systems, with hands\-on command of SFDA, HACCP, ISO 22000, and GMP.
* Strong engineering, maintenance, and capital project experience, including cold\-chain and freezing infrastructure.
* Experience operating within Saudi Arabia, including familiarity with local regulatory requirements, Saudization, and large\-workforce management.
* Engineering, food technology, or operations management degree; postgraduate qualification or lean/Six Sigma certification preferred.
* Exceptional leadership presence, commercial judgment, and the ability to build and lead high\-performing teams.


****Key Competencies****
* Strategic and operational leadership
* Operational excellence and continuous improvement
* Food safety and quality governance
* Financial and commercial acumen
* People leadership and organizational development
* Results orientation and accountability

data.jd_text:
Assystem is an international company with one mission: accelerate the energy transition around the world.
   

  

  

  

 Every day, our 6,500 switchers located in 12 countries (Europe, Middle East, Pacific Asia \& Africa) connect their six thousand billion neurons to tackle the task of the century: switching to low\-carbon energy.
   

  

  

  

 We are a collective committed to the actors who are making the energy switch. Sharing our knowledge, expertise and values allows us to innovate and think differently about the energy transition.
   

  

  

  

 Drawing on more than 55 years' experience in highly regulated sectors subject to strict security and safety requirements, we provide our customers with engineering and project management services, as well as digital services and solutions to optimize the performance of complex infrastructure projects throughout their life cycle. The Group is currently ranked second in the world for nuclear engineering.
   

  

  

  

 To ensure a viable, efficient, and reliable energy future for all
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**
* **Project Leadership:** 
 Lead and monitor multi\-disciplinary engineering design teams throughout the project lifecycle to ensure seamless delivery of comprehensive engineering packages.
* **Scope \& Schedule Management:** 
 Define project scope, develop detailed delivery schedules, and monitor progress against critical paths to proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks.
* **Financial Control:** 
 Manage project financial performance, including budgeting, cost estimation, forecasting, and tracking cash flow against milestones.
* **Stakeholder Relations:** 
 Act as the primary focal point for clients, subcontractors, and regulatory authorities, leading regular design reviews and managing change orders effectively.
* **Risk Mitigation:** 
 Identify technical and commercial risks early in the design cycle and execute proactive strategies to protect project timelines and margins.
* **HSEQ Compliance:** 
 Ensure all engineering designs and project delivery methods strictly adhere to Health, Safety, Environment, and Quality guidelines.


**Qualifications**
* **Experience:** 
 A minimum of
 **5 years of dedicated experience** 
 in engineering project management or design management, preferably within an engineering consultancy, infrastructure, or complex energy sector environment.
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or a related discipline) from an accredited university.
* **Professional Registrations:** 
 Mandatory membership/registration with the Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE). A Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification is highly desirable.
* **Technical Expertise:** 
 Strong understanding of standard multi\-disciplinary engineering design workflows, technical documentation cycles, and modern digital engineering platforms (e.g., BIM or CAD systems).
* **Skills \& Competencies:** 
 Exceptional leadership, stakeholder negotiation, and conflict resolution capabilities, with a proven track record of managing diverse, multi\-cultural engineering teams.
* **Languages:** 
 Fluent in written and spoken English. Professional proficiency in Arabic is considered a significant asset.


**Additional Information**

 We are committed to equal treatment of candidates and promote, as well as foster all forms of diversity within our company. We believe that bringing together people with different backgrounds and perspectives is essential for creating innovative and impactful solutions. Skills, talent, and our people’s ability to dare are the only things that matter !. Bring your unique contributions and help us shape the future.

**Job Purpose:** 




  





 The Head of Project Execution oversees all aspects of Project Execution within the organization, ensuring that all Airside and Terminal activities comply with the regulations and quality requirements. They provide strategic direction, ensure safety compliance, and facilitate effective communication among Stakeholders ensuring successful project outcomes.
 



  





**Position Accountability Description:**

 Develop and implement strategic plans and provide strategic direction and leadership for project execution that align with the organization's goals and objectives.

3. Monitor industry trends and best practices to ensure the organization's project execution processes remain competitive and effective.

 Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of all Airside and Terminal projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, and on budget.
2. Ensure the acquisition of necessary permits and clearances for sitework, and compliance with the relevant safety and environmental standards (GACAR, ICAO, FAA etc.).

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
 The Agency Program Coordinator (APC) / Government Travel Credit Card (GTCC) Analyst manages and administers the Government Travel Charge Card (GTCC) program for staff and ship personnel. This role ensures compliance with GTCC policies and procedures, provides customer support to cardholders, and coordinates with financial institutions and government offices to maintain accurate account management and resolve travel card issues. The position supports command readiness by maintaining proper oversight of travel card accounts, ensuring cardholder compliance, and assisting with reconciliation and dispute resolution.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage the Command Government Travel Charge Card (GTCC) Program for CNSG\-C staff and ship personnel.
* Serve as helpdesk support for travel card inquiries, providing guidance and customer service to cardholders on GTCC policies, procedures, and responsibilities.
* Establish and manage new GTCC accounts while ensuring compliance with command and higher\-echelon policies and procedures.
* Review and validate cardholder access to electronic systems related to travel card management and terminate access when personnel transfer, retire, or separate.
* Process and approve new card applications and coordinate replacement cards when required.
* Coordinate with the Command Defense Travel System (DTS) Organizational Defense Travel Administrator (ODTA) to ensure DTS profiles contain current GTCC card numbers and expiration dates.
* Ensure cardholders complete required training and the Statement of Understanding prior to activation and continued use of GTCC accounts.
* Provide cardholders with training and guidance on GTCC policies, roles, responsibilities, and proper usage.
* Serve as liaison between financial institutions, Defense Finance and Accounting Service (DFAS), the Comptroller Office, Commercial Travel Office (CTO), and travelers to resolve account issues and discrepancies.
* Monitor and assist in resolving disputed transactions to ensure timely reconciliation and prevent account suspension.
* Other duties as assigned.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum eight (8\) years of experience supporting Government Travel Charge Card (GTCC) programs as an Agency Program Coordinator (APC) or similar role.
* Strong knowledge of GTCC account codes, policies, and procedures.
* Experience supporting Defense Travel System (DTS) processes is desirable.
* Strong customer service and communication skills with the ability to support travelers and resolve account issues efficiently.
* Experience coordinating with financial institutions, DFAS, and command leadership to manage travel card accounts and resolve discrepancies.
* Ability to maintain accurate records, monitor account compliance, and generate reports related to travel card usage and training requirements.
* Must have an active Secret Clearance.

**Company Description**
 Mantis is a leading, conservation\-focused hotel group with eco\-lodges, waterways, and curated eco\-resorts located all over the world. Sustainable travellers have been enjoying eco\-tourism, safaris, and adventure travel with Mantis since 2000\. Rooted in conservation, Mantis pursues sustainable business practices and develops tourism products that are respectful of the environment and communities in which they operate. Whether small and intimate or vast and complex, on a sweeping African plain, beach\-side escap,e or bustling city, each is an exceptional place for guests to find themselves. While uniquely different in the experiences they offer, all are linked through a collective obsession to be extraordinary, to be rare in a world that mass\-produces sameness.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Hawar Resort by Mantis is seeking an experienced and dynamic Culinary Director to lead and oversee all culinary operations across the resort. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining the highest standards of food quality, consistency, innovation, guest satisfaction, and operational excellence across all dining venues. The Culinary Director will play a key role in menu development, talent management, cost control, and culinary innovation while ensuring that all food offerings align with the resort's luxury positioning and guest expectations.
   

  

**What Is In It For You**
* Unleash the excitement: enticing rewards and unbeatable benefits are waiting for you!
* Ignite your skills with our cutting\-edge Academies for rapid professional growth.
* Cultivate your talents and watch your career flourish, locally and globally.
* Drive change through impactful Corporate Social Responsibility activities.
* Immerse yourself in a vibrant work environment with extraordinary colleagues.
* Join us on a direct path to success as we skyrocket to new heights!


**Key Responsibilities**
* Oversee all culinary operations across the resort, ensuring alignment with brand standards and operational excellence.
* Lead the development and execution of authentic Italian cuisine concepts, menus, and dining experiences.
* Ensure consistency and the highest standards in food quality, taste, presentation, and temperature across all kitchens.
* Drive innovation in menus, concepts, and food presentation to enhance guest experience and market positioning.
* Collaborate with Marketing and F\&B leadership to develop promotions, campaigns, and destination dining experiences.
* Maintain and improve kitchen operations to maximize profitability while ensuring high guest satisfaction.
* Ensure effective communication and alignment across all culinary teams.
* Monitor and manage stock levels, purchasing, receiving, and storage to meet company standards and control costs.
* Ensure all goods purchased comply with hotel specifications and quality standards.
* Lead and develop culinary teams through training, coaching, succession planning, and performance management.
* Ensure compliance with HACCP guidelines, hygiene standards, and food safety regulations.
* Promote best practices in kitchen operations, cleanliness, and grooming standards.
* Build strong cross\-functional relationships with F\&B, Operations, Sales \& Marketing, and other departments.
* Identify opportunities for efficiency improvements, cost optimization, and operational excellence.
* Stay updated on culinary trends, particularly within Italian and Mediterranean cuisine, and implement relevant innovations.
* Lead by example, fostering a positive, engaged, and high\-performing team culture.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in culinary arts, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
* Professional Culinary Certification from an accredited institution.
* Minimum 10 years of professional culinary experience, including at least 3 years in a senior culinary leadership role.
* Strong expertise in Italian cuisine, including menu development, authentic preparation methods, and modern Italian dining trends.
* Previous experience in luxury hotels, resorts, or high\-end standalone restaurants.
* Proven track record in menu engineering, food cost control, and operational management.
* Experience managing large culinary teams in a high\-volume environment.
* Strong understanding of international cuisines and dietary requirements.
* Excellent leadership, communication, coaching, and organizational skills.
* Knowledge of kitchen management systems, inventory controls, and purchasing procedures.
* Advanced knowledge of food safety standards and HACCP requirements.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, multicultural environment.
* Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience opening or repositioning Italian restaurants within luxury hospitality environments.
* Experience working in island resorts, destination resorts, or luxury lifestyle hospitality brands.
* Strong network within the international culinary community and awareness of emerging food trends.


 Additional Information
   

  

**Our commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion:** 
 We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent.
   

  

**Why work for Accor?** 
 We are far more than a worldwide leader. We welcome you as you are and you can find a job and brand that matches your personality. We support you to grow and learn every day, making sure that work brings purpose to your life, so that during your journey with us, you can continue to explore Accor’s limitless possibilities.
   

  

 By joining Accor, every chapter of your story is yours to write and together we can imagine tomorrow's hospitality. Discover the life that awaits you at Accor, visit https://careers.accor.com/
   

  

**About Mantis Collection:** 
 Mantis is a boutique hospitality group that was founded by conservationist Adrian Gardiner in 2000, with its main focus predominantly in Africa and the Middle East. Mantis grew from Adrian’s vision to restore and rewild degraded farmland which he developed into a widely\-acclaimed Private Game Reserve. This was the first private game reserve in the Eastern Cape and the beginning of eco\-tourism in a poverty\-stricken province that had few opportunities outside of commercial farming. Adrian and the Mantis team successfully created a place where man and nature could co\-exist sustainably. From this initial success, the Mantis model was then developed worldwide, understanding that consumers could use the Mantis portfolio as a mark of quality, consistency and character. Today the diverse portfolio of handpicked properties links up to create travel journeys, which offer guests the opportunity to experience the essence of the location in a setting of tailored luxury. Rooted in conservation, Mantis pursues sustainable business practices and develops tourism products that are respectful of the environment and communities in which they operate.

Structural aspects of the hotel as well as the maintenance of grounds and external facilities all fall within the span of responsibility.

* Provide advice to senior management on all aspects of engineering support, environmental controls and the operational efficiency of the property.

Responsible for the general cost control aspects of maintenance, the preparation of departmental cost budgets and their implementation and submission to management.
* Control of Capital Project Planning, in liaison with management, to ensure capital funding is effectively allocated and budgeted in accordance with company directives and philosophy.
* Plan, implement and administer an energy management program by establishing energy reduction objectives, the maintenance of records and regular reporting of performance against these objectives.
* Ensure the colleagues awareness of energy management within the property by conducting regular education and training programs on energy conservation and matters related to efficient operation of equipment in a cost\-effective fashion.

* Ensure adherence to all statutory regulations and fire codes by regularly reviewing policies and safety procedures. Ensure that any tests and inspections required on plant by statutory authorities are carried out as and when required and that all records and documentation associated with such tests and surveys are correctly kept and/or displayed. Ensure that the hotel fulfills all compliance requirements.
* Ensure technically competent engineering colleagues by selecting, training and developing a motivated, well\-qualified maintenance team. Carry out regular work sampling studies within the department and evaluate the performance and productivity of personnel.

Closely monitor the condition of the physical property and equipment by conducting continual inspections of the building. Ensure that preventative maintenance schedules are in operation and regularly upgraded.
* Contribute to a high standard of quality control within the hotel.
* Closely supervise outside contractors to ensure the cost effectiveness and the technical efficiency of all services performed. Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with contracts, leases, service agreements and warranties.
* Ensure the quality of all work completed by both employees and external contracted colleagues adheres to the standards of good engineering practice.
* Contribute to the effectiveness of management decision making by representing the engineering department at all executive and colleagues meetings and by ensuring regular liaison with heads of other departments.


**Qualifications**
* Experience managing large and complex hotel assets, ideally within premium properties
* Strong technical knowledge across HVAC, electrical, plumbing, BMS and fire/life safety systems
* Demonstrated experience leading CAPEX projects,
* Strong understanding of WHS legislation, statutory compliance and building regulations
* Excellent contractor, stakeholder and project management capabilities
* Exceptional leadership, communication and problem\-solving skills
* A proactive, solutions\-focused mindset with strong commercial acumen
* Qualifications in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil Engineering or a related discipline are highly regarded
* Knowledge of sustainability practices and energy management systems
* Experience working within heritage or highly regulated environments is advantageous

data.jd_text:
**Chief of Staff to the Founding Partners** 




  





 SV7 is a Kuwait\-based group operating across the GCC and internationally, originating and advising on opportunities at the intersection of infrastructure, strategic advisory, and digital commerce.
 



  





 We’re looking for a Chief of Staff to be a second mind to the founding partners — someone who sees around corners, owns problems end to end, and moves between financial analysis, strategy, business development, and operations in the course of a single day.
 



  





 This isn’t an administrative role. It’s a high\-trust, high\-autonomy seat for someone exceptional who wants proximity to the founding partners, real ownership, and exposure across industries.
 



  





**What you’ll do** 




  





 • Act as the founding partners’ right hand across all entities — turning high\-level direction into action, and exercising their judgment when they can’t be in the room.
 



 • Own strategic projects end to end: structuring deals, building financial models, drafting term sheets and proposals, and pressure\-testing decisions before they’re made.
 



 • Run point on business development — preparing briefs, managing partner and counterparty relationships, and keeping multi\-track initiatives moving.
 



 • Build the analysis behind major decisions — financial, commercial, and operational — with rigor and precision.
 



 • Work ten steps ahead, surfacing risks, opportunities, and decisions before they become urgent.
 



 • Represent the founding partners at a senior level, internally and externally, with discretion and polish.
 



  





**What we’re looking for** 




  





 • A sharp, strategic mind that thinks in systems, frameworks, and second\-order consequences.
 



 • Strong financial and commercial fluency — comfortable building models, reading deals, and reasoning about structure.
 



 • Exceptional written and verbal communication — able to move from a board\-level memo to a vendor negotiation without dropping the standard.

Description synthétique du poste
   

  

 Sous l'autorité de la Conseillère de coopération et d'action culturelle (COCAC) / Directrice de l'Institut français du Koweït (IFK) et en lien avec l’agence comptable régionale (ACR) et le secrétariat général d'ambassade (SGA), vous occupez les fonctions de secrétaire général (SG) d’un établissement à autonomie financière (EAF) en organisant le fonctionnement et la gestion administrative, matérielle, juridique, budgétaire et financière de l’Institut Français du Koweït qui dispose d’une personnalité juridique locale. Vous gérez également les crédits du service de coopération et d'action culturelle (SCAC) et proposez un appui ponctuel à l’Institut français de recherche à l’étranger, le Centre français de Recherche de la péninsule arabique à Koweït (CEFREPA).
   

  

 Activités principales
   

  

 Sous l'autorité du COCAC/Directeur, vous êtes responsable des affaires générales, des questions budgétaires, comptables et administratives, du management des ressources humaines, de la gestion immobilière, logistique, matérielle et de la sécurité. Vos missions principales sont les suivantes : 1\. Contribution au pilotage : \- mise en œuvre du plan de redynamisation de l’activité et de redressement financier de l’institut ; \- présentation des résultats et performances ; \- réalisation d'études de rentabilité et analyses prospectives ; \- accompagnement du directeur dans sa politique de mécénat et sponsoring ; \- réflexion sur les trajectoire financière, rationalisation des moyens et diversification des ressources. 2\. Gestion financière et budgétaire : \- préparation et exécution du budget, élaboration des budgets rectificatifs, mise en place d’outils d’optimisation de gestion, analyse des comptes budgétaires et suivi des tableaux de bord ; \- interface avec le ministère (DGM/DDC/RES, tutelle de l'IF) pour le contrôle de gestion et le rapport d’activités ; \- suivi du Contrôle interne financier (CIF) avec l'ACR. Le SG est membre du comité de gouvernance. 3\. Gestion des ressources humaines : \- coordination et encadrement des personnels, suivi de l’organigramme fonctionnel (ADL, expatriés), plannings, congés ; \- gestion administrative des personnels (recrutement, déroulement de carrière, contrats, évaluation, ...) ; \- suivi, application de la législation locale du travail, en lien avec l’avocat conseil du poste ; \- animation du dialogue social, relations avec les représentants du personnel et délégués syndicaux, gestion des conflits ; \- mise en place de formations ; \- suivi des questions d'hygiène, de sécurité et de conditions de travail. 4\. Gestion administrative : \- pilotage administratif et juridique (contrôle des conventions, veille juridique, gestion du contentieux ; \- suivi des contrats et conventions signés par chaque antenne, supervision des procédures administratives ; \- rédaction des notes de service, rappel des instructions, coordination des moyens et des ressources, conventions de prestation, contrat de location des locaux, rédaction de contrats avec les artistes, gestion et accueil des artistes en tournée, contact avec les fournisseurs) ; \- contrôle des activités de l'ensemble des services : réorganisation des procédures, limitation du risque de vol/fraude (en particulier au niveau du centre de langues, de l'espace Campus France, de la médiathèque) ; \- mise à jour du guide d’accueil, du règlement intérieur ; \- suivi de l'inventaire et de l'archivage. 5\. Gestion logistique, matérielle et immobilière : \- gestion du bâti et de l'investissement (travaux et commande) ; \- veille à la mise à jour régulière du plan de sécurité des emprises ; \- relations avec le propriétaire ; \- négociation et suivi des contrats de maintenance ; \- gestion des risques et veille à l'application des consignes de sécurité ; \- mise à jour du règlement intérieur de sécurité.
   

  

 Diplômes ou expérience professionnelle recommandée pour exercer les fonctions
   

  

 Pour les agents du MEAE : BAACA option encadrement. Connaissance indispensable de la DGM, de son organisation, de ses procédures, de ses outils et mécanismes de financement. Expérience réussie dans des fonctions similaires au sein d’un Institut Français, notamment en management, ainsi qu'en suivi budgétaire/gestion des ressources humaines d’un établissement cultuel. Sans être indispensable, de même que la connaissance de la région, la maîtrise de la langue locale constituerait un atout.

Dean – School of Engineering \& Computing
