**About The American International University**
 American International University (AIU) is a private institution in Kuwait, founded in 2019, offering undergraduate programs based on the American model of higher education. AIU provides degrees in Engineering, Architecture and Design, and Business Administration, with English as the language of instruction. The University is committed to fostering intellectual, cultural, and personal growth, preparing graduates for leadership roles in a global society.
   

  

 For more information, visit: www.aiu.edu.kw
   

  

 School of Engineering Profile
   

  

 The School of Engineering and \& Computing at the American International University in Kuwait comprises the departments of Biomedical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering. The School offers Bachelor of Science (BSc) degrees in Biomedical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering.
   

  

 Scope of Work
   

  

 The Dean of the School of Engineering \& Computing provides strategic, academic, and administrative leadership to advance AIU’s engineering programs. The Dean oversees academic quality, faculty development, accreditation, research and innovation, and operational effectiveness, fostering excellence, continuous improvement, and sustainable growth.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Provide overall leadership and management for the School of Engineering and Computing, including faculty, academic programs, and operations.
* Oversee all engineering and computing programs, ensuring academic excellence and market relevance.
* Lead curriculum development, scheduling, program assessment, and continuous improvement.
* Manage budgeting, resource allocation, and strategic planning.
* Oversee faculty recruitment, development, and performance management.
* Promote research and scholarly activity across the School.
* Maintain and engage the Industry Advisory Committee to align programs with industry needs.
* Lead accreditation and quality assurance processes, including ABET and related frameworks.
* Ensure accurate external communications, including the School’s website and public information.
* Strengthen industry partnerships, internships, and experiential learning opportunities.
* Support laboratory infrastructure and academic resources development.
* Represent the School in university leadership and institutional strategic initiatives.
* Promote student success, retention, progression, and employability through data\-informed leadership.


 Reporting Departments (If Applicable)
   

  

* Faculty in the School of Engineering
* Administrative and program support staff


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

 The ideal candidate shall demonstrate experience in professional and academic positions, a strong record in teaching, and outstanding international academic achievements. The candidate is expected to demonstrate ongoing contributions through published research in recognized international journals, as well as participation in exhibitions, conferences, and symposiums, in addition to the following qualifications and experience:
   

  

* Ph.D. or equivalent from a recognized university.
* Professor rank in one of the School’s disciplines.
* Strong record of excellence in teaching and research appropriate to the rank of professor.
* Leadership qualities and proven research background.
* Clear vision for higher education and School development.
* Familiarity with credit hour and semester systems.
* Senior managerial experience in higher education, preferably at dean level.
* Experience with program accreditation standards.
* Knowledge of HR, administrative, and financial policies and procedures.
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Experience with academic and industry institutions.
* Bilingual proficiency in English and Arabic is a plus.
* Experience in American or internationally accredited higher education systems is preferred.


**Additional Qualifications**
 Priority will be given to applicants with the following qualifications:
   

  

* Managerial experience and the skills necessary to launch pioneering projects.
* Multi\-cultural skills.
* Active participation in reputable organizations.
* Knowledge of the methods of evaluation and related matters.
* Documentation demonstrating support for the achievements of teachers and students.
* Understanding of the latest teaching methods, including the use of technology in the teaching process.
* Demonstration of a commitment to enriching the educational experience of students.


 How to Apply
   

  

 Interested candidates should visit the Job Opportunities section on our website and submit a resume and cover letter via: https://aiu.edu.kw/careers/jobs
   

  

 Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. The successful candidate is expected to commence employment on August 30, 2026\.

 Job Summary
 
 The Business Partner is the key and strategic interface between IT and the Business.  •Research and share new technology and bring industry best practices 
   

 •Prepare business IT budget in view of IT plans
   

 •Project Management to ensure desired objectives are achieved within defined timelines, cost and quality
   

 •Manage external vendors in terms of contracts, SLA, process alignment and payments
   

 •Work with IT to ensure that all incidents, service requests and change requests are managed within agreed service level agreements as per agreed quality standards.
   

 •Be a custodian of business processes with an objective to digitize the processes and eliminate manual work and inefficiencies
   

 •Work with the business and IT to improve Master Data Management (MDM). While primary ownership for MDM is with the business, IT must assist in the process by improving system configurations and controls, and providing timely and regular reports.
   

 •Ensure the roles and authorizations are aligned to standards. Work with finance, business team and COE for periodic review of roles and authorizations.
   

 •Maximize the use of system controls to reduce reliance on costly and inefficient manual controls.

data.jd_text:
**Description:** 
 The WADPM shall develop, revise, and maintain an airfield driving program to ensure the safe operations of vehicles, aircraft, and pedestrian movement on and around the airfield environment IAW DAFI 13\-213,
 *Airfield Driving* 
 . The WADPM shall solicit help from base senior leadership and other various base support agencies to ensure the program is effectively implemented and managed. The WADPM shall provide all initial and recurring airfield drivers’ training for all unit level Airfield Driving Program Manager (ADPMs) and all airfield drivers. The WADPM will ensure reporting of Controlled Movement Area Violations and other significant events in Amentum’s MIS system, to appropriate Wing leadership, and as required in DAFMAN 13\-204 and DAFI 13\-213\. The WADPM will conduct spot checks to enforce and monitor compliance with airfield driving procedures.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**
* Must have a \*7\-skill level from an approved DoD institution or civilian equivalent.
* Have documented knowledge or experience with ICAO procedures. Have a minimum of 1 year experience implementing airfield safety procedures and generating and facilitating airfield flight line drivers program.
* Ability to coordinate with Wing Safety, Airfield Management, Airfield Operations, and tenant units.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for program documentation, briefings, and incident reporting.
* Familiarity with airfield operations, ATC radio phraseology, airfield risk management, and airfield safety programs.
* Ability to obtain/maintain a US Secret Clearance (Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain/maintain the clearance)


**Primary Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Serve as the Wing’s designated Airfield Driving Program Manager, responsible for the full lifecycle of the Airfield Driving Program.
* Develop, maintain, and update the Wing Airfield Driving Instruction (ADI), training and testing materials, and local operating procedures.
* Train unit ADPMs and certify them to administer, test and train personnel assigned to their unit.
* Conduct initial, recurring, and remedial airfield driving training, including classroom instruction, practical evaluations and competency assessments.
* Maintain program records, training logs, violation reports, and certification documentation in accordance with DoD and USAF requirements
* Manage the issuance, tracking, and revocation of Airfield Driving Licenses, ensuring compliance with DAFI 13\-213 and local directives.
* Oversee the Runway Incursion Prevention Program, including trend analysis, corrective actions, and coordination with Wing Safety
* Lead investigations for airfield driving violations, runway incursions, and safety incidents; develop corrective action plans and report findings to Airfield Management leadership.
* Conduct program audits of individual unit programs, spot checks, and unit compliance inspections to ensure adherence to airfield driving standards.
* Provide recurring briefings to Wing leadership on program status, compliance issues, and risk mitigation measures.

You will be the operational backbone for critical systems—including Security, BMS, FAS, and ICT—navigating the complete project lifecycle from pre\-sales engagement to final delivery. Your leadership will be vital in ensuring programs are delivered on time, within budget, and in alignment with Honeywell’s strategic objectives and quality standards.

* Project Execution: Lead the overall execution of ELV projects, with a focus on mainly airport projects, following best\-in\-class methodologies.
* Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for day\-to\-day activities with all project stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and satisfaction.
* Financial Performance: Monitor monthly financial measures including revenue recognition, margins, invoicing, and cash collection to drive a positive P\&L.
* Project Planning: Develop and implement comprehensive Project Management Plans, including Scope, Execution, Quality, and Procurement plans.
* Risk \& Change Management: Identify risks and develop mitigation plans while managing scope changes through variation orders and contract alignment.
* Sales Collaboration: Engage early with Sales and Estimation teams during bidding stages and lead the formal hand\-over process.
* Performance Tracking: Monitor project performance against defined KPIs and utilize Honeywell’s operating systems, such as Cora PPM, for records management and forecasting.
* Health \& Safety: Manage all HSE\-related project activities in strict coordination with the HSE department to ensure a safe work environment


**Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Electrical, Electronics, or relevant field).
* Experience: 10\+ years of project management experience specifically with ELV Systems and Software Integrations.
* Language: Native or fluent proficiency in both Arabic and English.
* Technical Knowledge: Strong expertise in Security, BMS, and Fire Alarm Systems (FAS).
* Portfolio Management: Proven ability to manage a portfolio of projects concurrently while meeting tight deadlines under pressure.
* WE VALUE
* Certification: Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is highly preferred.
* Domain Expertise: Prior experience managing large\-scale projects in Airports, Smart Cities, or IoT domains.
* Contractual Acumen: Knowledge of contract types and the ability to effectively communicate with legal and contract teams.
* Leadership Skills: A proactive approach to problem\-solving, strong negotiation skills, and the ability to lead cross\-functional teams.
* Software Proficiency: Familiarity with project management tools (e.g., MS Office, Cora PPM) and SAP modules.


 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
   

  

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
   

  

**About Us**
 Honeywell helps organizations solve the world's most complex challenges in automation, the future of aviation and energy transition. As a trusted partner, we provide actionable solutions and innovation through our Aerospace Technologies, Building Automation, Energy and Sustainability Solutions, and Industrial Automation business segments – powered by our Honeywell Forge software – that help make the world smarter, safer and more sustainable.

data.jd_text:
**Closing Date: 26 June 2026**
 NATS is the UK’s leading air navigation service provider, handling over 2 million flights each year. It provides air traffic control services, as well as a wide range of commercial solutions to over 30 countries internationally. Our people are at the heart of our purpose to advance aviation and keep the skies safe.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 This role is accountable for the day\-to\-day operational oversight, training and implementation of ANS solutions across the contract. The role is responsible for providing advice and support within the operations directorate, ensuring independent oversight that delivers assurance that operational and training responsibilities, as well as quality standards, are being met, maintained, and continually improved in relation to the contract’s operational service delivery in Kuwait.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, acting as the point of contact for all operational and training matters.
* Understand client needs, challenges, and objectives to deliver the contract and drive customer satisfaction.
* Provide oversight on all operational activities to meet or outperform all operational and safety KPIs.
* Work closely with the regulator to ensure all policies, procedures and training programmes comply with regulatory requirements and company policies.
* Manage operational and training budgets and forecasts, tracking performance against targets and implementing corrective actions when necessary.
* Provide regular updates to clients on operational KPIs, training status, milestones, and deliverables, ensuring transparency and alignment on expectations.
* Work closely with the Delivery Director to ensure that up to date account reviews and performance reports are in place for internal stakeholders and senior management.
* Analyse day\-to\-day operations and processes and identify areas for process enhancement.
* Develop an implementation plan to introduce a Search and Rescue cell responsible for all Search and Rescue activities required in the Kuwait FIR.


**Qualifications, Skills And Personal Attributes**
* Extensive experience in ATC Supervisory or Management roles, with a detailed understanding of the operational environment and the critical role that people and processes play in achieving operational KPIs and meeting training objectives.
* Excellent leadership skills, with steadfast resolve and personal integrity.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to build rapport and influence stakeholders at all levels.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make informed decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize tasks effectively.
* Preferably possess experience in Search and Rescue (SAR) operations, including familiarity with SAR procedures, coordination protocols, emergency response frameworks and collaboration with multi‑agency teams.
* A University Degree is strongly preferred for this role.
* Fluent in English


**Additional Vacancy Information**
* Required to work flexibly across different time zones and working weeks.
* International travel as required.


 We are proud to offer a fantastic total reward package to help you thrive both personally and professionally. In addition to a competitive salary that's regularly reviewed, as a member of our international team, you'll also benefit from private healthcare and dental cover, a generous leave entitlement with the option to purchase additional leave, wellness support and a comprehensive learning and development offering. For more information, please visit International \- NATS
   

  

 If you share our passion to advance aviation and keep the skies safe – we would like to hear from you whatever your age, sex, race, faith, visible or invisible disability. Individuals that bring different perspectives, skills, life experiences and backgrounds help us be at the forefront of our industry.

* Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
* Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
* Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
* Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.
* Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.
* Intermediate computer software skills required.
* Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, “Debits/Credits”, adjusting entries and corrections.
* Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship’s Senior Officers and the corporate office.

**JOB PURPOSE:** 




 To manage and grow large account portfolios and client relationships for assigned portfolio; improve service quality levels and supervise the subordinates’ day\-to\-day activities and client interactions to ensure that the team’s objectives are constantly met and its revenue targets achieved, while maintaining client satisfaction and portfolio credit quality.

**Client and Market Analysis** 



* Participate in the financial analysis conducted on clients and their respective industries/ markets to identify potential opportunities and risks.

* Assist in the preparation of timely and accurate statements and reports to meet the unit’s requirements, policies, and standards.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE:** 




**Minimum Qualification** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Finance or related discipline is preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Attributes:** 



* Knowledge of the banking sector, and FAB’s products and business strategies
* Ability to work under pressure and adjust quickly to changing priorities
* Computer proficiency
* Ability to analyze and research information
* Banking software systems proficiency
* Data analysis and financial modelling skills
* Credit analysis and FOREX skills
* Communication skills



  





**Minimum Experience** 



* 6 years of experience in corporate banking or a similar area preferably managing client relationships

data.jd_text:
**About the Role:** 




 BÖWE is an award\-winning architecture and design firm seeking a highly experienced Quantity Surveyor with strong expertise in quantity surveying, cost estimation, cost control, tendering, procurement support, contract administration, and commercial management.
 



 The ideal candidate will manage project costs across pre\-contract and post\-contract stages, including quantity take\-offs, BOQ preparation, cost estimation, tender evaluation, variation assessment, interim payment reviews, cost reporting, and contract documentation support.
 



  





**Quantity Surveying \& Commercial Skills:** 




 • Strong experience in quantity surveying, cost estimation, BOQ preparation, tendering, and contract administration.
 



 • Proven ability to manage project costs across pre\-contract and post\-contract stages.
 



 • Advanced experience in preparing quantity take\-offs from drawings, specifications, BIM models, and tender documents.
 



 • Strong knowledge of construction materials, finishes, fit\-out works, MEP coordination, and architectural packages.
 



 • Ability to prepare detailed cost estimates, budgets, cost plans, and commercial reports.
 



 • Experience in reviewing contractor quotations, tender submissions, payment applications, claims, and variations.
 



 • Strong understanding of procurement processes, tender comparison sheets, and commercial evaluation.
 



 • Ability to review drawings, specifications, scope documents, and technical details to identify cost implications.
 



 • Strong knowledge of contract terms, project documentation, change management, and commercial risk control.

**Key Responsibilities:**

 • Assist in procurement coordination by preparing comparison sheets, commercial summaries, and recommendation reports.
 



 • Monitor project budgets, cost performance, and commercial risks throughout the project lifecycle.
 



 • Review interim payment applications, progress claims, invoices, and supporting documents.
 



 • Assess, negotiate, and validate variations, change orders, claims, and additional work requests.

 • Participate in project meetings, tender meetings, negotiation sessions, and commercial coordination discussions.
 



 • Maintain accurate commercial records, project cost files, tender documents, and contract\-related correspondence.

 • Represent BÖWE professionally in meetings with clients, consultants, contractors, and suppliers.
 



  





**Required Qualifications \& Skills:** 




 • Bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related field.

 • Excellent knowledge of construction methods, finishing works, materials, specifications, and project documentation.

 • Revit / BIM
 



 • Cost estimation and quantity take\-off tools
 



 • Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook
 



 • Microsoft Project or Primavera P6 is an advantage
 



 • ERP or project cost management systems are an advantage

 If you are a detail\-oriented Quantity Surveyor with 6 to 10 years of proven experience in quantity surveying, cost estimation, tendering, and commercial management, we would be delighted to review your application.
 



 Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
 



 Please send your CV to:
 



 📧 mz@bowe.me

*At Monks, we believe in fostering an environment where a diversity of perspectives can thrive. We proactively work to design hiring processes that promote equity and inclusion while mitigating bias. data.jd_text:
**Role Purpose**
 The Senior Manager – Internal Audit Centre of Excellence (IA CoE) is responsible for strengthening the Internal Audit function through quality assurance, strategic planning, methodology development, digital enablement, and centralized resource management.
   

  

 The role acts as the strategic and operational backbone of the Internal Audit Unit, ensuring consistency, efficiency, innovation, and alignment with Global Internal Audit Standards (IPPF), while enabling delivery of high\-quality assurance and advisory services. across the organization.
   

  

**Position Information**
* Unit: Internal Audit
* Division: CAE
* Location: HQ


**Grade:** 
 L2
   

  

**Qualification**
* Bachelor’s in accounting /finance /business or related subjects. CIA certification is a must.
* Professional certification including CA, CPA, ACCA, CISA, will be highly preferred.


**Experience**
* 8 years of total experience \& at least 3 years in a managerial position.


**Key Accountabilities**
 Quality Assurance \& Improvement Program
   

  

* Lead and manage the Quality Assurance \& Improvement Program (QAIP), develop and implement necessary quality assessment methodology, models, tools, etc.
* Ensure \& promote compliance with: IPPF / Global Internal Audit Standards, local regulations \& Internal audit methodology and policies.
* Perform ongoing internal quality assessment including individual engagement level assessments and implement improvements across the Unit.
* Conduct periodic quality reviews of Internal Audit Unit with respect to compliance with IPPF and local regulations.
* Facilitate external quality assessments.
* Identify improvement opportunities and drive continuous enhancement of audit quality.


 Performance Management
   

  

* Define and monitor KPIs and performance metrics for the Internal Audit function.
* Track audit delivery (Strategy \& Plan) against plans, timelines, and quality benchmarks.
* Support performance evaluation processes in coordination with audit leadership.
* Provide insights to CAE on productivity, utilization, and capability development.


 Risk Based Internal Audit Plan
   

  

* Coordinate development of the annual risk\-based internal audit plan after consolidating inputs from Business Units, Internal Audit teams, second line functions and Senior Management and Audit \& Risk Committee.
* Ensure alignment with enterprise risks, regulatory requirements, and strategic priorities and recommend adjustments in the plan where necessary.
* Monitor performance and delivery of audit engagement against the plan and produce MIS.


 Internal Audit Strategy
   

  

* Support the CAE in developing and monitoring of Internal Audit Strategy, initiatives and roadmap.
* Coordinate and where necessary implement strategic initiatives.


 Standardization \& Operational excellence
   

  

* Custodianship of IA manual and ensures IAU activities are in compliance with regulatory and Global IA standards.
* Continuously review, enhance, and update Internal Audit methodologies, frameworks, and processes to ensure alignment with best practices and drive operational excellence.
* Standardize audit approaches, templates, tools, and reporting formats across the function.
* Benchmark audit practices against leading industry standards and peers.
* Facilitate knowledge sharing and adoption of best practices across the function.


 Continuous Audit \& Digital Enablement
   

  

* Ensure the smooth delivery of continuous audit engagements and where possible coordinate to embed the output in the planned audit engagements.
* Enable and support audit teams through data analytics and automation.
* Ensure the digital enablement of the Unit (including use of emerging tech like AI) as per the IA Strategy.
* Oversee administration of the Audit Management System, including System configuration and enhancements, User access and governance and Integration of analytics and reporting capabilities
* Promote adoption of data\-driven auditing and digital tools across Internal Audit.


 Audit \& Risk Committee \& Executive Management Reporting
   

  

* Prepare and submit to CAE monthly, quarterly, semi\-annual and annual MIS and other lAU performance related reports, including follow up / findings dashboard, internal quality assessment reports, state of lA report, etc.
* Assist CAE in preparation and administration of BAC Meetings.
* Provide insights on audit plan status, Key findings and themes, open findings, risk exposures and trends.
* Support CAE in presentation materials and stakeholder communications.
* Prepare and coordinate delivery of various awareness sessions on GRC \& Ethics.


 Follow\-Up Coordination
   

  

* Coordinate follow up and validation efforts to ensure timely closure and update of findings status.
* Centralize tracking of Internal Audit findings and management action plans.
* Monitor and report status of overdue and high\-risk issues.
* Escalate critical matters to CAE and senior management.


 Whistleblower Program \& Investigations
   

  

* Manage and coordinate investigations under the Whistleblower Program.
* Ensure investigations are conducted objectively, confidentially, and in line with policies.
* Coordinate with Legal, HR, and Compliance where required.
* Ensure proper documentation, reporting, and closure of cases.


 Resource Management /Audit Pool Administration
   

  

* Manage the centralized Internal Audit resource pool (\~20 staff). Schedule Audit engagements and serve as a focal point for consolidating individual engagement level assessment and leave management of the pool staff.
* Allocate resources to audit teams (GMs/SMs) based on audit priorities, skill requirements, capacity and utilization
* Oversee scheduling, utilization, and workforce planning.
* Manage administrative aspects including ERP\-related matters, timesheets, and coordination.


 Subsidiaries Audit Management \& Contract Governance
   

  

* Manage procurement and onboarding of outsourcing vendors for Internal Audit of unlisted subsidiaries in line with governance requirements.
* Coordinate closely with the appointed external audit service providers, Management of subsidiaries and respective GM Internal Audit to effectively plan, execute, and monitor audit activities across subsidiaries.
* Ensure timely preparation and submission of audit dashboards and reports, including consolidation and escalation of key findings, to the Board Audit \& Risk Committee.
* Monitor vendor performance against SLAs and handle administrative matters including invoice verification and accurate cost chargeback to subsidiaries.


**Key Competencies**
**Leadership**
* Assertiveness and Conflict Resolution
* Fostering Learning and Development
* Inspiring and Leading Others
* Leading Change and Cultivates Innovation
* Visioning and Alignment


**Behavioral**
* Timely decision\-making
* Drives Achievements
* Ethics \& Compliance

data.jd_text:
The Manager / Senior Manager – Portfolio \& Asset Management will support the execution of Asyad Group’s portfolio management function. The role will focus on driving asset\-level performance visibility, detailed financial and operational analysis, value creation planning, turnaround support, and capital efficiency across Asyad’s portfolio companies and strategic investments.
 



 The role requires a strong analytical profile, preferably with significant Financial Due Diligence experience, and the ability to work closely with business units, finance teams, operating companies and senior management to identify performance gaps, challenge assumptions, and support value creation initiatives.
 



  





**Performance Monitoring \& Business Plan Review** 



* Monitor performance against budget across revenue, EBITDA, cash flow and capex, and flag key risks and variances.
* Prepare monthly/ quarterly structured asset review packs and performance dashboards for management and board reporting.
* Identify early warning signals and track implementation of corrective actions.
* Review and challenge annual business plans, budgets and forecasts submitted by portfolio companies.
* Validate key assumptions and assess alignment with strategy and value creation objectives.
* Evaluate capex plans and expected returns to support capital allocation decisions.



  





**Financial Analysis** 



* Perform detailed analysis of financial performance, covering revenue, margins, cost structure, working capital, cash generation and capital efficiency.
* Assess sustainability of earnings and identify key performance gaps and drivers.
* Build and maintain asset\-level financial models to support performance tracking and decision making.



  





**Value Creation \& Turnaround** 



* Identify and prioritize value creation opportunities across growth, cost optimization, asset utilization and cash improvement.
* Support turnaround of underperforming assets through structured action plans and performance tracking.
* Quantify impact of initiatives and monitor delivery against targets.



**Governance \& Shareholder Oversight** 



* Prepare shareholder materials, portfolio reviews and performance summaries for internal stakeholders.
* Track board resolutions, shareholder actions and key governance matters across portfolio companies.
* Identify governance, reporting and control gaps and escalate where required.



**Capital \& Strategic Support** 



* Assess capital structure, funding requirements, returns and capital efficiency across assets.
* Support follow\-on investments, restructuring initiatives and divestment analysis.
* Contribute to portfolio\-level capital allocation and strategic review discussions



  





**Skills** 



* Hands\-on and analytical with strong FDD and financial analysis capability.
* Ability to challenge numbers, assumptions and business plans.
* Strong Excel and financial modelling skills.
* Ability to convert detailed analysis into clear management recommendations.
* Commercial judgment and ability to link operational drivers to financial performance.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with ability to work across business units and portfolio companies.
* High attention to detail and ability to work with incomplete or inconsistent data.
* Clear written communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to operate independently and manage multiple assets/workstreams.



 English language is mandatory. Fluent in Arabic preferred.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Business or related field.
* Professional qualification preferred: CPA, ACCA, CFA, ACA or equivalent.
* MBA or advanced finance qualification is an advantage.



**Experience** 



* Minimum 8 to 10 years of experience in Financial Due Diligence / Transaction Services, private equity, portfolio management or corporate finance.
* Strong experience in financial analysis, business performance review and working with management accounts.
* Demonstrable strong financial modelling experience.
* Extensive knowledge of financial accounting concepts and corporate finance.

data.jd_text:
**Purpose/ Mission:**
 The IT Manager is responsible for establishing, managing, and developing the overall Information Technology (IT) function for Meranti Green Steel Oman (MGSO). This role will lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of the company's IT infrastructure, systems, cybersecurity, applications, and digital solutions to support business operations, project development, and future plant operations in Oman.
   

  

 The IT Manager will act as the primary IT lead for the Oman business, working closely with corporate teams, external service providers, and business stakeholders to ensure secure, reliable, and scalable technology solutions are in place to support the company's growth.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
 IT Strategy \& Governance
   

  

* Develop and implement the IT roadmap and technology strategy aligned with business objectives.
* Establish IT policies, procedures, standards, and governance frameworks.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, cybersecurity standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Develop and manage the annual IT budget and expenditure plans.


 IT Infrastructure \& Operations
   

  

* Establish and maintain all IT infrastructure for the Oman office and future operational sites.
* Manage corporate networks, internet connectivity, servers, cloud services, storage, and communication systems.
* Ensure system availability, reliability, and business continuity.
* Oversee IT asset management, software licensing, and hardware lifecycle management.


 Cybersecurity \& Risk Management
   

  

* Develop and implement cybersecurity controls and best practices.
* Monitor and manage cybersecurity risks, vulnerabilities, and incident response activities.
* Ensure appropriate backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity plans are in place.
* Lead cybersecurity awareness initiatives across the organization.


 Business Systems \& Applications
   

  

* Manage business applications and digital platforms used across the organization.
* Support implementation and administration of ERP, HR, Finance, Procurement, Document Management, and collaboration systems.
* Work closely with functional teams to identify opportunities for process improvement and digitalization.
* Ensure system integrations and data integrity across business applications.


 Project \& Operational Support
   

  

* Support project teams with technology requirements during project development and execution phases.
* Participate in the planning and implementation of IT systems required for future plant operations.
* Coordinate with engineering, operations, procurement, and corporate teams to deliver technology solutions supporting business growth.


 Vendor \& Contract Management
   

  

* Manage relationships with IT vendors, consultants, service providers, and telecommunications companies.
* Lead vendor selection, contract negotiations, and performance management activities.
* Ensure service providers meet agreed service levels and business requirements.


 User Support \& Service Delivery
   

  

* Establish and oversee IT support services for all employees and contractors.
* Ensure timely resolution of IT issues and delivery of high\-quality user support.
* Develop IT service management processes and performance metrics.


 Budget Planning \& Cost Management
   

  

* Develop and manage the annual IT budget, ensuring alignment with business objectives and operational requirements.
* Prepare short\-term and long\-term forecasts for IT\-related expenditures, including hardware, software, infrastructure, cybersecurity, licenses, and external service providers.
* Work closely with Finance to ensure timely budget planning, cost control, and resource allocation.
* Evaluate and recommend cost\-effective technology solutions while maintaining operational efficiency and security.
* Monitor IT spending and ensure all expenditures are managed within approved budgets.


 Team Leadership
   

  

* Build and develop the IT function in Oman as the organization grows.
* Recruit, mentor, and manage IT personnel and external support resources.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and customer\-focused service delivery.


 Corporate \& Regional Collaboration
   

  

* Act as the primary IT representative for MGSO and coordinate closely with corporate teams and external stakeholders.
* Support group\-wide IT initiatives, digital transformation projects, and technology standardization efforts.
* Provide regular reports and recommendations to management regarding IT performance, risks, and future requirements.
* Support the CEO in all relevant tasks where requested.


**Requirements/ Skills/ Experience:**
* Experience establishing and managing IT functions within industrial, manufacturing, construction, energy, or large\-scale project environments.
* Strong knowledge of IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud platforms, enterprise applications, and network administration.
* Experience managing IT vendors, budgets, contracts, and technology projects.
* Knowledge of ERP systems and enterprise business applications is preferred.
* Experience working in multinational organizations and start\-up or greenfield project environments is highly desirable.


**Required Education/ Qualification/ Training:**
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 10 years of IT experience, including at least 5 years in a managerial or leadership role.

 Serve as the owner's area manager for the Utilities area on the 2\.5 Mtpa green Direct Reduced Iron (DRI) / Hot Briquetted Iron (HBI) project in Duqm, Oman. Carry technical and commercial accountability for the Utilities area, encompassing air separation (ASU; nitrogen and ox
data.jd_text:
**Purpose / Mission:**
 Serve as the owner's area manager for the Utilities area on the 2\.5 Mtpa green Direct Reduced Iron (DRI) / Hot Briquetted Iron (HBI) project in Duqm, Oman. Carry technical and commercial accountability for the Utilities area, encompassing air separation (ASU; nitrogen and oxygen production), water treatment and management (raw water, demineralised water, cooling water, fire water), wastewater management and zero liquid discharge (ZLD), compressed air and instrument air, plant air, gas distribution (nitrogen, oxygen, hydrogen, natural gas as applicable), and the utilities\-process interface with DRI and BoP areas. Dual\-role overlay as Lead Process Engineer for utilities scope; DRI process authority sits separately with a dedicated DRI Process Engineer post\-FID. Lead the Utilities scope from pre\-FID through FEED, EPC tender, construction, commissioning and ramp\-up.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
 Own technical and commercial accountability for the Utilities area, including scope definition, OEM selection, contract negotiation, claims management, schedule and cost ownership for the area.
   

  

 Lead the owner's engineering definition of the air separation unit and gas distribution system serving the plant.
   

  

 Lead the owner's engineering of the plant water systems including raw water intake or supply, demineralised water production, cooling water systems, fire water, and the integrated water balance.
   

  

 Own the design and delivery of the wastewater management and zero liquid discharge (ZLD) strategy, with particular attention to the water\-constrained Duqm site and applicable Omani regulatory requirements.
   

  

 Lead the owner's engineering of compressed air, instrument air, plant air and gas distribution systems including nitrogen and oxygen distribution to point\-of\-use.
   

  

 Provide cross\-area utilities discipline authority including review and assurance of utility interfaces with the DRI, BoP, Materials Handling and HV areas.
   

  

 Provide Utilities area input to specifications, tender documentation, technical evaluations and award recommendations for the utility EPC and equipment packages, including interfaces with major utilities OEMs and licensors (Air Liquide, Linde, Air Products and equivalents).
   

  

 Review and approve utilities engineering deliverables from the Owner's Engineer and EPC contractors.
   

  

 Lead Utilities area input to HAZID, HAZOP, SIL assessment, LOPA and related process safety studies.
   

  

 Support cost estimate development for utilities scope to FID\-level accuracy.
   

  

 Provide Utilities area technical and commercial leadership during construction, pre\-commissioning, commissioning and performance testing.
   

  

 Cross\-area coordination: the plant\-wide cable and pipe bridge system spans the BoP, Materials Handling and Logistics, Utilities and High Voltage areas. Civil and structural design ownership sits with the BoP Area Manager; routing, occupancy and interface management is a joint responsibility of the BoP, MH\&L, Utilities and HV Area Managers. The four Area Managers will agree corridor strategy, support spacing, occupancy planning and revision control as a co\-ordinated workstream.
   

  

 Contribute to the development and mentoring of process and utilities engineering resources as the in\-country team grows from pre\-FID into execution.
   

  

**Requirements / Skills / Experience:**
 Minimum 15 years' experience in heavy industrial process plant utilities engineering, with a clear strength in process discipline depth across multiple utilities including at least three of: air separation, water treatment systems, wastewater and ZLD, compressed air and gas distribution, and steam systems where applicable.
   

  

 Strong preference for direct experience on integrated steel, ironmaking, petrochemical, fertilizer, refinery, mining or analogous heavy industrial greenfield projects.
   

  

 Direct experience interfacing with major utilities OEMs and licensors (Air Liquide, Linde, Air Products for ASU, and equivalents for water treatment) is a strong advantage.
   

  

 Experience across the full project lifecycle: FEED, detailed design, procurement, construction supervision, commissioning and ramp\-up.
   

  

 Demonstrated commercial muscle on top of technical authority: experience owning a utilities package end\-to\-end from scope definition through OEM selection, contract execution, claims management and closeout.
   

  

 Direct experience with ZLD or advanced wastewater systems is a strong advantage for the water\-constrained Duqm site.
   

  

 Experience with cooling water systems including seawater cooling is a strong advantage.
   

  

 Demonstrated familiarity with international process and utilities design codes (ASME, API, ISA, IEC) and applicable Omani regulatory requirements.
   

  

 Demonstrated leadership in process safety, including accountability for HAZOP, SIL and process hazard analysis outcomes.
   

  

**Prior GCC Or Extreme\-environment Project Experience Preferred.**
 Demonstrated ability to operate as a senior technical and commercial authority in a lean owner team environment.
   

  

 Strong communication, technical writing and review skills.
   

  

**Required Education / Qualification / Training:**
 Bachelor's degree in Chemical, Process, Mechanical or related engineering discipline (required). Master's degree in Process or Chemical Engineering (preferred). Chartered Engineer, Professional Engineer or equivalent internationally recognized professional status (preferred). Member of a recognized professional engineering institution (e.g. IChemE, AIChE, IMechE) (preferred).
   

  

**Required Language Proficiency:**
 English \- Fluent
   

  

 Arabic \- Nice to have

data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The incumbent will lead in a proactive and prudent fashion the Bank’s treasury function by managing the Bank’s cash flows, asset – liability profile and foreign exchange exposures/risk and generate supplementary income within the set strategy, risk appetite, applicable regulatory limits and approved products.
   

  

 Manages activity of the trading team by implementing the defined Group Risk Management Framework in which they operate. Develops and actively pursues cross\-border trading opportunities and developing a strategy to grow the business. Has thorough knowledge of a broad range of trading techniques including trading/hedging strategies (stack and roll, cross commodity), market liquidity and volatility, options, derivatives, futures, swaps, exotics pricing and trading, and has broad understanding of commodity markets. Has extensive background in risk management strategies and is responsible for ensuring that overall value and risk exposure of the trading portfolio remains within the agreed Group strategy.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities By Dimensions**
* Oversees the development and implementation of annual business plans and target budgets for units of responsibility with emphasis on achievement of set targets/ objectives, business growth and expansion; in accordance with the Bank’s overall budget and strategy.
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and delegate activities/ authority to the respective staff as required and monitor exercise of the same.
* Approves formulated, and/or specific strategies which cover balance sheet asset, liability and contingent allocation, longer term funding arrangements asset diversification, use of market products and financial instruments with risks identified, and hedging, trading and investment strategies.
* Oversees the implementation and evaluation of the Treasury strategic and business development plans and achievement of related short and long term business goals both locally and internationally.
* Approves Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) created for the purpose of performance monitoring and quality measurement purposes for the Treasury function and monitor their achievements on periodic basis.
* Implements KPI’s and best practices for role
* Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimise cost, avoid waste, and optimise benefits for the bank.
* Demonstrate clear understanding of the important factors behind the bank's financial \& non\-financial performance.
* Approves Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/ units to achieve improvements in turnaround time (TAT) which will also help increase external customer satisfaction.
* Provide timely and accurate information to the external and internal auditors, the Compliance function, and Group Risk as and when required.
* Meets with visiting banks representatives, and maintains credit lines and services through active relationship management.
* Establishes and oversees the management of relationships with key internal and external stakeholders and managing key client interface.
* Provide feedback to Corporate/Retail Banking business units’ managers and, as appropriate, recommend course of action.
* To assist customers in all their queries on Bank’s product and seek solution to their requests
* Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/ units to achieve improvements in turn\-around time.
* Build and maintain strong and effective relationship with all other related departments and units to achieve the Group’s goals/objectives.
* Provide timely and accurate information to the external and internal auditors and the Compliance function as and when required.


**Education/Experience Requirements**
* University graduate preferably with a Major in Finance, Banking, Economics, or Mathematics (related field of study), Masters preferred.
* MBA, CFA, ACT or related professional certification is preferable.
* 15 years diverse Treasury experience, of which 5 years must have been in a leading role in a Treasury Division, preferably in the country or with an international bank.
* Additional commercial banking experience, especially credit and market risk management would be of value.


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV

Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
   

  

 In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.
   

  

 We have been present in Saudi Arabia for 40 years and with over 600 employees to date, we are growing rapidly. Together we are delivering our signalling, control and train protection systems for the North –South Railway (NSR), the longest system of it’s kind in the world. Together we are key suppliers of In\-flight entertainment and connectivity systems as well as air traffic management solutions in Saudi. We are making Saudi Arabia a safer place by securing the country’s critical infrastructure and e\-security solutions that secure the country’s electronic payment systems. Thales has been selected to supply major electronic systems for air defence and the Group also supplied communication and optronic systems for the Army, the Saudi Arabia National Guards and the Air Force.
   

  

**JOB OBJECTIVE:**
 As a Project Manager within the Platforms Services \& Delivery team you will ensure that a project is completed on time and will deliver solutions that meet both customers’ requirements and our commitments. Your role will directly contribute to internal and external customer satisfaction which is key for business growth.

* You will provide visibility of the project progress, obtain the necessary resources and identify and resolve issues; and manage the financial aspects of projects including costs and revenue
* You will manage project risks and related action plans
* You will manage change requests and identify new business opportunities

data.jd_text:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a Client Program Senior Specialist, you will support and manage the execution of BCG U client upskilling programs, ensuring successful delivery, operational excellence, and outstanding client experience. You will collaborate closely with client\-facing teams and clients, serving as a vital operational link to maximize learner engagement and ensure program success.
   

  

 You will contribute to the end\-to\-end program management cycle, including:
   

  

* Coordinating and aligning with clients and case teams on schedules, logistics, and milestones.
* Managing learner onboarding, inquiries, tracking participation, and completion.
* Facilitating smooth collaboration with internal teams (learning designers, faculty, platform \& solutions team) and external vendors.
* Driving the preparation and delivery of live sessions for client learners, including facilitating such sessions.
* Working collaboratively to identify and monitor program metrics and address complex issues, using data to develop practical recommendations that improve client and learner outcomes.
* Handling administrative, legal, and contractual program components.
* Contributing to BCG U internal projects when not staffed on client assignments.
* Proactively staying abreast of new platform features; incorporating enhancements to drive learner engagement and program effectiveness.
* Applying technical expertise and understanding of digital learning to help solve operational challenges and suggest improvements to client programs.
* Managing complex, high\-stakes projects with significant strategic and operational impact, beyond purely upskilling program execution.
* Leveraging GenAI and emerging technologies (e.g., AI agents, automation tools) to streamline workflows, improve operational efficiency, and automate components of program delivery where appropriate.


 You'll continuously improve the effectiveness and efficiency of BCG U programs, proactively identifying operational issues and suggesting solutions.
   

  

**You are good at**
* Working effectively with colleagues across teams and backgrounds, ensuring everyone’s contributions align with client needs.
* Coordinating and managing large\-scale client upskilling programs effectively.
* Ensuring quality and consistency in program delivery, with strong attention to detail.
* Collaborating with cross\-functional teams and clearly communicating with various senior stakeholders (both verbal and written).
* Problem\-solving with a client\-focused mindset.
* Analyzing data; clearly and persuasively communicate data and recommendations to senior stakeholders to support better decision\-making.
* Preparing impactful presentations and communications.
* Building and maintaining strong internal and external relationships.
* Adapting flexibly to changing priorities and environments.
* Managing complex, high\-visibility, and high\-stakes initiatives with strong risk management and stakeholder alignment.
* Identifying opportunities to leverage GenAI and automation to improve processes and enhance scalability.


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* Minimum 5\-7 years’ experience in relevant business.
* Relevant educational qualifications such as a graduation degree.
* Experience/exposure to digital learning, Edtech preferred.
* Consulting Experience a plus but consulting mindset a requirement.
* A strong interest in talent and upskilling.
* Demonstrated Project Management Expertise. Strong ability to successfully plan, execute, and oversee complex projects from initiation to completion, ensuring on\-time delivery and within budget, while effectively working in cross\-functional teams and stakeholders set up.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, strong command of the English and Arabic languages.
* Demonstrated integrity, discretion, and professionalism in handling confidential data and client information.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data insights from into actionable recommendations.
* Data analytics skills, including tools like Tableau preferred.
* Advanced skills in PowerPoint, MS Excel, Word.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, high\-stakes projects involving multiple senior stakeholders and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong understanding of GenAI capabilities and a proactive mindset toward leveraging AI agents and automation to enhance operational effectiveness.
* Comfort experimenting with and implementing emerging technologies to drive efficiency and innovation.


 Please note this position is not restricted solely to the responsibilities listed above and that the job scope and responsibilities are subject to change.
   

  

 Who You'll Work With
   

  

* Global BCG U Team
* Global BCG LD Team
* Various regional case teams
* External vendors/partners


 Additional info
   

  

 BCG U is our global center of expertise on upskilling and reskilling for transformative business impact. BCG U’s mission is to equip our clients with future\-critical capabilities, so that organizations can tackle issues with skill shortages rapidly and at scale. In doing so, we help unlock the full potential of private and public sector organizations around the world.
   

  

 More than a traditional L\&D program, BCG U helps our clients with significant, strategic capability improvement by:
   

  

* Upskilling strategically critical groups (those with highest impact potential) to drive transformational change
* Driving significant and measurable impact on key business metrics
* Crafting rich, customizable learning journeys at scale, tailored to client's unique challenges, and delivered by world\-class academic experts and industry practitioners


 Ensuring that learnings are made applicable in daily work through practice, processes and tools to support change, and new behaviors and mindsets.
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

**About Thunes**
 Thunes is the Smart Superhighway for money movement around the world. Thunes’ proprietary Direct Global Network allows Members to make payments in real\-time in over 130 countries and more than 80 currencies.
   

  

 Thunes’ Network connects directly to over 7 billion mobile wallets and bank accounts worldwide, via more than 350 different payment methods, such as GCash, M\-Pesa, Airtel, MTN, Orange, JazzCash, Easypaisa, AliPay, WeChat Pay and many more.
   

  

 Members of Thunes’ Direct Global Network include gig economy giants like Uber and Deliveroo, super\-apps like Grab and WeChat, MTOs, fintechs, PSPs and banks. Thunes’ Direct Global Network differentiates itself through its worldwide reach, in\-house Smart Treasury Management Platform and Fortress Compliance Infrastructure, ensuring Members of the Network receive unrivalled speed, control, visibility, protection and cost efficiencies when making real\-time payments globally.
   

  

 Headquartered in Singapore, Thunes has offices in 12 locations, including Barcelona, Beijing, Dubai, London, Manila, Nairobi, Paris, Riyadh, San Francisco, Sao Paulo and Shanghai. For more information, visit: https://www.thunes.com/
   

  

**Context of the role**
 The Network Development Director will report to the Head of Network (APAC). The primary responsibility of this role is to develop and execute sustainable network partners with various participants of the payments and financial services ecosystem in South Asia and Central Asia.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be an individual who is self\-motivated, possesses high energy and has a strong business acumen.
   

  

 The incumbent will be focused on developing and scaling partnerships with large, strategic financial partners including banks, cash networks, wallet providers, acquirers, payment facilitators, card issuers and processors. Leveraging their partnerships and industry relationships, this person will advocate for innovation and support Thunes' go to market efforts as well as strive to be a thought leader in the financial ecosystem.
 **They will be developing a well\-functioning pay\-out and pay\-in network in Pakistan and South Asia to support the growth and development of our global network.**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Manages and develops critical banking and network partnerships, with a focus on driving and executing joint initiatives and helping launch and manage new offerings benefiting Thunes’ users
* Manages full sales cycle including generation of leads to managing live accounts, ensuring best in class methodical partner management rooted in KPI’s
* Leverage industry knowledge to craft thoughtful partnerships and product strategies with banks and networks, partnering with business development and various stakeholders (including risk, product, engineering, compliance, legal, and treasury)
* Steers, in conjunction with Business Development team, banks and FI's to execute deals supporting that strategy and help ensure that there is a proper execution plan in place
* Gather inputs from and co\-ordinates with internal stakeholders (including risk, compliance, product, engineering, treasury) on creation and execution of partner strategy
* Leverages significant industry experience to Thunes' internal teams; composes holistic network strategy and advances that strategy with FI's
* Interacts with Senior Officers within the Central Bank to facilitate approval processes, followed by overseeing and managing the coordination in rolling out new services to targeted partners/customers
* Attends Industry events and follow\-up on source leads
* Ensures all specific reports and records are completed within timeframe, including utilisation of CRM tool with precision, sharing timely feedback to line manager about performance, sales activity, account management status and strategy planned
* Initiate and maintain strong working relationships with colleagues and customers to ease communication channels and facilitate resolutions for issues, ensuring satisfaction amongst existing accounts resulting in positive account retention


**Professional Experiences And Qualifications**

* At least 8\+ years of partnerships and account management experience working with financial institutions and payments companies across the region
* Should be able to manage multiple stakeholders, including compliance, legal, solutions delivery, treasury and finance
* Strong negotiator and ambitious on what Thunes should try to do with their network partners and how Thunes creates value and differentiation

*Checkout.com*

*If you want to do career\-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.*
*With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.*
 Checkout.com is actively looking for strategic\-thinking, resourceful, and highly driven Enterprise Account Managers to join our Commercial team in Dubai. We are currently hiring for multiple positions across varying levels of seniority.
   

  

 We are looking for top\-tier payments talent to join our high\-performance culture as we continue to scale after exponential growth in 2025\.
   

  

 As an Enterprise Account Manager, you are the business advisor and primary post\-integration point of contact. You will act as a trusted advisor, helping our largest merchants navigate the complex global payments landscape. You must possess the ability to influence C\-level stakeholders, the analytical rigor to perform deep dives into payment performance, and the resilience to turn difficult conversations into win\-win partnerships.
   

  

 Candidates will be assessed against a specific set of criteria for each level (Mid \& Senior) depending on their depth of payments experience and the competencies demonstrated throughout the interview process.

* Performance Optimisation: Conducting deep\-dive analyses of merchant payment data to increase acceptance rates, reduce false declines, and optimize the checkout flow.
* Strategic Growth: Proactively identifying opportunities to upsell new products and features, increasing our "share of wallet" within each account.
* Retention \& Loyalty: Acting as the primary line of defense against churn by building high\-touch, consultative relationships and resolving complex merchant pain points.
* Commercial Negotiation: Navigating difficult conversations and handling pushback from sophisticated enterprise merchants with a focus on long\-term partnership.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partnering with Sales, Integration, Legal, and Product teams to ensure an outstanding, seamless merchant experience.
* Market Advocacy: Acting as the voice of our product and an ambassador of our brand, providing expertise and guidance on global payment strategies.


**About You**
* Experience: At least 4 years of experience in a B2B Enterprise Account Management or Relationship Management role within a payments or digital first business!
* Domain Expertise: Strong knowledge of e\-commerce, payment technologies, and major future trends in the financial ecosystem.
* Commercial Acumen: Proven ability to hit financial targets, reduce churn, and drive expansion revenue (upselling/cross\-selling).
* Resilience: Experience handling high\-pressure situations and pushback from difficult or demanding enterprise stakeholders.
* Analytical Mindset: Comfortable using data to tell a story; you can turn complex transaction data into actionable recommendations for a merchant.

* Communication: Exceptional English communication skills (Arabic is a plus), with the ability to influence at all levels of an external organization.

 We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.
   

  

 Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.
   

  

 We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.
   

  

 It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.
   

  

**Life at** 
**Checkout.com**
 We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.
   

  

 Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.
   

  

 For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

data.jd_text:
**Sanabil Studio** 
 is a venture builder that blends industry expertise, technology, and startup know\-how to turn bold ideas into real businesses. We take concepts from zero to launch, and when a venture proves its potential, we back it with seed funding and hands\-on support to help it scale.
   

  

**TradePay** 
 is one of those ventures building the trade finance infrastructure for FMCG in Saudi Arabia. Our mission is to replace informal supplier credit with structured, data\-driven working capital that helps small merchants grow, protects suppliers from credit risk, and strengthens the FMCG supply chain. We are building a new credit system for underbanked merchants where risk is priced from real transaction behavior, not balance sheets. Our model leverages supplier, distributor, and marketplace data to power embedded
 **B2B BNPL** 
 experiences across FMCG ecosystems. This is not traditional lending this is supply\-chain\-native decisioning built from real commerce data.
   

  

 We are looking for a Head of Operations to build and lead TradePay's operational backbone from the ground up
 **reporting directly to the CEO.**
**THE ROLE What you'll own here** 
 .
   

  

* Design and build TradePay's end\-to\-end collections infrastructure and execution workflows
* Manage repayment reminder strategies across SMS, WhatsApp, calls, and automated payment systems
* Own outbound collections activities, promise\-to\-pay tracking, escalation workflows, and legal recovery coordination
* Manage third\-party collections partners and build collections dashboards and reporting
* Oversee merchant onboarding operations including KYB/KYC document collection, account activation, and merchant operational records
* Build and manage the merchant support function covering repayment inquiries, operational issues, complaints, and escalations
* Design and manage dispute workflows, coordinating with suppliers and merchants to resolve issues and maintain audit trails
* Oversee merchant repayment processing, payment reconciliation, settlement coordination, and payment exception resolution
* Manage operational relationships with FMCG suppliers, distributors, force automation providers, marketplaces, payment providers, collection agencies, and KYB/KYC providers
* Produce daily collections reports, DPD and aging reports, and operational KPI dashboards
* Build scalable operational processes, SOPs, and controls, and automate manual workflows in partnership with Product and Engineering


 How Success Will Be Measured Scalable collections infrastructure fully operational, automated reminder and collections engine implemented, merchant support function operating to defined SLAs, real\-time operational reporting and dashboards live, reconciliation and settlement processes fully controlled, dispute management framework operational, and operational readiness achieved for national scale.
   

  

 Where This Role Can Go Head of Operations → Chief Operations Officer as TradePay scales its operational infrastructure across the region.
   

  

**THE PROFILE You're probably a fit if…**
 You have 8\+ years of experience in fintech, lending, BNPL, payments, collections, customer operations, or financial services operations
   

  

**You Have Proven Experience Building Operational Functions From Scratch**
 You bring strong collections and customer servicing experience
   

  

 You have experience managing operational teams and third\-party vendors
   

  

 You have strong analytical and reporting capabilities
   

  

**You Have Startup Or High\-growth Company Experience**
 You have Saudi Arabia or GCC experience
   

  

**THE ENVIRONMENT What Working Here Actually Looks Like.**
 1\- Operational Engine Ownership You own the infrastructure that keeps TradePay running. Every merchant onboarding, every collections workflow, every settlement and reconciliation process runs through what you build.
   

  

 2\- Direct Impact on the Business Collections performance, merchant satisfaction, and operational scalability all trace back to your systems. What you build moves the business forward directly.
   

  

 3\- A Role That Grows With You This position has a clear path into Chief Operations Officer as TradePay scales its operational infrastructure across the region.
   

  

 What You Get From Us
   

  

**Competitive pay** 
 : A package that reflects your experience and the market, not a lowball with "equity upside" as the excuse. Meaningful equity: Real upside aligned with long\-term value creation. Real data, at scale: Access to real\-world FMCG transaction data across suppliers, distributors, and marketplaces the foundation of a category\-defining fintech.
   

  

**Premium gear:** 
 , day one: Everything you need to hit the ground running, set up and ready before your first morning. Mentorship that matters: Direct collaboration with the Founder and leadership team from people who've actually built and scaled ventures.
   

  

**An accelerated curve** 
 : You'll learn more here in 12 months than most roles offer in three years.
   

  

 Hiring Process Introductory recruiter conversation → Founder interview → Operations case study and practical exercise → Reference checks → Offer

Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that's shaping the future of flying. It seeks to lead the aviation industry by transforming Saudi Arabia into a global aviation and trade hub \- a digitally native airline that will connect the kingdom to more than 100 destinations.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Are you a detail driven payment operations professional who thrives in fast paced, high accuracy environments?
   

  

 We are looking for a payments expert to support the continuous availability, stability, and optimization of our payment orchestration platform across all sales channels.
   

  

 In this role, you will monitor and operate end to end payment processes including authorizations, captures, settlements, refunds, and chargebacks to ensure accurate and timely transaction handling.
   

  

 You will work on payment performance monitoring, configuration support, and testing activities that enhance acceptance rates and checkout success. All while also supporting compliance with PCI DSS, card scheme rules, IATA requirements, and regulatory standards by performing routine control checks, documenting exceptions, and escalating anomalies.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with vendors, internal technical teams, and finance partners to resolve incidents, track SLAs, support integrations, and maintain accurate settlement and reconciliation data.
   

  

 This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a highly specialized operational function at the heart of our commercial and financial ecosystem.
   

  

**About You**
 Degree qualified, you will demonstrate a minimum of 3 years in payments, financial services, or merchant or airline payment operations.
   

  

 You are expected to understand the full payment transaction lifecycle including authorization, capture, settlement, refunds, and chargebacks, with practical experience supporting payment operations and resolving processing issues across multiple channels. You will bring hands on knowledge of payment ecosystems including orchestration platforms, gateways, acquirers, card schemes, and alternative payment methods.
   

  

 We would love to hear from you even more if you have experience working with PCI DSS requirements, card scheme rules, operational controls, and incident handling processes.
   

  

 This is your opportunity to shape the future of air travel. Bring your best and show us why you can own this position within Riyadh Air.
   

  

 Please submit your application by clicking on the Apply button. Our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing applications shortly.

 🚒
