 Faculty members are responsible for contributing to our academic programs, conducting research, and actively participating in departmental and university activities. They are engaged in teaching, services, research, and professional development tasks.
 



 Potential candidates are expected to:
 


* Significantly contribute to the advancement of the research activities and publish research findings in refereed journals.
* Have a strong commitment to teaching excellence and student advising at undergraduate levels.
* Prepare teaching materials, maintaining and improving competence in subjects being taught.
* Develop and deliver courses to students.
* Prepare class activities, quizzes, assessments, and exams.
* Passionately support the college and departmental\-wide activities and services with a spirit of leadership, commitment, accountability, and collegiality.
* Evaluate, monitor, and mentor student academic progress.
* Supervise and assist students in all aspects related to the courses.
* Guide, lead, and mentor students in internship and research projects.
* Engage actively in promoting the growth of the university and participate in strategic activities and events.
* Participate in departmental and college meetings and activities.
* Serve and support functional activities of departmental committees.
* Undertake any other duties as may be directed by the Head of Department.



  





**Required Qualifications** 




  




* A Ph.D. degree in Information Technology/Computer Science or a related field from an internationally accredited university.
* Excellent publication records, in particular during the last five years.
* Pursue academic achievements and have a demonstrable research capability.
* Publish his/her research findings in refereed journals.
* Have a solid commitment to teaching excellence and student advising at the undergraduate
* level.
* Ability to work in a diverse, interdisciplinary, and fast\-paced environment is essential.
* Have demonstrable skills in oral and written English.

Functional Consultant – Dynamics 365 Supply Chain
 



 Department
 



 Information Technology / ERP
 



 Reports To
 



 ERP Manager / Head of Business Applications
 



 Job Summary
 



 The Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Functional Consultant is responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management solutions. The role involves gathering business requirements, translating them into system solutions, conducting user training, and ensuring the effective utilization of D365 Supply Chain modules to support business operations and strategic objectives.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 Business Analysis \& Requirements Gathering
 


* Conduct workshops with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements.
* Document business processes, functional specifications, and solution designs.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through system enhancements.



 Solution Design \& Implementation
 


* Configure and implement Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management modules according to business requirements.
* Lead end\-to\-end implementation projects, including requirement gathering, system configuration, testing, deployment, and post\-go\-live support.
* Recommend best practices aligned with Microsoft standards and industry practices.



 Supply Chain Functional Areas
 



 Provide functional expertise in:
 


* Procurement \& Sourcing
* Product Information Management
* Inventory Management
* Warehouse Management
* Transportation Management
* Master Planning
* Demand Forecasting
* Production Control (Manufacturing)
* Vendor Management
* Quality Management



 Testing \& User Acceptance
 


* Prepare functional design documents and test scenarios.
* Execute system testing and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Validate solutions to ensure business requirements are met.



 Training \& Support
 


* Conduct user training sessions and prepare training materials.
* Provide functional support and troubleshoot business process issues.
* Assist users in adopting system enhancements and new functionalities.



 Integration \& Collaboration
 


* Work closely with technical consultants, developers, and third\-party vendors.
* Support integrations between D365 and other enterprise systems.
* Coordinate with project managers and business teams to ensure successful project delivery.



 Continuous Improvement
 


* Monitor system performance and recommend process improvements.
* Stay updated with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain features and releases.
* Participate in system upgrades and enhancement projects.



 Qualifications
 


* Bachelor's Degree in Information Systems, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 certifications are highly preferred.



 Experience
 


* Minimum 5 years of experience in ERP consulting.
* At least 3 years of hands\-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.
* Experience in full\-cycle ERP implementation projects.
* Experience in retail, distribution, manufacturing, logistics, or warehousing environments is preferred.



 Technical Skills
 


* Strong knowledge of Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management modules.
* Understanding of ERP implementation methodologies.
* Knowledge of business process mapping and documentation.
* Familiarity with Power Platform, Power BI, and Microsoft ecosystem is an advantage.
* Understanding of integrations, workflows, and reporting solutions.



 Soft Skills
 


* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently and within project teams.
* Strong presentation and training skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.



 Preferred Qualifications
 


* Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management Functional Consultant Associate.
* Experience with multinational organizations or large\-scale ERP projects.
* Arabic and English proficiency.
* Experience working in GCC countries is an advantage.

**Graduate Program \| iGeneration 2026 by Ahlibank**




**Be part of the generation driving the digital revolution in banking.**




 At Ahlibank, we believe the future of banking is powered by technology, innovation, and talented people.
 **iGeneration Program** 
 is designed for ambitious Omani graduates who are ready to transform their potential into impactful careers within the banking and financial services industry.
   





  





 Join a career development journey that combines hands\-on experience, structured learning, mentorship, and exposure to cutting\-edge technologies, enabling you to contribute to Ahlibank's digital transformation while building a strong foundation for a successful technology career.
   





  





**About the Program**




**iGeneration Program** 
 is Ahlibank's flagship technology graduate development initiative, created to identify, develop, and empower Omani talent for critical and emerging technology roles within the banking sector.
   





 The program is tailored for the next generation of digital thinkers, innovators, and problem\-solvers who are eager to apply their academic knowledge in a dynamic professional environment and grow into future technology leaders.

 ▸ A structured

 ▸ Exposure to real\-world projects that contribute directly to Ahlibank's digital transformation journey
   





 ▸ Professional mentorship and coaching from experienced banking and technology professionals
   





 ▸ Access to technical and professional development opportunities, including online and instructor\-led learning
   





 ▸ A collaborative environment that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and career growth
   





  





**Who We Are Looking For**




 We are seeking motivated and forward\-thinking Omani graduates who are passionate about technology, innovation, and shaping the future of digital banking.
   





 The ideal candidate is analytical, curious, adaptable, and eager to make a meaningful impact through technology\-driven solutions.
   

  





**Key Competencies**




 ▸ Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
   





 ▸ Interest in digital technologies, automation, data, AI, cybersecurity, or software development
   





 ▸ Effective communication and interpersonal skills
   





 ▸ Ability to collaborate within cross\-functional teams
   





 ▸ Self\-motivated mindset with a passion for continuous learning and innovation
   





 ▸ Adaptability and willingness to embrace new technologies and challenges
   





  





**Why Join Ahlibank?**




 At Ahlibank, we are committed to developing the next generation of Omani technology professionals. Through iGeneration, you will gain valuable industry experience, build future\-ready skills, and contribute to innovative initiatives that are shaping the future of banking in Oman.
   





 This is more than a graduate program—it's an opportunity to launch your career, expand your capabilities, and become part of a team that is driving digital transformation and innovation.

**Join us and become part of the next generation of technology innovators at Ahlibank.**



 Requirements
